articleTitle: High-power 355-nm UV generation in CsLiB6O10 crystal
abstract: A 30.8-W output power at 355 nm is generated in CsLiB<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> crystal using a hybrid picosecond MOPA seeded by a gain-switched LD. The conversion efficiency from the fundamental source to the third harmonic reaches 48.1%.

articleTitle: High contrast CEP-stable OPCPA front-end for PW-class Ti:Sapphire system
abstract: We demonstrate a hybrid OPCPA/CPA front-end for PW Ti:Sapphire systems delivering 3 mJ, 27 fs, CEP-stable pulses at ∼800 nm with a temporal contrast exceeding 2.10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−13</sup> and 80 mrad CEP fluctuations.

articleTitle: Tomography of single-photon subtraction process in multiple time-frequency modes
abstract: We present a method to characterize single-photon subtraction process in multiple time-frequency modes. To obtain complete information of the process, we use coherent-state quantum process tomography, and express the results by a quantum process matrix.

articleTitle: Bound state in the continuum nanophotonic laser
abstract: We have designed a high quality factor cavity that is based on a bound state in the continuum and harnessed its properties to demonstrate a novel type of surface emitting laser. We have experimentally demonstrated lasing action in this compact nanophotonic laser at room temperature with a very low threshold power.

articleTitle: Electronically tunable, fully fiber-integrable optical parametric oscillator
abstract: We present a fiber-integrable optical parametric oscillator, tunable from 1130 to 1310 nm within 8 μs via the repetition frequency of the pump laser. Output energies above 1 nJ at a repetition frequency around 1MHz were reached.

articleTitle: Optical Tamm states in liquid photonic crystal and metasurface
abstract: Tamm plasmon (TP) modes happens at photonics crystal with metals. By using metasurfaces as reflective half wave plate and liquid photonic crystal, optical Tamm state could be excited and be able to tune by varying temperature or voltage.

articleTitle: 2.56 Tbps (8 × 8 × 40 gbps) fully-integrated silicon photonic interconnection circuit
abstract: We demonstrate a fully-integrated photonic Wavelength Division Multiplexing (WDM) transceiver circuit with heterogeneous integration on silicon, and on-chip interconnection with total transmission capacity up to 8×8×40 Gbps.

articleTitle: High-resolution, THz-wave real-time imaging with Si-camera based on nonlinear optical up-conversion
abstract: We propose THz-wave real-time imaging system with high resolution based on second harmonic generation in nonlinear organic DAST crystal. The spatial resolution is estimated to be less than ~3×λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">THz</sub>.

articleTitle: A study on spectral dynamics of Raman-assisted mode-locking fiber cavities with time-stretch technique
abstract: We experimentally explore spectral dynamics in Raman-assisted mode-locking fiber laser cavities with time-stretch technique at both 1.0 and 1.5 μm. The real-time correlation between temporal and spectral intensity reveals different behaviors at different dispersion regimes.

articleTitle: Ring modulator small-signal response
abstract: Ring modulator electro-optical frequency responses are presented together with pole-zero diagrams for both intracavity and coupling modulation cases. Through this modeling, we analyze the ring modulator small-signal response based on the pole-zero locations.

articleTitle: Coherent Raman gain suppression in a gas-filled hollow-core PCF pumped in the deep ultraviolet
abstract: DUV-pumped hydrogen-filled kagomé-PCF displays coherent Raman gain suppression at much higher values of dephasing than for visible pumping. This will impair the performance of gas-based Raman amplifiers and lasers, especially at higher pump powers.

articleTitle: Towards high-cooperativity strong coupling of a quantum-dot in a tunable microcavity: The role of emitter broadening
abstract: We study single InGaAs quantum-dots within a tunable microcavity and observe a large Rabi splitting and high cooperativity (5.5). The dynamics are limited by spectral wandering; we propose an improved design towards ultrahigh cooperativity.

articleTitle: Achromatic modulators and hybrid beam combiners for astrophotonics
abstract: We present our work on achromatic beam combiners to achieve wide band interferometry, using electro-optic devices. We also present our developments in hybrid integrated optics interferometers coupling passive devices but allowing sharp bending radius waveguides and active devices, allowing phase modulation in lithium niobate channel waveguides. These systems have been developed for visible applications, in the context of LITHIUM cubesat project and FIRST 9 channel beam combiner for FIRST/SUBARU telescope.

articleTitle: Computational single-shot hyper-spectral imaging based on a microstructured diffractive optic
abstract: A compact hyper-spectral imaging system using a microstructured transparent diffractive optic is experimentally demonstrated with enhanced spatial resolution. A fast algorithm based on regularization is exploited to reconstruct hyper-spectral data in a single shot.

articleTitle: Site-controlled crystalline growth of InN on GaN substrate and its photoluminscence
abstract: We report a site-controlled growth of InN on a GaN substrate. Crystalline InN micropillars were selectively grown from the hexagonal V-pits on GaN surface. The grown mechanism and photoluminescent property will be discussed.

articleTitle: External modulation technique for the generation of strict linearly chirped continuous waves
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate generation of optical linearly chirped frequency continue waves by an external modulation technique over 2.5 GHz. The highest relative accuracy of 4.7 % and the best linearity of 0.9997 are measured and analyzed.

articleTitle: Magnetic-field sensor based on magnetic-fluid-filled silica microcapillary resonator
abstract: A magnetic-field sensing scheme based on a silica microcapillary resonator filled with magnetic fluid is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The results show that a sensitivity of 4.6 pm/mT is achieved.

articleTitle: Tunable graphene-based mode converters and optical diodes
abstract: We introduce compact tunable spatial mode converters for parallel-plate waveguides consisting of two graphene monolayers operating in the mid-infrared wavelength range. We show that such structures can also be used to design graphene-based optical diodes.

articleTitle: Optomechanical quantum control of a nitrogen vacancy center in diamond
abstract: We demonstrate optomechanical quantum control of a nitrogen vacancy (NV) in the resolved-sideband regime by coupling the NV to both optical fields and surface acoustic waves and by using strong excited-state electron-phonon coupling for NVs.

articleTitle: Wireless optical transmission of 450 nm, 3.2 Gbit/s 16-QAM-OFDM signals over 6.6 m underwater channel
abstract: We experimentally realized a gigabit underwater wireless optical communication system using commercially available 450 nm blue laser diode. By implementing 16-QAM-OFDM modulation, we achieved data rate of 3.2 Gbit/s with a BER of 6.83×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> over 6.6 m channel.

articleTitle: Tensile-strained Ge/SiGe quantum-well microdisks with overlying SiNx stressors
abstract: We demonstrate Ge/SiGe multiple-quantum-well microdisks on Si substrates with SiN<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> stressors on top. The strain transferred from the SiN<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> to the Ge quantum wells are determined by photoluminescence and Raman measurements, and are in agreement with simulation results.

articleTitle: Wideband nonlinear frequency conversion with OAM fiber
abstract: We propose >99% efficient wideband frequency conversion between visible and telecommunication bands for quantum networks and single-photon detection, enabled by the enhanced phase matching capabilities offered by intermodal Bragg scattering in OAM fibers.

articleTitle: Cascaded optical parametric amplifier in PPLN for efficient narrowband terahertz generation
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally the onset of cascaded optical parametric amplification (COPA) in periodically-poled lithium niobate. This technique permits narrowband terahertz wave generation beyond the Manley-Rowe limit.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared second harmonic spectroscopy probing surface phonon polariton localization in SiC nanopillars
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate mid-infrared second harmonic generation frequency-domain spectroscopy as a novel, highly sensitive approach to investigate the degree of sub-wavelength localization of surface phonon polaritons in SiC nanopillars.

articleTitle: Tunable dielectric metasurfaces using elastic substrates
abstract: We introduce a tunable metasurface platform for efficient reconfigurable optical wavefront shaping based on stretchable elastic substrates. As proof of concept, we demonstrates lenses with highly tunable focal length.

articleTitle: Enhancing the efficiency of thermophotovoltaics with photon recycling
abstract: We show that photon recycling utilizing the spectral selectivity of the photovoltaic band edge enables 48% thermophotovoltaic heat-to-electricity conversion efficiency at 1200°C with In<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.47</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.53</inf>As cells, and present experimental methods to demonstrate this concept.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of Moiré metasurfaces
abstract: We report the fabrication of moiré metasurfaces by moiré nanosphere lithography and their optical properties. Moire metasurfaces consist of a wide variety of metallic nanoparticles and show multi-band absorption peaks from visible to infrared range.

articleTitle: A 100m/40Gbps 680-nm VCSEL-based LiFi transmission system
abstract: A 100m/40Gbps 680-nm VCSEL-based LiFi transmission system employing three-stage injection-locked technique and doublet lens scheme is proposed. With the assistance of LNA and CDR, low BER of <; 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> at 100m/40Gbps operation is obtained.

articleTitle: Patterning of ion-sliced lithium niobate for hybrid photonic integration on silicon
abstract: We present a method to pattern ion-sliced LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> with controllable size, shape, and crystal orientation for integration on silicon. Measurements of hybrid silicon and LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> resonators with coplanar electrodes exhibit a 5.2 pm/V tunability.

articleTitle: High power single-frequency and frequency-doubled laser with active compensation for the thermal lens effect of TGG crystal
abstract: By inserting an intracavity DKDP slice with negative thermal lens effect into a single-frequency and frequency-doubled laser, the harmful effect of TGG is actively compensated and the highest output power of 30.2 W is achieved.

articleTitle: A 70-W average power sub 100-ps laser based on a fiber and bulk hybrid MOPA configuration
abstract: High repetition rate high power picosecond laser is an urgent demand for the micro machining of transparent materials and other applications. Based on a fiber and bulk hybrid MOPA system, we demonstrate a 70-W average power laser at 1064nm with 1000-kHz repetition rate and 83-ps pulse duration.

articleTitle: Growth of single-phase wurtzite BAlN with 7.2%-B contents
abstract: We report on growth of 100-nm single-phase wurtzite BAlN layers with B contents up to 7.2% by MOCVD, which can be potentially applied to deep UV DBRs for VCSELs.

articleTitle: Polarimetric measurements and analysis of different metal-coated mirrors
abstract: We study the induced polarization by different metal-coated mirrors of an azimuth-over-elevation beam scanner. We devised and tested a method to eliminate these effects for all scan directions by means of altering the incident polarization.

articleTitle: Direct growth of high-power InGaN/GaN quantum-disks-in-nanowires red light-emitting diodes on polycrystalline molybdenum substrates
abstract: The first high-power InGaN/GaN quantum-disks-in-nanowires red (λ=705 nm) light-emitting diodes on metal substrates was demonstrated. The low turn-on voltage and high power were achieved through the direct growth of high-quality nanowires on TiN/Ti/Mo stack.

articleTitle: Indistinguishable heralded single photons from two separate silicon nanowires pumped at different wavelengths
abstract: Quantum interference of heralded photons from two separate silicon nanowires pumped at different wavelengths shows a raw visibility of 88±8.4%, indicating that these photons are highly indistinguishable and can be multiplexed for quantum photonic applications.

articleTitle: Short-wave infrared compressive imaging of single photons
abstract: We show megapixel-resolution short-wave infrared single-photon imaging with a timing resolution of 150 ps utilizing one superconducting nanowire single-photon detector and compressive imaging.

articleTitle: Modulation technique for improving temporal resolution in biphoton coincidence measurements
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a new method for temporal characterization of entangled photons based on electro-optic modulation and time shifting. Our technique reduces the resolution limits induced by the large timing jitters in single-photon detectors.

articleTitle: Efficient scalable monolithic semiconductor high-energy terahertz pulse source
abstract: A novel ZnTe contact-grating THz source, pumped above the three-photon absorption edge, was demonstrated. THz pulses up to 3.9 μJ energy were generated with up to 0.3% efficiency, 100× higher than reported previously for ZnTe.

articleTitle: Charge transport in Na0.63CoO2 thin film studied by terahertz spectroscopy
abstract: Charge transport in Na<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.63</sub>CoO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> thin film was investigated experimentally by time-domain terahertz spectroscopy and theoretically using Monte Carlo calculations of charge response in nano-structured materials. The dominating transport mechanism is a metallic-like conductivity of charges partly confined in constituting nano-grains. The scattering time at low temperatures is limited by scattering by ionized defects and the conductivity is strongly suppressed due to capture of a major fraction of charge carriers in deep traps.

articleTitle: Planar lens at visible: Metasurface versus refractive optics
abstract: We demonstrate planar lenses in the visible range (λ = 405nm, 532nm, and 660nm) with superior performance over a commercially-available objective. Planar lenses have focusing efficiencies as high as 86% with a numerical aperture of 0.8.

articleTitle: Quantum emission from hexagonal boron nitride monolayers
abstract: We demonstrate first room temperature, and ultrabright single photon emission from a color center in two-dimensional multilayer hexagonal boron nitride. Density Functional Theory calculations indicate that vacancy-related centers are a likely source of the emission.

articleTitle: High-performance terahertz source based on a bimodal laser diode and a plasmonic photomixer
abstract: We demonstrate a compact terahertz source based on a bimodal laser diode and a plasmonic photomixer, which generates 0.45 mW power at 1.62 THz and offers a broad radiation frequency tuning range of 0.15-3 THz.

articleTitle: A tunable and switchable dual-wavelength single-longitudinal-mode fiber laser at 2μm based on saturable absorber and self-injection locking
abstract: A 2μm novel dual-wavelength single-longitudinal-mode (SLM) fiber laser based on saturable absorber and self-injection locking which can ensure SLM operating stable is reported. The proposed configuration has ingenious and compact structure, and reliable performance.

articleTitle: Optical sensing with all-dielectric photonic crystals
abstract: Summary form only given. Dielectric multilayered structures are introduced here as building blocks of disposable chips for sensing applications. Some experimental configurations are illustrated wherein flat or patterned multilayers are employed for sensing in either label-free, spectroscopic or fluorescence operational modes. In particular, the possibility to enhance and control the emission from fluorescence markers on the chip surface is demonstrated to improve the detection limit in bio-assays for cancer diagnostics.

articleTitle: High speed infrared spectroscopy induced by all optical modulation of pulsed quantum cascade laser
abstract: We demonstrated a high speed frequency modulation spectroscopy scheme for trace gas sensing. It was up to 400 MHz by means of the all-optical modulation of a pulsed distributed-feedback QCL by near-infrared illumination.

articleTitle: Generation of sharp electron bunches from a laser field and a dc bias field
abstract: Our exact analytic solution for electron emission shows that sharp electron bunches may be generated from a metal surface subject to a weak laser field and a strong dc bias field.

articleTitle: Parametric cooling of a degenerate Fermi gas by shaking an optical trap with anharmonic frequencies
abstract: We develop a technique for cooling a degenerate Fermi gas in a crossed-beam optical trap, where high-energy atoms are selectively removed by modulating the stiffness of the trapping potential with anharmonic trapping frequencies.

articleTitle: 104 Gbps PAM4 transmission over OM3 and OM4 fibers using 850 and 880 nm VCSELs
abstract: The receiver sensitivity of 52 Gbps-PAM4 is investigated over OM3/OM4 fibers in real time. The measured sensitivities are compared and correlated with measured fiber bandwidths for 850/880 nm channels to examine 104 Gbps SWDM2-PAM4 transmission.

articleTitle: Computer-generated optical mode-managed funnel coupler for reducing intrinsic coupling loss
abstract: We developed a mode management technique for computer-generated optical circuits. An optical funnel coupler for PON systems using it exhibited upstream-coupling of 4.5 dB better than those of branched couplers while providing the WDM function.

articleTitle: Detecting determinism in laser noise: A novel diagnostic approach for ultrafast lasers
abstract: A method for analyzing the statistical nature of laser noise is demonstrated. By application to CEP noise characteristics, the method is shown to enable discriminating between deterministic technical and stochastic quantum noise contributions.

articleTitle: Experiment demonstration a directly excited orbital angular momentum and wavelength tunable laser
abstract: A wavelength tunable directly generated orbital angular momentum (OAM) carrying laser is proposed and demonstrated. The topological charge value of OAM laser can vary from -10 to +10 and the OAM laser wavelength can cover the C-band.

articleTitle: Recent progress in wind field sensing by aerosol lidar and motion estimation algorithms
abstract: Recent research results that involved the application of two motion estimation algorithms (cross-correlation and wavelet-based optical flow) to data from two ground-based atmospheric aerosol lidar systems (analog and digital direct detection) will be presented.

articleTitle: Optical radiocarbon detection (14C) using a quantum cascade laser
abstract: We describe a cavity ring-down spectrometer which uses a quantum cascade laser for optical detection of radiocarbon in the mid-infrared spectral region. A description of the instrument, key components, and future improvements will be discussed.

articleTitle: Sub-picosecond auger-mediated hole trapping dynamics in CdSe/CdS Core/Shell colloidal semiconductor nanoplatelets
abstract: The ultrafast carrier dynamics of CdSe/CdS core/shell colloidal nanoplatelets are investigated using femtosecond transient absorption spectroscopy. We observed electron cooling, as well as Auger-mediated hole trapping and concomitant Auger heating on sub-picosecond timescales.

articleTitle: Nanometric Anderson localization at optical wavelengths
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate localization of visible light in deep subwavelength disordered multilayers with ~15 nm layer thicknesses, making it possible to sense 2 nm thickness variations in individual layers, and we demonstrate localization enhanced transmission.

articleTitle: Biologically inspired optofluidic lasers via chlorophylls
abstract: The first demonstration of chlorophyll lasers with two lasing bands was achieved by using an optofluidic ring-resonator. Our work revealed the mechanism and unique characteristics of chlorophyll lasers which leads to novel biocompatible laser applications.

articleTitle: Fluorescence imaging of waveguide mode beating and propagation in tapered and bend regions
abstract: Propagation of light through planar waveguides is important for photonic integrated circuits. Experimentally imaging light intensity within multimode waveguides shows how different modes interfere. These images can be used to determine waveguide properties.

articleTitle: Simultaneous electronic and magnetic excitation of cobalt by intense THz pulses
abstract: We study the interaction of intense THz magnetic fields with ferromagnetic thin films. At higher field intensities, the THz electric field starts playing a role, strongly changing the dielectric properties of the cobalt thin film.

articleTitle: Bi-doped fiber laser for telecom applications
abstract: Novel Bi-doped low RIN fiber laser operating at 1450 nm in both CW and mode-lock regimes was used for forward pumping in 83-km telecom link using distributed Raman amplification with very low signal power variations.

articleTitle: Broadband silicon-on-insulator 2×2 power splitters using curved asymmetric waveguides
abstract: Broadband silicon-on-insulator (SOI) 2 × 2 power splitters are designed based on curved asymmetric waveguide coupler sections. A 50/50 power splitter with a footprint of ~20 × 3 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and ±1dB bandwidth >100 nm is designed and fabricated.

articleTitle: 50 Tbit/s massively parallel WDM transmission in C and L band using interleaved cavity-soliton Kerr combs
abstract: Interleaving two soliton Kerr combs we generate 179 carriers for WDM transmission and demonstrate transmission of a data stream of 50 Tbit/s over 75 km. This is the highest data rate achieved with a chip-scale comb source.

articleTitle: What are the merits of hyperbolic metamaterials?
abstract: Detailed analysis of hyperbolic metamaterials shows that Purcell enhancement attainable in them is negated by loss, slow velocity and impedance mismatch. These materials offer no advantage whatsoever relative to simple slab and gap plasmonic waveguides.

articleTitle: Visible range plasmons in topological insulators
abstract: Near-field imaging in the visible reveals the existence of localized and propagating plasmons on the surface of topological insulator. We also report ab-initio band structure calculations explain the origin of plasmonic response in chalcogenide compounds.

articleTitle: Line-tunable CW lasing of mid-infrared acetylene gas hollow core fiber laser
abstract: Line-tunable CW lasing of acetylene around 3 μm was demonstrated in a laser cavity made of hollow core fiber. The pump laser at 1.53 μm was a diode laser and the threshold was below 20 mW.

articleTitle: Light-vapor interactions in an atomic cladding micro ring resonator coupled system
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the evanescent coupling between a solid core micro ring resonator and rubidium atomic vapor. Highly efficient and effective absorption cross sections as well as distinct Fano lineshapes are observed.

articleTitle: Hybrid fiber amplification system mastered by non-aqueous tape casting fabricated Yb-doped ceramic lasers
abstract: We compare laser performances of composite YAG/Yb:YAG and bulk Yb:YAG ceramic lasers in chirped-pulse and self-similar amplification, showing excellent power-scaling and pulse-compression properties of the hybrid ceramic master-oscillator fiber amplifier.

articleTitle: Integrated hyperbolic metamaterial devices for efficient rectification of infrared radiation
abstract: We discuss possibility of rectifying infrared radiation using metal-insulator-metal tunneling nanodiodes, engineered as hyperbolic-metamaterials (HMMs). We demonstrate that responsivity of HMM-based devices can reach tens of mA/W in mid-infrared region, which may find interesting applications in photodetection and energy harvesting.

articleTitle: Advancements in substrate-transferred crystalline coatings
abstract: We outline recent advances in high-performance substrate-transferred crystalline coatings with key results being the demonstration of sub-ppm absorption in the near infrared, as well as preliminary loss measurements in the mid-IR from 3-4 μm.

articleTitle: Emergence of transverse spin in optical modes of semiconductor nanowires
abstract: Here we demonstrate the generation of transverse spin angular momentum by the weakly-guided mode of semiconductor nanowires. The evanescent field of these modes in combination with the transversality condition accounts for the transverse spin.

articleTitle: Hybrid colloidal quantum dot silicon nitride waveguide gain measurement based on variable stripe length method
abstract: We fabricated hybrid colloidal quantum dot silicon nitride waveguides and demonstrate they exhibit amplified spontaneous emission under femtosecond optical pumping. The gain coefficient is measured using an integrated variable stripe length method.

articleTitle: Small core chalcogenide photonic crystal fiber for mid-infrared wavelength conversion: Experiment and design
abstract: Kerr index and dispersion parameter of a small core chalcogenide photonic crystal fiber are estimated via four-wave mixing near 2 μm. From these values, new fiber design is proposed to efficiently generate idlers in mid-infrared.

articleTitle: A fully guided-wave approach to the generation and detection of squeezing at a telecom wavelength
abstract: We report on the first realization of an entirely guided-wave squeezing experiment at telecom wavelength. Our setup exploits non-linear optical waveguides and fiber components. This configuration allows implementing a plug-and-play experiment, compatible with fiber networks.

articleTitle: Temporal Hilbert transform based on an integrated frequency comb source
abstract: An experimentally demonstrated temporal Hilbert transformer based on an integrated optical frequency comb source is exploited to obtain the temporal Hilbert transform of a Gaussian pulse with a full-width half maximum duration of 0.12ns.

articleTitle: Novel pyroelectric detectors applied for precise THz power measurements
abstract: Novel pyroelectric THz detectors were calibrated traceable to SI and applied for precise THz power measurements of time-domain spectroscopy systems and an international pilot comparison.

articleTitle: Talbot interference lithography with table-top extreme ultraviolet laser
abstract: A hybrid lithography technique, Talbot interference lithography (TIL) that combines Talbot lithography (TL) and interference lithography (IL) is analyzed in this paper. In a single lithography step, the method is able to print custom defined periodic patterns that inherit the resolution limit from IL together with the flexibility of lattice design from Talbot lithography. The arbitrary shaped cells produced by the TL can be filled with fine interference patterns. In addition, TIL relaxes constrains in the mask fabrication and simultaneously expands the depth of focus, printing nanopatterns in high resolution with low NA.

articleTitle: Toward all-optical sub-cycle visible-to-infrared pulse envelope measurement via cross-correlation sonogram
abstract: We numerically characterize visible-to-infrared pulses with durations down to 2.3 fs (0.88 cycle) by cross-correlation sonogram using a 20-μm-thick BBO crystal. This method is simple, sensitive, and potentially applicable to even shorter pulses.

articleTitle: Atomic density effect on the spatial multi-mode structure of atom-generated squeezed light
abstract: We study experimentally and theoretically the role of internally-generated higher-order Laguerre-Gauss modes in measurements of squeezed vacuum produced via polarization self-rotation interaction of an ensemble of Rb atoms and a strong linearly polarized laser field.

articleTitle: Picosecond 40 mJ, 1 kHz Ho:YLF amplifier at 2 μm
abstract: A high-gain laser source, containing a Ho:YLF single-energy regenerative amplifier and two booster amplifiers are reported, delivering up to 40 mJ picosecond pulses at 2051 nm, with energy fluctuations of the 1 kHz pulse train below 0.9% rms.

articleTitle: Spurious-free dynamic range characterization of a χ2-based PPLN waveguide
abstract: We experimentally characterize the spurious-free dynamic range performance of a χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-Based PPLN waveguide by measuring the distortion on a microwave photonic link of two RF tones around 9.9GHz and characterizing the SFDR of a generated idler in a PPLN waveguide

articleTitle: Emitter-cavity coupling in hybrid silicon carbide-nanodiamond microdisk resonators
abstract: We model, fabricate and characterize hybrid silicon carbide-nanodiamond microdisk resonators on a silicon wafer. Diamond's silicon-vacancy emission couples to the whispering gallery resonances for a potential Purcell enhancement up to the modeled F = 75.

articleTitle: Emission enhancement via local symmetry distortion in lanthanide-based upconverting nanoparticles
abstract: Lanthanide-based upconverters exhibit great potential for photovoltaic and bioimaging applications but have been traditionally plagued by prohibitively low quantum efficiencies. One reason largely responsible is the parity-forbidden nature of the electronic transitions which comprise upconversion. Ionic cosubstitution is used as a means to influence and distort the local symmetry environments of emitting ions without disturbing the global structure of the host lattice. Upconversion emission intensity is shown to increase more than 2× with a modest degree of cosubstitution. This enhancement is obtained without any changes to particle size or global structure.

articleTitle: The rising of the supercontinuum
abstract: Supercontinuum sources are one of the most widely exploited technologies to emerge from the invention of photonic crystal fibers. I will review the developments in supercontinuum technology which have allowed this exploitation to take place.

articleTitle: Observation of photonic Chern insulator
abstract: We experimentally observed a photonic Chern insulator with large Chern number. Two nontrivial chiral edge states have been distinguished. By introducing two excitation probes and changing their positions, we successfully eliminate one of the modes.

articleTitle: High pulse energy, tunable repetition rate source for two-photon microscopy
abstract: Multiphoton microscopy requires balancing high peak powers for depth penetration with low average powers to prevent thermal damage. We demonstrate a wavelength-tunable source with 27 to 48 nJ pulse energy and an adjustable repetition rate.

articleTitle: Hybridization: A route to state engineering for quantum-enhanced metrology
abstract: The hybridization of distinct quantum systems has now reached the stage when we can actually engineer the properties of the composite system to be better than the individual parts. One natural application of hybridization is the generation of non-classical states, which are extremely important in emerging quantum technologies such as quantum metrology and sensing. In this presentation we consider the generation of spin squeezed states in a hybrid system composed of a superconducting circuit coupled to a spin ensemble. We show that spin squeezing can be generated by two different mechanisms: one-axis twisting and driven collective relaxation.

articleTitle: Fiber-laser-based, 80-MHz picosecond UV source generating multi-tens of milliwatt output power across 329–348 nm
abstract: We report a fiber-laser-based 80-MHz picosecond UV source, tunable across 329-348 nm, providing 115 mW at 339.9 nm, with passive power stability of ~2.9%rms (1 min) and 6.5% rms (2 hours), in high beam quality.

articleTitle: Introduction to SG-II 5 PW laser facility
abstract: Shenguang-II 5PW laser is designed to deliver a 150J 30fs laser pulse into the target chamber. In beginning of 2016, 1PW (30J/27fs) outputs have been achieved and are used for physical experiments.

articleTitle: Measuring non-commuting observables of a single photon
abstract: In this presentation we will show how we performed, for the first time, a sequential weak value evaluation of two incompatible observables on a single photon.

articleTitle: Soft lithography of 3D polymeric lasers and cavities
abstract: We demonstrate the realization of 3D photonic lasers and cavities in polymeric materials using soft lithography and characterize them experimentally. High-Q cavities and low-threshold lasers based on SU-8 and Solgel are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Study on initial process of fs laser ablation dynamics by using soft x-ray laser probe
abstract: We have developed the pump and probe interferometer and reflective imaging technique of the metal surfaces during the femto-second laser ablation by using the plasma based soft x-ray laser at the wavelength of 13.9 nm. The pumping laser used for ablation was a Ti: Sapphire laser pulse with the duration of 80 fs pulse at a central wavelength of 795 nm, and had a gaussian spatial profile. By using the x-ray imaging technique, the time resolved image of nano-scaled ablation dynamics was obtained.

articleTitle: Nonlinear parity-time-symmetric transition in finite-size synthetic photonic media
abstract: We study nonlinear finite-size parity-time symmetric optical couplers. In such systems, we predict nonlinear parity-time symmetric transition, regardless of the details of their geometry. Variety of periodic intensity patterns is formed in these couplers.

articleTitle: Optical properties of gold thin films at elevated temperatures
abstract: Temperature dependence of gold thin film optical constants is studied from room temperature to 500 <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>C for different crystallinities and thicknesses. Degradation of plasmonic properties at elevated temperatures and its effects on applications are discussed.

articleTitle: Two-photon microscopy based on fiber delivery of ultrashort laser pulses and supercontinumm generation in a photonic crystal fiber
abstract: We report on two-photon microscopy (TPM) imaging based on a coherent fiber-based supercontinuum source. The supercontinuum generation in a photonic crystal fiber induced by fiber-delivered ultrashort (~ 100 fs) laser pulses, enables high-resolution TPM fluorescence imaging in multiple spectral bands.

articleTitle: Attosecond precision multi-km laser-microwave network
abstract: A novel 4.7-km laser-microwave network continuously operating with attosecond precision over more than two days is demonstrated. This work enables clocking of future X-ray photon-science facilities now also with attosecond temporal resolution.

articleTitle: Influence of femtosecond laser parameters on metal ablation volume
abstract: Femtosecond laser ablation of stainless steel was studied. Two ablation regimes were identified. Analytical model of metal ablation volume calculation is proposed and confronted to experimental results. For desired microtexturing, the fluence and number of pulses are essential.

articleTitle: High power femtosecond all-fiber chirped pulse amplification system based on Cherenkov radiation
abstract: We report a 60-W femtosecond Yb-doped all-fiber chirped-pulse-amplification system based on Cherenkov radiation generated by Er-doped dispersion-managed mode-locked fiber laser. The pulse width after compression by chirped-volume Bragg grating is 597-fs with 5.7-MW peak power.

articleTitle: Bit flow density (BFD): An effective performance FOM for optical on-chip interconnects
abstract: Here we propose a new figure of merit for optical on-chip links and networks named “Bit Flow Density”, which is a useful evaluation index that combines latency, throughput and footprint for precise crosstalk-based on-chip network design, simulation, and network simulators.

articleTitle: Parametric four-wave mixing in strongly driven Raman molecular gas
abstract: We propose and demonstrate parametric four-wave mixing in a Raman active gas. Two lasers with a 1.7 THz frequency-difference in a strongly-driven Raman rotational-transition of D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> generate sidebands with frequency-spacing equal to the lasers frequency-difference.

articleTitle: Few photon — qubit scattering in dispersive waveguides
abstract: Dispersion in waveguides leads to atom-photon bound states in qubits embedded in waveguides. We utilize Feynman diagrams and numerical simulations to analyze one-and two-photon scattering from qubits with the aim to test different quantum information processing schemes.

articleTitle: Difference frequency generation in orientation-patterned gallium phosphide
abstract: We generate over 10 mW of broadband pulses at 7 to 10 micrometer wavelength in orientation-patterned gallium phosphide by difference frequency mixing between the fundamental and Raman-shifted component of a femtosecond Er fiber laser.

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband dispersive radiation by spatiotemporal oscillation of multimode waves
abstract: We study supercontinuum in graded-index multimode fibers. Spatiotemporal oscillations of solitons produce radiation spanning from the mid-IR to ultraviolet. Applications to ultrafast fiber sources and connections to spatiotemporal modulation and conical wave instability are discussed.

articleTitle: Optomechanical interactions in non-Hermitian photonic molecules
abstract: We investigate optomechanical interactions in non-Hermitian photonic molecules. We show that the maximum enhancement of optomechanical coupling for steady state solutions is achieved for unbalanced gain and loss profiles away from exceptional points.

articleTitle: Integrated two-color femtosecond chirped-pulse fiber amplification system at wavelengths of 1050 and 1550 nm
abstract: A synchronized and phase-coherent two-color femtosecond chirped-pulse amplification system based on Er (1550 nm) and Yb (1050 nm) fiber lasers is presented. The system is all-fiber integrated except for the final compressors.

articleTitle: Attosecond probing of nuclear vibration with frequency shift in harmonic spectrum
abstract: We report the first experimental observation of frequency shift in high order harmonic generation (HHG) from isotopic molecules H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, from which we successfully retrieve the nuclear vibrations in these isotopic molecules.

articleTitle: 3D integrated photonic technologies for future functional microsystems
abstract: This paper discusses 3D photonic integration technologies and fabrication processes towards realizing advanced functional microsystems. Their applications in computing, networking, sensing, imaging, and biomedicine will also be discussed.

articleTitle: Ultra-high capacity microstructure sensor network in a single fiber based on hybrid TDM/WDM/FDM
abstract: Based on hybrid WDM/TDM/FDM, a 3D encoded microstructure sensor network with ultra-high capacity up to 32000 is proposed. The competitive sensing performances are experimentally demonstrated in a prototype system with 64 sensors.

articleTitle: Towards attometer/Hz1/2 displacement resolution in DFB fiber laser acoustic emission sensors
abstract: A distributed feedback fiber laser is shown to achieve a displacement resolution approaching 3 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−17</sup> m/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup> up to 10 MHz (∼ 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> more sensitive than the current state-of-the-art). Detection of acoustic emission events from cracks induced in fatigued lap joints is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Cascade coherent anti-stokes Raman scattering (CARS) microscopy
abstract: We used a six wave mixing process with two beams to acquire chemical specific laser scanned confocal images. The non linear optical process is called “Cascade Coherent Anti-Stokes Raman” (CCARS).

articleTitle: Attraction optical forces inside hyperbolic metamaterials
abstract: Hyperbolic metamaterials provide a platform for a new type of optical manipulation using highly confined extraordinary modes. Here we predict and analyze optical attracting forces acting on a small particle inside a hyperbolic slab.

articleTitle: Optical phase anisotropy in layered black phosphorus
abstract: We developed an interferometric spectroscopy and imaging technique to exploit the optical phase anisotropic properties of layered black phosphorus. The optical contrast is an order of magnitude larger than that with purely intensity-based measurements.

articleTitle: 1-GHz offset-free frequency comb in the mid-infrared
abstract: We generate offset-free gigahertz frequency combs tunable from 2.75 to 3.8 μm by using PPLN waveguides for 30-dB-amplification of a supercontinuum generated in a Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> waveguide by the same Yb:CALGO-laser that pumps the OPA process.

articleTitle: Characterization of Bragg fibers by mie scattering
abstract: Mie scattering of Bragg fibers made of periodic layers of SiN<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> and SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is demonstrated. The scattering pattern is very sensitive to Bragg layers' configuration, making it attractive to characterize Bragg fibers non-invasively.

articleTitle: Unraveling exciton kinetics of electroluminescence in colloidal quantum dot LEDs
abstract: We systematically studied emission kinetics of colloidal quantum dots in active light-emitting diodes using time-correlated single photon counting and conclusively revealed the combined effect of both electric field and charging acting together in reducing the quantum efficiency during operation.

articleTitle: Optical torque in integrated silicon waveguides induced by photon spin angular momentum transfer
abstract: We experimentally measured the twisting optical torque exerted on integrated rectangular silicon waveguides, induced by the photon spin angular momentum transfer, when the polarization state evolves as the photons propagate, due to the waveguide birefringence.

articleTitle: Liquid crystal frequency tunable terahertz metamaterial absorber
abstract: Here, we theoretically and experimentally realize a terahertz (THz) perfect metamaterial absorber with an actively tunable frequency response. The structure is made of a complementary frequency selective surface (CFSS) and a metal backplane where the subwavelength space between them is filled with liquid crystal. By applying a voltage between CFSS and metal backplane a resonance frequency shifts about 4.5 GHz at 0.567 THz is obtained while the absorbance maintains at %90.

articleTitle: Topological photonic crystal in three dimensions
abstract: We discover a 3D magnetic topological photonic crystal hosting a single surface Dirac cone, protected by a crystal symmetry. Such a gapless surface state is fully robust against random disorder of any type.

articleTitle: Photoresponse of graphene-on-silicon nitride microring resonator
abstract: We report the design and fabrication of a graphene-on-silicon nitride microring resonator to achieve the optimized optical absorption. The bolometric effect in the graphene photodetector results in a responsivity of 1.31 mA/W at 1.55 μm.

articleTitle: Planar metal-GaN spiral nanowire cavities for high circular dichroism lasing action
abstract: The compact and energy-efficient planar metal-GaN spiral nanowire cavity lasing device has been demonstrated with high circularly polarized UV laser light at 364 nm and the circular dichroism performance enhanced to dissymmetry factor of +1.4.

articleTitle: Optimized cladding-pumped few-mode EDFAs for space-division multiplexed systems
abstract: We report an optimized cladding-pumped 10-modes EDFA with more than 20 dB gain, zero differential modal gain, ~4.5 dB noise figure over the C-band and below 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> BER for up to 15-spatial modes.

articleTitle: Superradiance of air plasma induced by electron recollision
abstract: We report on experimental evidence showing that the intense 391nm radiation emitted by air plasma is superradiance. Electron recollision is speculated to play an essential role in this superradiant process.

articleTitle: Experimental realization of a reflections-free compact delay line based on a photonic topological insulator
abstract: Photonic topological insulator emulating quantum spin Hall effect is employed to demonstrate the first reflections-free topologically protected delay line. Large broadband time delays of the guided edge modes are measured, compared with narrow-band non-topological ones.

articleTitle: Systematic study of Si-based Ge/Ge0.9Sn0.1/Ge photodiodes with 2.6 μm detector cutoff
abstract: A double heterostructure Ge/Ge<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.9</sup>Sn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sup>/Ge photodiode detector grown on Si was systematically characterized. Temperature-dependent device performance has been investigated. A cutoff wavelength of 2.6 μm and the peak responsivity of 0.19 A/W at 300 K were achieved.

articleTitle: Super-resolution mid-infrared imaging using photothermal microscopy
abstract: Mid-infrared photothermal heterodyne imaging (MIR-PHI) overcomes the diffraction limit of traditional MIR imaging and uses visible photodiodes as detectors. Our MIR-PHI experiment achieved high sensitivity (S/N >100), sub-diffraction limit spatial resolution and high acquisition speed. Sensitive, affordable and widely applicable, this technique is a promising imaging tool for biological systems.

articleTitle: Additional degree of freedom in interleaved junction silicon modulators against efficiency-energy conflict
abstract: This paper introduces lateral contribution into interleaved junction. Numerical analysis suggests light-carrier overlap enhancement. VπLπ and energy consumption can both surpass lateral junction performance as opposed to conventional interleaved junction suffering from efficiency-energy conflict.

articleTitle: Spectral engineering of frequency combs using deposited waveguides
abstract: Engineering of SiN waveguides for spectral tailoring of frequency combs is presented. Several dispersion designs are shown to give rise to spectra which are suitable for comb-based spectroscopy and difference frequency generation for self-referencing.

articleTitle: 15 Gb/s transmission with wide-FSR carrier injection ring modulator for Tb/s optical links
abstract: A ring modulator with 22nm free spectral range is modulated and demonstrates an open eye diagram at 15Gb/s. This enables high channel counts towards Terabit per second bandwidth for optical data links using this device architecture.

articleTitle: Cascaded downconversion interface to the telecom band for single-photon-level signals at 650 nm
abstract: We present a device for two-stage frequency conversion of a 650 nm signal to the telecom band with low excess noise and low required pump power. We observed 99% depletion for each stage.

articleTitle: Hollow-core photonic-bandgap fiber resonator for rotation sensing
abstract: Contrast and finesse of a 19-cell hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber resonator are experimentally investigated. The results show compatibility with medium to high performance rotation sensing applications, while minimizing the Kerr effect.

articleTitle: Carrier-envelope-phase- and angle-resolved photoelectron streaking measurements on W(110)
abstract: We present an extended streaking measurement scheme by additionally detecting the electron emission angle and the carrier-envelope phase of the IR laser field. This allows a more complete and detailed insight into the electron dynamics in solids and gives access to ultrafast band structure dynamics.

articleTitle: Holographic fluorescence microscopy with self-interference incoherent digital holography
abstract: We demonstrate the cellular imaging of holographic fluorescence microscopy by implementing self-interference incoherent digital holography (SIDH) apparatus. Complex holograms of three different wavelengths are acquired and post processed to generate pseudo color image of cell.

articleTitle: Lateral transfer recirculating etalon receiver for methane spectroscopy
abstract: We describe an etalon spectrometer with a novel light recirculation scheme to generate simultaneous parallel wavelength channels with no moving parts. We present results from a system to resolve the 1651 nm absorption feature of methane. We present results from a prototype and a corresponding model. We also show results from a solid, 3-mirror etalon that has >95% peak transmission and significantly better out-of-band rejection than its 2-mirror counterpart. We show application of this system to methane laser spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of attenuation-resistant higher order frozen waves
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a class of beams-known as the Frozen Waves (FWs) - which are composed of higher order Bessel beams and can maintain predetermined longitudinal intensity profiles in the presence of propagation losses. FWs can address many challenges in optical trapping and micro-manipulation.

articleTitle: In-Fiber Monomode Octave-Spanning OAM Supercontinuum
abstract: We demonstrate an octave-spanning supercontinuum generated entirely in the |L|=8 orbital angular momentum (OAM) mode of an air-core fiber. The supercontinuum shows high mode purity (>14dB) and polarization extinction >8 dB across the spectral bandwidth.

articleTitle: Detailed phase matching characterization of inter-modal four-wave mixing in a two-mode fiber
abstract: We experimentally characterize the phase matching properties of two inter-modal four-wave mixing processes in a graded index fiber guiding the LP01 and LP11 mode-groups.

articleTitle: 56-Gbps OOK transmission using silicon microring assisted Mach-Zehnder interferometer
abstract: We report a silicon microring assisted Mach-Zehnder interferometer with error free operation up to 38 Gbps. 56 Gbps transmission over 2 km standard single mode fiber at the hard-decision forward-error correction threshold is successfully achieved.

articleTitle: Measurement of exciton correlations using electrostatic lattices
abstract: We present a method for determining correlations in a gas of indirect excitons. The method involves subjecting the excitons to an electrostatic lattice. We present findings of strong correlations in systems of indirect excitons.

articleTitle: Attosecond clocking of scattering dynamics in dielectrics
abstract: We investigated the attosecond electronic collisional dynamics in a dielectric nanomaterial, which are of primary importance to fully understand the transport properties in future dielectric-electronic devices with up to petahertz switching speeds.

articleTitle: Coherent beam combining in Er3+ doped multicore fiber with 1480nm core pumping
abstract: Coherent beam combining of 7 erbium-doped cores of a multicore fiber amplifier is demonstrated. Diffractive optical element is used to spatially combine output beams. 45% combination efficiency is achieved using stochastic parallel gradient descent algorithm.

articleTitle: Dense wavelength beam combining of an external thin-film filter multi-laser cavity stabilized diode laser module
abstract: We report on kW-class dense wavelength beam combining of a diode laser module which is spectrally stabilized using a novel external multi-laser cavity architecture based on a thin-film filter as a dispersive optical element.

articleTitle: Photoemission time delays from a cu(111)-surface: Validity of macroscopic laws for probe-field effects
abstract: Photoemission delays from copper (111) are measured in an attosecond pump - infrared probe experiment. The influence of the probe pulse and the validity of the Fresnel equations on atomic length and time scales are investigated.

articleTitle: High-resolution on-chip spectrometer with a tunable micro-ring resonator filter
abstract: A high-resolution on-chip spectrometer is demonstrated with a tunable micro-ring resonator filter by exploiting the thermo-optic effect and high quality factor of micro-ring resonator. A resolution of 0.15 nm and a bandwidth of 19 nm are realized.

articleTitle: Optical sensors from electrohydrodynamic jetted polymer fiber resonators
abstract: Electrohydrodynamic jetting is used to manufacture dye-doped polymer fiber resonators. We present comb-like laser emission from different polymer/dye combinations and report the use of these structures as sensitive detection of ethanol and methanol.

articleTitle: Artificial thermodynamics with optical stochastic pumps
abstract: Particles subjected to complex optical potentials that vary in both space and time can be sub- or super-diffusive. The corresponding difference in effective temperatures allows an effective stochastic pumping of colloidal particles.

articleTitle: Intracavity Martinez compressor for simultaneous dispersion compensation and tunable spectral filtering
abstract: We demonstrate the utility of an intracavity Martinez compressor with a 71 fs normal dispersion mode-locked Yb:fiber laser. The compressor provides spectral filtering and tunable dispersion compensation from normal to anomalous with simple components.

articleTitle: 40-Ghz pulse source based on XPM-induced focusing in normally dispersive optical fibers
abstract: We experimentally investigate the design of a high-repetition rate source delivering well-separated optical pulses due to the nonlinear compression of a dual-frequency beat signal within a cavity-less normally dispersive fiber-based setup.

articleTitle: Effect of loss on slow-light-enhanced second harmonic generation in periodic nanostructures
abstract: We analyze, analytically and through nonlinear simulations, the dependence of SHG efficiency on the group index in lossy periodic structures, and find that the optimal efficiency is reached for finite values of the group index.

articleTitle: Scale-invariant nonlinear optical effects in gases
abstract: A general scaling formalism for nonlinear light-matter interactions in gases is presented and experimentally verified. The formalism enables to conveniently extrapolate nonlinear phenomena, such as filamentation or high-order harmonic generation, to new laser parameters.

articleTitle: Multi-GHz mode-locked lasers and comb-resolved spectroscopy
abstract: A femtosecond optical frequency comb with a maximum repetition frequency of 15 GHz was developed and successfully applied to comb-resolved spectroscopy, as well as the manipulation of acoustic phonons in a silica fiber.

articleTitle: Observation of conical third-harmonic emission of vortex beams via ultrashort laser pulse filamentation in air
abstract: We employ a lab-built Ti:sapphire chirped pulse amplifier to generate third-harmonic vortex beams by femtosecond pulse filamentation in air. The generated beams follow the orbital-angular-momentum conservation and phase-matching condition between the fundamental and third-harmonic waves.

articleTitle: Plasmonic metal-cored fibres
abstract: We study plasmonic metal-cored glass fibres where, upon pulsed laser excitation, the coupling between plasmonic and dielectric modes induces strong light collimation and suppression of nonlinear absorption, providing a novel platform for tunable fiberized sources and sensors.

articleTitle: On-chip Fourier transform spectrometer for chemical sensing applications
abstract: This paper reports an on-chip Fourier transform spectrometer (FTS) which exploits a tunable Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI) by taking advantage of the thermo-optic effect to achieve a high resolution of at least 40 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Entanglement swapping — when being the same is better than being different
abstract: We show that entanglement swapping can result in a state with higher concurrence than that of the input states. For pure entangled states this is most likely when the input states are of similar concurrence.

articleTitle: Optical simulation of unphysical Majorana dynamics
abstract: The charged version of Majorana particles are unphysical and due to the violation of charge conservation they can not exist. However, we experimentally emulate the dynamics of charged Majorana particles in a tailored waveguide chip.

articleTitle: Enhancement of two-photon absorption in highly emissive BODIPY dyes
abstract: Novel perfluorinated BODIPY dyes have been synthesized aiming increased nonlinear optical properties. Two-photon absorption spectroscopy shows about 4-fold enhancement of two-photon absorption cross-section in planar biphenyl-containing BODIPY dye, compared to the unsubstituted initial material.

articleTitle: Monocrystalline silicon needle formation by optical vortex illumination
abstract: Optical vortex illumination enables the creation of silicon needles with a height of ∼14 and a thickness of ∼2 μm. Silicon needle formation requires an optical vortex pulse with a pulse duration of 10∼20 ps, so as to create thermally-melted silicon with fewer heat diffusion effects.

articleTitle: SESAMs for high-power lasers
abstract: We present novel fast MOVPE-grown SESAMs with enhanced damage threshold and surface quality suitable for power-scaling of modelocked laser oscillators to enable ultrafast lasers in the kilowatt average power regime.

articleTitle: Generation and analysis of correlated pairs of photons on board a nanosatellite
abstract: We report the operation of a photon pair source on board a nanosatellite. Pair generation and polarization correlation are demonstrated in low Earth orbit: an important milestone towards compact entangled photon pair sources for future space-based quantum communication.

articleTitle: Higher order soliton breakup via implosion
abstract: We report a novel breakup scenario of ultra-short high-order solitons in optical waveguides, via formation of a shock far below subcycle level, followed by a dramatic and complete transition into a dispersive wave.

articleTitle: Dual-comb spectroscopy for solid-state physics and extension toward time-resolved measurement
abstract: Dual-comb spectroscopy was applied for characterization of complex refractive-index of a Si wafer and transient interferogram by optical excitation in an InGaAs-based saturable absorber. Full-characterization tool with wide dynamic-range in time- and frequency-domain is provided.

articleTitle: Isolated, circularly polarized, attosecond pulse generation
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate angularly and temporally isolated counter-rotating circularly polarized attosecond pulses which span from 30 to 45 eV.

articleTitle: Can sub-optical-cycle parametric waveform synthesizers be seeded by separate bulk white-light supercontinua?
abstract: We present longitudinal-phase stability measurements between separate supercontinua generated in different bulk materials. The remarkably low relative phase jitter of few attoseconds allows multiple-white-light seeding schemes for flexible and ultrabroadband optical parametric waveform synthesizers.

articleTitle: Complete Bell state measurement realized utilizing time-polarization hyperentanglment
abstract: We report deterministic measurement of time-polarization hyperentangled two-photon Bell states with common single-photon detectors. Optical fiber distributed Bell states are detected with 84-93% success, demonstrating that our method may enable superdense coding over fiber channels.

articleTitle: Is MoS2 better for spasers than graphene?
abstract: We show a circular shaped MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> spasers perform better compared with similar designs using graphene in terms of mode energy, electric filed intensity and operating thresholds.

articleTitle: Integrated chip-scale wavemeter with 300 MHz free spectral range
abstract: We designed, fabricated and characterized an integrated chip-scale wavemeter based on an unbalanced Mach-Zehnder interferometer with 300 MHz free spectral range using low-loss Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> platform. We also integrated an optical hybrid to provide phase information.

articleTitle: Recent advances of mid–infrared compact, field deployable sensors and their real world applications in the petrochemical industry, atmospheric chemistry and security
abstract: Development of trace gas sensors based on mid-infrared interband cascade lasers and quantum cascade lasers as well as their applications will be reported. The sensor technology will use both laser absorption and quartz enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Low-loss subwavelength grating waveguide bends based on index engineering
abstract: We report the design, simulation and experimental demonstration of low loss subwavelength grating waveguide (SWG) bends. With trapezoidal shape silicon pillars, the average insertion loss of a 5μm SWG waveguide bend is reduced drastically from 5.43 dB to 1.10 dB per 90° bend for quasi-TE polarization.

articleTitle: Electrical excitation of plasmons in graphene through the 2D Čerenkov effect
abstract: We show that charge carriers flowing inside graphene can emit graphene plasmons (GPs) through a 2D Čerenkov effect (ČE), providing a highly efficient, tunable, and ultrafast conversion mechanism from electrical signal to plasmonic excitation.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact broadband dielectric antenna
abstract: We demonstrate an ultra-compact silicon on insulator antenna with 3.2μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> footprint and broadside radiation from 1470nm to 1550nm for applications in fiber-to-chip coupling and phased arrays.

articleTitle: MBE-grown Cr:ZnS thin film laser media
abstract: We report results of spectroscopic analysis of the first laser-quality MBE-grown Cr:ZnS films. Comparison of spectral-luminescent properties with bulk Cr:ZnS indicates their good laser properties, opening the way towards industrial mid-IR thin-disk and waveguide lasers.

articleTitle: High power mid-infrared laser sources
abstract: We discuss high power mid-infrared laser sources based on frequency conversion of solid-state lasers operating in the 2-micron spectral region. These lasers are shifted to the mid-infrared via optical parametric oscillation in ZGP and OPGaAs.

articleTitle: Orbital angular momentum mode multiplexer based on multimode micro-ring resonator with angular gratings
abstract: We demonstrate silicon photonic orbital angular momentum multiplexing devices based on mulitmode microring resonator. Up to four optical beams carrying different orbital angular momentum states can be selectively excited from different input ports.

articleTitle: Generation of sub-50 FS pulses with >1.5 MW of peak power from a diode-pumped Yb:CALGO laser oscillator
abstract: A sub-50-fs diode-pumped Yb:CALGO laser oscillator was demonstrated. The highest peak power achieved for 48-fs pulses directly from the oscillator was 1.6 MW. The shortest generated pulses were 40-fs with 177 kW of peak power.

articleTitle: Ultra-low power signal depletion via four-wave mixing Bragg scattering in hydrogenated amorphous silicon waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate 7 dB signal depletion in a hydrogenated amorphous silicon waveguide via four-wave mixing Bragg scattering with only 280 μW total pump power in the waveguide. The bandwidth is larger than 4 nm.

articleTitle: Table-top megahertz XUV source driven by high-power modelocked thin-disk laser
abstract: We demonstrate high harmonic generation at 2.4 MHz from the compressed output of a thin-disk oscillator, obtaining >5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> photons/s (19<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> harmonic). Additionally, we investigate phase matching conditions towards higher XUV photon flux.

articleTitle: Guiding and coupling light through nonlinear plasmonic nanosuspensions
abstract: We demonstrate guiding of a strong infrared beam by a weak visible beam due to plasmonic-resonant soliton formation. Master/slave-type coupling is also observed by tuning the relative strength of two opposite polarizabilities in core-shell nanosuspensions.

articleTitle: Absolute distance measurement method with optical frequency comb interferometer based on balanced optical cross correlator and optical heterodyne technique
abstract: Optical frequency comb interferometer based on balanced optical cross correlation and optical heterodyne techniques have been demonstrated. The method can be used to determine absolute distance with coherent link between pulse envelope and interferometric phase.

articleTitle: Z-scan characterization of two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenide few-layer sheets
abstract: The Z-scan technique was applied to investigate the nonlinear absorption and refraction in few layer sheets of 2D transition metal dichalcogenide: WS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and Mo<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</inf>W<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, which showed nonlinear saturable absorption and two photon absorption.

articleTitle: Bio-inspired, nanostructured anti-reflective surfaces for laser applications
abstract: Here we show the use of nanostructured fused silica substrates with well-controlled geometry and refractive index profiles to provide ultra-low reflectance (0.015%) and nearly perfect transmittance (99.9%) per side over a broad range of wavelengths. Anti-reflective surfaces using such nanostructures will allow the design of more durable and powerful laser systems.

articleTitle: Soliton molecules in a 2-μm thulium-doped fiber laser
abstract: We report on experimental observation of out-of-phase stable soliton molecules at 2-μm in an all-fiber ultrafast thulium-doped laser based on nonlinear polarization rotation technique.

articleTitle: Spontaneous photonic super-crystals in composite ferroelectrics
abstract: We report the spontaneous formation of a volume cubic grating in ferroelectric KLTN. Diffraction indicates a 3D linear, electro-optic, and nonlinear structure with lattice constant 10000 times larger than the underlying perovskite lattice.

articleTitle: CMOS-compatible silicon-rich nitride waveguides for ultrafast nonlinear signal processing
abstract: We report on the linear and nonlinear characterization of PECVD Si-rich-nitride-waveguides. We show that the nonlinear properties can be enhanced by one order of magnitude with respect to standard Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> in the 1550-nm-region without suffering two-photon-absorption.

articleTitle: Record single mode laser diode packing density using high uniformity lithographic VCSEL arrays with narrow spectral width
abstract: Single mode lithographic VCSELs are shown to be capable of unprecedented dense packing into arrays for high pulse power to improve spectral control and beam quality.

articleTitle: Nonlinear microscopy of nano-objects using excitation beam profiles with engineered phase jumps
abstract: We introduce nonlinear microscopy with phase-engineered incident beams. By controlling the phase across an incident Hermite-Gaussian HG<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> beam, we vary the longitudinal electric field component at focus, allowing tailoring of second-harmonic generation from vertically-oriented nanowires.

articleTitle: Rb-stabilized compact optical frequency comb acting as a versatile wavelength reference
abstract: An optical frequency comb spanning over 1540 nm to 1580 nm is generated from a Rb-stabilized frequency-doubled 1560-nm DFB laser. Frequency stability and accuracy as well as noise properties of the laser system are presented.

articleTitle: Enhancement of optical absorption in ‘photonic graphene’
abstract: The enhancement in absorption of photonic graphene structure is reported in this article: it can be enhanced about four times (40%) compared to a reference absorption (9.8%) at certain wavelengths by adding defects and mirrors.

articleTitle: High peak power Erbium-Ytterbium single frequency pulsed fiber amplifier using a compressive strain gradient
abstract: We report on a 385W peak power single-mode single-frequency pulsed fiber amplifier using a compressive strain gradient reaching 24% optical-optical efficiency. This is the highest combination of peak power and efficiency for such an amplifier.

articleTitle: Tunable SESAM mode-locked Tm fiber laser based on chromatic dispersion of lens
abstract: We report tunable SESAM mode-locking of a Tm fiber laser facilitated by chromatic dispersion of a lens. A tuning range of 1890-1940 nm with the maximum average power of 196mW, spectral bandwidth of 18.9 nm, and the repetition rate of 20.5 MHz was obtained.

articleTitle: Dynamic evolution of a two-dimensional electron gas in a magnetic field after optical photoexcitation
abstract: We used optical-pump, terahertz-probe spectroscopy to track carrier dynamics in a two-dimensional electron gas under a magnetic field, revealing photoinduced changes to the cyclotron frequency and scattering time, along with an unexpected higher frequency mode.

articleTitle: Investigation of an integrated photonic dual-pumped phase-sensitive amplifier based on a highly saturated semiconductor optical amplifier
abstract: An integrated photonic phase-sensitive amplifier with a dual-pumped four-wave mixing architecture is investigated. Gain curves with multiple periods are theoretically studied and experimentally demonstrated with approximately 7.8 dB extinction gain.

articleTitle: Observation of Turing and Faraday instabilities in a bistable passive resonator
abstract: We experimentally study the occurrence of instabilities in a dispersion oscillating fiber ring cavity. This dispersion profile allows the interplay between the well-known Turing and Faraday instabilities, dramatically affecting the dynamics of the system.

articleTitle: Plasmonic organic hybrid Bragg grating modulator
abstract: A novel ultrafast, compact (1.5 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) sub-fJ/bit electro-optical modulator based on an organic plasmonic Bragg waveguide is proposed. Simulations show extinction ratios of 10 dB with insertion losses of 2.6 dB for a peak voltage of 1.4 V.

articleTitle: Power scaling of single-frequency fiber amplifiers at 976 nm
abstract: Cladding pumped single-frequency Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped fiber amplifiers at 976 nm were investigated. Over 4 W output power was obtained and further power scaling can be achieved by reducing the cladding diameter of the Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped fiber.

articleTitle: Petahertz frequency operation with gallium nitride semiconductor
abstract: We demonstrate optical drive with 1.16-PHz frequency using gallium nitride (GaN) wide-bandgap semiconductor. An isolated attosecond pulse with coherent broadband spectrum reveals dipole oscillation with 860-as periodicity in the GaN electron and hole system.

articleTitle: Synchronous mode-locked laser network with sub-fs jitter and multi-km distance
abstract: We report a synchronous multi-color mode-locked laser network over 4.7-km distance. Output of two remotely synchronized lasers shows only 0.6-fs RMS drift over 40 hours reaching 20<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> decimal uncertainty in less than 10000-s averaging time.

articleTitle: Chip-packaged silicon photonic nanoscale thermometers
abstract: We report on the development of on-chip integrated packaged nanoscale silicon photonic temperature sensors capable of detecting temperature differences as small as 70 μK, thus showing the potential to replace legacy resistance thermometers.

articleTitle: 1300 nm fiber laser system for THG and 2PEF bio-imaging
abstract: We present a 1300 nm fiber laser source for bio-imaging applications. We demonstrate nonlinear imaging using nanocrystals as optical markers for THG microscopy and efficient 2-photon-excitation of fluorophores at 1300 nm in biological samples.

articleTitle: 1THz span optical frequency comb using VCSELs and off the Shelf expansion techniques
abstract: We show, to our knowledge, the broadest VCSEL-based optical comb with 1THz span (20 dB), 193 teeth, obtained by cascading two expansion stages, one with Electro-Optic Modulators and the second based on High Non-Linear Fibers.

articleTitle: The suppression of chromatic dispersion fluctuation in chalcogenide hybrid microstructured optical fibers and their parametric amplification performance
abstract: New chalcogenide hybrid microstructured optical fibers with second cladding layers were proposed to suppress the fluctuation of near-zero and flattened chromatic dispersion and the fluctuation of broad FOPA gain spectra caused by the fiber structure fluctuation.

articleTitle: Photon Management using index-near-zero materials
abstract: Index-near-zero materials can strongly enhance light-matter interactions. The performance of light trapping greatly exceeds the conventional Yablonovitch limit. Moreover, Index-near-zero materials suppress radiative recombination, resulting in enhanced open circuit voltage in direct bandgap solar cells.

articleTitle: Multimode optomechanics and electrostatic control in slot-mode optomechanical crystals
abstract: We demonstrate a flexible slot-mode architecture for cavity optomechanics that supports mechanical frequencies between 400 MHz and 3.5 GHz, multimode operation coupling multiple optical and mechanical resonances, and an electrostatic actuation scheme for wavelength tuning/stabilization.

articleTitle: Phase mask-based multimodal superresolution microscopy
abstract: We demonstrate a multimodal superresolution microscopy technique based on phase masked excitation and spatially filtered detection. We acquire two-photon fluorescent lifetime and second harmonic images of fluorophores mixed with gold particles with 100 nm resolution.

articleTitle: Effective symbol-amplitude scaling scheme in DD-OFDM transmitter with 4.3-dB receiver-sensitivity improvement
abstract: A simple and effective scheme of symbol-amplitude scaling is proposed and experimentally demonstrated to significantly improve OFDM transmitter performance. Up to 4.3-dB sensitivity improvement is achieved for OFDM QPSK signal in a LR-PON scenario.

articleTitle: Compact, real-time analyzer for C-13 and O-18 isotope ratios of carbon dioxide in breath air
abstract: Breath air analysis provides a non-invasive alternative to traditional diagnosis methods in numerous clinical applications. Mid-infrared optical technology allows for fast datarates and sample bag - free analysis, with compact instrumentation.

articleTitle: Polarization maintaining mode selective coupler
abstract: A polarization selective weakly-fused fiber coupler composed of a few mode fiber and a single mode fiber is demonstrated with high efficiency higher than 90%. The coupler profile optimization has allowed to remove polarization and spatial degeneracy in the first and second high order mode.

articleTitle: Nanoplasmonics: Exploring nonlocal and quantum effects
abstract: Plasmonics is commonly understood within classical electrodynamics with local-response constitutive relations. However, possibilities for nonlocal dynamics and quantum effects emerge with strong spatial confinement in plasmonic nanostructures. This talks reviews recent theory and experiments developments.

articleTitle: Tunable on chip optofluidic laser
abstract: On chip tunable laser is demonstrated by realizing a microfluidic droplet array. The periodicity is controlled by the pressure applied to two separate inlets, allowing to tune the lasing frequency over a broad spectral range.
