abstract: A phase-gradient metasurface layer composed of refractory plasmonic zirconium nitride nanoantenna array has been developed for demonstration of photonic Spin Hall Effect which shows similar high efficiency as previously reported gold SHE design.

articleTitle: Microcavity-stabilized quantum cascade laser
abstract: A CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> whispering gallery mode microresonator is used for frequency stabilization and linewidth narrowing of a mid-IR quantum cascade laser. Sub-Doppler recording of a CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> transition demonstrates the suitability of the system for high-resolution spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Adiabatic control of solids by strong ultrafast optical fields
abstract: We present latest developments in theory and recent experimental results for a new class of phenomena in condensed matter optics when a strong optical field ~1-3 V/Å reversibly changes the solid within an optical cycle. During a single-oscillation of a strong optical pulse, a dielectric undergoes a reversible transition to a semimetallic state, which follows the instantaneous optical field during time intervals on order of hundred attoseconds. Such a pulse drives ampere-scale currents in dielectrics and controls their properties, including optical absorption and reflection, extreme UV absorption, and generation of high harmonics in a non-perturbative manner on a 100-as temporal scale. Applied to a metal, such a pulse causes an instantaneous and reversible loss of the metallic properties. We will also discuss or latest theoretical results on graphene and silicene, semimetals, in a strong ultrashort pulse field revealing their unique behavior. These are fastest phenomena in optics unfolding within half period of light.

articleTitle: High-energy femtosecond hydrogen Raman laser
abstract: High-energy pulses at 1.28 μm are demonstrated by stimulated Raman scattering using two chirped pulses of a Ti:Sapphire laser in hydrogen. The Stokes pulse carrying record-high energy of 4.4 mJ is recompressed to 80 fs.

articleTitle: Additive manufacturing for optical network components
abstract: Additive manufacturing has set out to change the world of manufacturing, and is also addressing the space of optical network components. Developments for industrialization of two-photon absorption processing will be displayed targeting current prototyping of test structures and future options for volume manufacturing of optical components and network technology.

articleTitle: Simple and precise measurement of dynamic displacement for more-than-10-MHz vibration
abstract: We demonstrate a simple and precise measurement system of dynamic displacement for more-than-10-MHz high-frequency vibration. An interferometer using high-frequency phase modulation and simple data processing achieved a small error of better than 0.7 nm.

articleTitle: Breaking the temporal resolution limit by superoscillating optical beats
abstract: We experimentally break the temporal Fourier-transform resolution limit by generating a super-oscillating optical beat signal. This result opens the way to greatly improve the temporal resolution in applications using ultra-short optical pulses.

articleTitle: Thin disk pumped 1 kHz broadband OPCPA system with 8 mJ output
abstract: We present a multistage 1 kHz OPCPA system, pumped by two frequency doubled thin disk regenerative amplifiers, delivering together 57 mJ at 515 nm. The OPCPA produces 8 mJ of amplified signal and is compressible to <; 27 fs.

articleTitle: A new theoretical approach to cascaded stimulated Brillouin scattering
abstract: We present a novel approach to cascaded stimulated Brillouin scattering in which the multitude of interacting optical fields are described by a single forward and single backward propagating wave at a single carrier frequency.

articleTitle: Controlling the polarization state of light with metasurfaces via the excitation of plane-wave and focused electron beam
abstract: We demonstrate the general mechanism to construct the dispersion-free metastructure. By designing the parameters of a metallic metamaterial and a dielectric interlayer, the thickness-dependent dispersion of the dielectric spacing layer cancels out the intrinsic dispersion of the metallic structure.

articleTitle: Carrier-envelope offset frequency stabilization in a femtosecond optical parametric oscillator without nonlinear interferometry
abstract: The carrier-envelope offset frequency of signal pulses in a femtosecond optical parametric oscillator was stabilized with a position-sensitive photodiode. The technique is easily implemented, requires no nonlinear interferometry and has a wide capture range.

articleTitle: Femtosecond nonlinear response of bulk plasmons in a highly doped semiconductor
abstract: Using midinfrared 2-color pump-probe spectroscopy we study longitudinal bulk plasmons in ZnO. The plasmon resonance undergoes a strong red-shift upon intraband excitation of electrons caused by an enhanced mass in the hot plasma.

articleTitle: Broadband characterization of ZBLAN fiber for short-wave infrared applications using all-fiber interferometer
abstract: Group-velocity dispersion, third-order dispersion and propagation losses of 14m normal dispersion ZBLAN fiber are directly and continuously measured over 1500-2100nm range using all-fiber Mach-Zehnder interferometer. The fiber is then used for dispersion compensation at 2μm.

articleTitle: A hybrid Si/InP single mode laser with the periodic micro-structure on InP ridge waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate a hybrid Si/InP laser with micro-structure on the InP waveguide. The laser power output from silicon waveguide is 1.13 mW, and the threshold is 57 mA at room temperature and continuous wave operation.

articleTitle: Terahertz meta-atom quantum well photodetectors
abstract: We demonstrate single-pixel and 2D arrays of THz quantum-well photodetectors featuring extremely sub-wavelength, antenna-coupled resonators. Few-micron sized devices show photodetection in the 100–200 μm range, with a consequent dramatic reduction in the device dark current.

articleTitle: Optomechanical oscillators fabricated in a CMOS-compatible foundry
abstract: We demonstrate self-sustained mechanical oscillations at room temperature and ambient pressure in a silicon photonic crystal slot-cavity fabricated by a CMOS-Foundry. Optical quality factor as high as Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">opt</sub> = 4 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> and an optomechanical coupling rate of g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>/2π = 76 kHz are observed.

articleTitle: Self-synchronization and phase steps in microresonator-based optical frequency combs
abstract: We introduce a new nonlinear oscillator model governing the spontaneous creation of ultrashort pulses in Kerr-nonlinear parametric oscillators. This model explains the π and π/2 steps in our phase spectrum measurements of microresonator-based frequency combs.

articleTitle: Non-scanning three-dimensional imaging using spectral interferometry with chirped frequency comb
abstract: One-shot 3D imaging-method with a chirped frequency comb was demonstrated using 2D pulse-to-pulse spectral interferometry. A step-height was measured with 6.1-μm-uncertainty, currently limited by the detection system. The method has large dynamic-range with high precision.

articleTitle: Monolithic semiconductor entangled sources spanning the S-C-L bands
abstract: We demonstrate direct generation of wavelength-multiplexed polarization entangled photons from a single chip. The concurrence of 0.98±0.01, and bandwidth spanning S-C-L bands are the highest reported in waveguide sources, setting new records for monolithic quantum technologies.

articleTitle: Transient nonlinear refraction measurements of titanium nitride thin films
abstract: Using the highly sensitive optical beam deflection method, the transient nonlinear refraction of thin film titanium nitride is measured. The results show a large negative instantaneous nonlinearity, followed by a long lived positive decay.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of 7-fold Multicasting of a 20-Gbaud QPSK signal using Kerr frequency combs
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 7-fold multicasting of 20-Gbaud QPSK signals based on Kerr frequency combs generated in a silicon nitride microresonator. The effect of high phase-noise comb state on the multicasting performance has also been studied.

articleTitle: 2D electronic stark spectroscopy
abstract: We describe a novel nonlinear spectroscopy method that combines the high sensitivity of background-free heterodyne-detected 2D electronic spectroscopy with Stark spectroscopy for observation of ultrafast charge-transfer kinetics. We demonstrate the method on the photosystem II reaction center.

articleTitle: Highly regular nanostructuring of Si surface by ultrashort laser pulses
abstract: Sub-MHz repetition rate femtosecond laser pulses produce extremely regular periodic surface structures on silicon surface due to competition between ultrafast heating and electron-emission. They allow manufacturing of novel devices for solar, optoelectronic, and biomedical applications.

articleTitle: An all-silicon passive six-port circuit of all-optical ordered-route transmission
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a six-port passive circuit supporting all-optical ordered-route transmission using thermo-optic effect. The 15-dB bandwidth (BW) is larger than 0.05 nm and the maximum blocking extinction ratio (BER) is 39 dB.

articleTitle: Tunable THz metamaterial and plasmonic devices based on graphene
abstract: Two approaches for constructing terahertz reconfigurable devices, namely: (i) graphene-only plasmonic structures, and (ii) graphene-metal hybrid metamaterials, are analyzed and compared from the perspectives of: quality factor, extinction-ratio, unit cell dimensions, and tunability range.

articleTitle: Monitoring of atmospheric methane and ethane using two continuous-wave interband cascade lasers
abstract: A sensor system for simultaneous detection and monitoring of ppb concentration levels of methane and ethane using two interband cascaded lasers was developed. Long-term monitoring of these two atmospheric gases was performed in the Greater Houston area.

articleTitle: Interferometric activation of quantum dephasing channels
abstract: We report an optical phenomenon that allows perfect quantum communication through a pair of dephasing channels each with zero quantum capacity. Our results are useful for enriching the structure of the quantum communication theory.

articleTitle: Generation of second harmonic beams with switchable caustic trajectories
abstract: We demonstrate theoretically and experimentally the generation of second harmonic beams with arbitrary convex caustic trajectories. Different trajectories can be selected using the same nonlinear crystal by varying the crystal temperature or the pump wavelength.

articleTitle: S2 measurement of higher order mode content in low loss hypocycloid Kagomé hollow core photonic crystal fiber
abstract: We present the first detailed investigation of modal properties in hypocycloid Kagomé fibers; even with an optimized input launch, higher order modes propagate over long fiber lengths, indicative that these modes have low attenuation.

articleTitle: A setup for extreme-ultraviolet ultrafast angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy at 50-kHz repetition rate
abstract: We demonstrate a novel table-top trARPES setup that combines a bright 50-kHz source of narrowband, extreme ultraviolet (XUV) pulses at 22.3 eV with UHV photoemission instrumentation, enabling sensitive access to dynamics over a large momentum space.

articleTitle: High-energy, high-efficiency, and high-repetition-rate OPCPA at 1.7 μm
abstract: A 3 mJ, two-cycle (11.4 fs), 1 kHz, carrier-envelope phase (CEP)-stable laser at 1.7 μm is developed via a three-stage optical parametric chirped-pulse amplifier (OPCPA) in BiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>. This is an ideal driver for generating isolated attosecond pulses in the soft x-ray region.

articleTitle: Laser-patterned array with aerosol-jet printing quantum-dots for novel white light source
abstract: Through the laser-ablation and aerosol-jet printing techniques, a novel photoluminescent quantum-dots device with microscale patterns has been demonstrated as a white-light emitting source with stable emission at different driving currents and larger color productivity domain.

articleTitle: Laser induced in-fiber capillary instabilities for precise and scalable microsphere fabrication
abstract: We demonstrate an in-fiber microsphere fabrication method with great precision and controllability based on laser-induced thermal effect. The smallest amplification ratio of 3.88 between the microsphere and the fiber core is achieved experimentally.

articleTitle: Generation and application of five phase-locked harmonics in the continuous wave regime
abstract: We report generation of five phase-locked harmonics with an exact integer frequency-ratio of 1:2:3:4:5 in the continuous-wave regime by implementing a divide-by-three optical-frequency division technology in the harmonic generation process.

articleTitle: Anomalous dispersion in 300 nm-thick Si3N4 concentric-ring-resonators
abstract: We present a mode coupling scheme to achieve anomalous dispersion with concentric-ring-resonators, and demonstrate broadband anomalous dispersion with a peak value of 2700 ps/nm/km in a 300 nm-thick Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> platform in the near infrared.

articleTitle: Demonstration of multiplexing and transmission of QPSK-to-16QAM channels over 100 km using wave mixing for aggregation and noise mitigation
abstract: We demonstrate an optical multiplexing and transmission of QPSK-to-16QAM channels over 100 km using wave mixing for aggregation and noise mitigation. For the input signals with phase noise of ∼50, 35 degree and 300 MHz noise bandwidth, the OSNR penalty of ∼1dB is obtained at BER 10–<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> for aggregated 20 Gbaud 16QAM signal compared to the case of having no phase noise in input signals.

articleTitle: A solid-state source of subcycle pulses in the mid-infrared
abstract: We have demonstrated an approach for the generation of 20-fs-pulses at 6.8 μm. Subcycle pulse widths have been achieved due to self-compression dynamics and ultrabroadband phase matching for FWM near the zero-GVD wavelength of GaAs.

articleTitle: Enhanced UV upconversion emission using plasmonic nanocavities
abstract: Strongly enhanced upconversion emission is experimentally demonstrated from an ensemble of β-NaYF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>:Gd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>/Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>/Tm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> @NaLuF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> core-shell nanoparticles trapped in judiciously designed plasmonic nanocavities. Using cross-shape silver nanocavities, 170-fold enhancement is obtained at UV band around 345 nm.

articleTitle: Observation of flat-band image transmission in optically induced Lieb photonic lattices
abstract: We demonstrate distortion-free flat-band image transmission in Lieb photonic lattices. Such lattices are established by a simple yet effective optical induction technique using two incoherently overlapping light patterns rather than the femtosecond laser-writing technique.

articleTitle: Surface nanoscale axial photonics (SNAP) structures introduced with a femtosecond laser
abstract: Surface nanoscale axial photonics (SNAP) structures are created with a femtosecond laser inscription for the first time. A micron-thin inscription, introduced along the fiber axis, is characterized by the measured subnanometer-small effective fiber radius variation.

articleTitle: Ultrafast conductivity study of Dirac surface states via THz pump and THz probe spectroscopy
abstract: Intense THz excitation in topological insulator Bi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> induces negative low-frequency conductivity and energy-dependent relaxation dynamics, different from high-energy pumping, which allows us to isolate intrinsic quasi-particle scattering dynamics inside the surface states.

articleTitle: Hybrid CMOS-compatible material and device platform for integrated nanophotonics
abstract: In this talk, the recent achievements in the development and optimization of hybrid multilayer CMOS-compatible material systems (e.g., SiN/Si, multi-layer Si/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, etc.) to address all the practical requirements of ultra-fast and ultra-compact integrated photonic structures will be discussed. Using these hybrid material systems, a series of ultracompact and high-performance reconfigurable photonic devices and subsystems that are formed by using high Q resonators will be demonstrated. The use of these devices and subsystems for realization of densely-integrated reconfigurable photonic chips for signal processing and sensing applications will be discussed.

articleTitle: On-chip high performance plasmonic-CMOS components based on horizontal hybrid Cu-SiO2-Si platform
abstract: The on-chip high performance plasmonic-CMOS waveguide based on hybrid Cu-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-Si platform operating at TE-mode is reported with the propagation loss ~0.5 dB/μm at the telecom wavelength. As an example, the ultracompact waveguide bend radius of 10 nm is achieved with ~0.1 dB/turn propagation loss and subsequently the sub-μm ring resonator filter of a radius of 0.2 μm is demonstrated with the excellent extinction ratio ~27 dB and insertion losses ~1 dB. This work will be useful to develop novel small footprint nanoscale electronic-photonic integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of Inviscid Burgers' equation dynamics in nonlinear fiber optics
abstract: We report on the experimental observation of inviscid Burgers' equation dynamics, obtained when a properly tailored pulse propagates in an optical fiber. Experimental results show controllable pulse steepening and shock formation in excellent agreement with theory.

articleTitle: Probing the scattering characteristics of supersymmetric photonic structures
abstract: We present an experimental approach for interrogating the reflection-transmission behaviour of supersymmetric photonic arrangements. In doing so, we enable a comprehensive method for the full characterization of the optical properties of synthetic SUSY-based systems.

articleTitle: Broadband silica-based thulium doped fiber amplifier employing dual-wavelength pumping
abstract: We report a broadband and gain-flattened silica-based thulium-doped fiber amplifier with dual-wavelength pumping (790 nm+ 1600 nm). 15dB gain bandwidth is more than 220 nm ranging from 1700 to 1920 nm with a maximum gain of 29dB and a noise figure of less than 5dB.

articleTitle: Toward unifying chemical function with molecular structure using strong fields, x-rays, and electrons
abstract: Strong field molecular control can be used as a correlation parameter, allowing one to combine free electron laser based x-ray spectroscopy together with ultrafast electron diffraction. We will discuss this also in the light of emerging non-linear x-ray techniques.

articleTitle: 3D integrated silicon photonic external cavity laser
abstract: A 3D integrated hybrid silicon photonic external cavity laser was realized experimentally. Continuous wave lasing was demonstrated with a side mode suppression ratio of 30 dB and optical output power up to 1.4 mW.

articleTitle: All fiber broadband mode converter based on semicircular-distribution long period fiber gratings
abstract: All fiber broadband mode converter based on semicircular-distribution long period fiber gratings is proposed. Simulation results show that the mode conversion efficiency from LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> mode to LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> mode is more than 85% over wavelength range of 200nm.

articleTitle: A temperature insensitive load sensor based on a dual loop optoelectronic oscillator
abstract: A temperature insensitive load sensor based on a dual loop optoelectronic oscillator is proposed. The two loops, with one subjected to a load, have different oscillation frequencies but same temperature sensitivity so that load sensing can be achieved by interrogating their mixing frequency.

articleTitle: Characterization of the nonlinear susceptibility of monolayer MoS2 using second- and third-harmonic generation microscopy
abstract: Second- and third-harmonic generation microscopy of monolayer MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is reported for imaging and characterization of the material's nonlinearity. A telecommunication wavelength pump is used, revealing the material's promise for use in nonlinear optical devices.

articleTitle: Phase-sensitive amplification in silicon and chalcogenide waveguides
abstract: We review the progress in integrated phase-sensitive amplification (PSA) in Kerr media and present our results in silicon and chalcogenide waveguides.

articleTitle: Playing a metamaterial guitar with light: Optically addressable nanomechanical metamaterial
abstract: Optical signals actuating unique elements of a nanostructure at their eigenfrequencies are used to modulate metasurface properties with sub-wavelength spatial resolution thus creating a randomly addressable metamaterial that acts as all-optical spatial light modulator.

articleTitle: Optical characterization of van der Waals materials via near-field microscopy
abstract: We demonstrate a novel characterization method of van-der-Waals' materials by performing near-field-microscopy of hexagonal-boron-nitride thin films on single-crystal silver. Beyond determining dispersion of optical modes, this technique also enables the direct study of light-matter interactions.

articleTitle: Injection locking of high-β quantum dot microlasers
abstract: We experimentally and theoretically investigate injection locking of high-β microlasers and show simultaneous stationary oscillation synchronized to the external signal and at the solitary frequency, where their macroscopic counterparts exhibit perfect synchronization or chaotic dynamics.

articleTitle: A multi-core fiber to single-mode fiber side-polished coupler
abstract: Evanescent coupling between a side-polished multi-core fiber and a single-mode fiber is demonstrated for the first time. The low-loss tap coupler is capable of isolating the output from a single core of a 7-core fiber.

articleTitle: Highly efficient hybrid quantum dot white light emitting diodes with prolonged lifetime
abstract: A white LED is demonstrated by incorporating three kinds of colloidal quantum dots and sodium chloride. Further lifetest shows great stability up to 146 hours under 203.4 mW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of blue pump power.

articleTitle: Microfiber-based few-layer black phosphorus quantum dots saturable absorber for mode-locked fiber laser
abstract: We demonstrate an erbium-doped fiber laser mode-locked by using a microfiber-based black phosphorus quantum dots saturable absorber. The generated pulses demonstrate the operation of this material in the near infrared region.

articleTitle: Adaptive selection of illumination based on 3D Fourier ptychography
abstract: Based on 3D Fourier ptychography imaging technique, adaptive selection of illumination utilizing the relationship between Fourier spectrum and illumination angle is proposed. The method reduces almost 50% computational work and accelerates the imaging reconstruction without loss of image quality.

articleTitle: Room-temperature mid-infrared photodetector via hybrid graphene nanoribbon-C60 phototransistor
abstract: We demonstrated that depositing C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</sup> film on graphene nanoribbons greatly enhance the electron trapping efficiency. As a result, the graphene nanoribbon photodetectors with C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</inf> layer exhibits high responsivity of ∼0.4 A/W under infrared laser (10 μm) illumination at room temperature.

articleTitle: On-chip UV dispersive wave generation
abstract: UV dispersive wave generation is demonstrated using a silica ridge waveguide. The short wavelength edge of the spectrum reaches 320 nm and the phase matching condition can be engineered to tune the emission from 320-580 nm.

articleTitle: Buried extraordinary optical transmission
abstract: Metallic films with subwavelength apertures integrated into a semiconductor exhibit broadband enhancement of light coupling into the semiconductor (compared to an unstructured surface) while providing near uniform electrical contact for potential integration into optoelectronic devices.

articleTitle: A strip-slot direct mode coupler
abstract: We investigate the direct butt coupling between slot and strip waveguides. Contrary to popular belief, the apparent mode mismatch does not deteriorate conversion efficiency. The direct coupler shows 95% conversion efficiency with a broad bandwidth.

articleTitle: Weak measurements compressed sensing quantum state tomography
abstract: We show that prior knowledge that a quantum state is close to a pure state enables a direct and efficient measurement of the density matrix representing the state, using the weak measurements methodology.

articleTitle: Generation of 100-GHz radiation in lithium niobate driven by 4.7-ps, 22-mJ, 1030-nm Yb:YAG laser pulses
abstract: A cryogenically cooled Yb:YAG amplifier with 4.7-ps laser pulses is employed to generate 100-GHz pulses in lithium niobate via optical rectification. We obtained a high efficiency ~0.05% at 300 K, close to the theoretical prediction.

articleTitle: Lab-on-a-chip Raman sensors outperforming Raman microscopes
abstract: We demonstrate that the signal-to-noise ratio and signal collection efficiency in evanescent waveguide-based Raman spectroscopy exceeds that in Raman microscopes. We investigate the effect of silicon-nitride waveguide geometry to further improve the performance.

articleTitle: Photonic realization of topologically protected bound states in domain-wall waveguide arrays
abstract: We present an analytical theory of 2D topologically protected guided photonic modes for continuous periodic dielectric structures, modulated by a domain wall. We then numerically corroborate the applicability of this theory for 3D structures.

articleTitle: Modelling superconducting nanowire single photon detectors in a waveguide-based resonator
abstract: We present the analysis of a single photon detector system capable of achieving near-unity detection efficiency. It consist of waveguide-coupled superconducting nanowires as short as 1 μm embedded in a racetrack resonator.

articleTitle: Advanced microwave photonic structure for low coherence interferometry
abstract: A novel technique for low coherence interferometry by using Microwave Photonics technology is experimentally proved. Considerable improvements on key LCI parameters as penetration depth, axial resolution and sensitivity along the measurement range are achieved.

articleTitle: Numerical modeling of amplitude-to-phase conversion in modified uni-traveling carrier (MUTC) photodetector
abstract: We calculate the amplitude-to-phase noise conversion in a MUTC photodetector. We obtained two nulls as measured in the experiments, and we explain their origin.

articleTitle: Practical multiplexing for third generation quantum repeaters
abstract: We restrict quantum error correcting code sizes in third-generation quantum repeaters to explore qubit channel multiplexing. We find that the single link optimization is not necessarily the optimal configuration for improving the practical encoded-qubit throughput.

articleTitle: Integrated quantum frequency comb source of entangled qubits
abstract: We demonstrate the simultaneous generation of multiple time-bin entangled photon pairs on a CMOS-compatible photonic chip. We measure quantum interference and perform state tomography, confirming entangled qubits with fidelities above 86% and 99.9% purity.

articleTitle: Highly sensitive strain sensor based on helical structure in multicore fiber
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a highly sensitive strain sensor based on a helical structure in a multicore fiber. The maximum sensitivity is about -61.13 pm/μϵ. The sensor has the capability of discriminating strain and temperature.

articleTitle: All-dielectric three-dimensional photonic topological metacrystals
abstract: We demonstrate that a symmetry protected topological (SPT) state can be engineered in a three-dimensional (3D) all-dielectric metacrystal where the electromagnetic duality between electric and magnetic fields is ensured by the meta-atoms design. Magneto-electric coupling results in a complete topological photonic bandgap and an emergence of spin-polarized surface states with conical Dirac dispersion on 2D topological domain walls.

articleTitle: Light sheet microscopy with wavefront coding for fast volumetric imaging of biological samples
abstract: Decoupling the illumination from the detection optics in microscopy can be achieved by combining light sheet and wavefront coding. This results in a system that allows the light sheet to produce optical sections from out of focus planes. By scanning the light sheet through the sample, it is possible to produce high-resolution volumetric images of living samples at unprecedented speeds.

articleTitle: CO2 sounder lidar development at NASA-GSFC for the ASCENDS mission
abstract: We have advanced the science of space-based laser measurements using the spectral purity and frequency tuning of a fiber-amplified lasers performing active remote sensing of atmospheric CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> column abundance and dry mixing ratio.

articleTitle: Biexciton-mediated modulation response of colloidal quantum dots deposited on a silicon nitride waveguide at high laser excitation rate
abstract: We develop a sensitive collinear pump-probe technique to resolve small amplitude and phase modulations of laser pulses in hybrid PbS/CdS-quantum-dot-SiN waveguides. It shows that at high excitation rate biexciton creation governs the optical interaction.

articleTitle: Quantification of bulk densification in fused silica induced by femtosecond laser exposure in the sub-50 fs regime
abstract: Using micro-cantilever deflection, we study laser-induced densification in bulk fused silica in the sub-50 fs, non-ablative regime. We estimate induced densification from deflection measurements, with a maximum value of 0.014%.

articleTitle: Octave broadband supercontinuum generation in gas-filled anti-resonant hollow-core fiber
abstract: We report on octave broadband supercontinuum generation from ultraviolet to near infrared wavelengths in the fundamental mode of a gas-filled novel low-loss anti-resonant hollow-core fiber having distinct transmission windows.

articleTitle: Analysis of effect of interaction between transverse modes on Kerr frequency comb generation
abstract: We investigated the effect of the interaction between transverse modes on Kerr comb generation. We expanded the Lugiato-Lefever model to consider the effect of cross-phase modulation. We found XPM can work for forming dual solitons.

articleTitle: Excitation and propagation of surface plasmon polaritons on non-structured surface with gradient permittivity
abstract: We have theoretically analyzed the excitation and propagation of surface plasmon polaritons on a planar interface between a homogeneous dielectric and a gradient negative permittivity material. This theory may lead to various applications, including “rainbow trapping”.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical responses of protected atomically thin black phosphorus
abstract: We investigate nonlinear optical responses of black phosphorus in ambient conditions protected by exfoliating thin hexagonal-boron nitride on top. We observe sub-picosecond and polarization sensitive responses for few-layer black phosphorous.

articleTitle: The impact of thermal mode instability on core diameter scaling in high-power fiber amplifiers
abstract: Detailed simulations reveal that the threshold for thermal mode instability decreases for increasing core diameter in step-index fiber amplifiers. The threshold for 50-μm fiber cores is 37% lower than that of 20-μm fiber cores.

articleTitle: Dynamics of excited-state InAs/GaAs Fabry-Perot quantum-dot lasers under optical feedback
abstract: Similar InAs/GaAs quantum-dot lasers emitting on either the ground or excited state are studied under optical feedback. The feedback-sensitivity and dynamics of the excited-state laser are investigated and compared to that of the ground-state laser.

articleTitle: High harmonics from solids probe Angstrom scale structure
abstract: We report generation of XUV harmonics in magnesium oxide crystals subjected to strong laser fields ~1V/Å. By using crystal orientation and laser ellipticity dependence we show that solid-state harmonics probe local electronic structure of crystal.

articleTitle: Beam steering in highly coherent implant-defined vertical cavity surface emitting laser array
abstract: Electronically controlled beam steering was achieved via highly coherent in-phase implant defined vertical cavity surface emitting laser arrays. The total power in the central lobe is above 36% in 1 × 2 array when steering.

articleTitle: A novel approach of LMR/MIP for optical fiber based salivary cortisol sensor
abstract: A novel fiber optic sensor for salivary cortisol sensing in 0 to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> g/ml concentration range is fabricated and characterized using LMR/MIP techniques. The sensor possesses maximum sensitivity of 6.47 nm/gml<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> for 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> g/ml.

articleTitle: Frame dragging in optical Newton-Schrödinger system?
abstract: The general relativity effect of frame-dragging: the precession of test particles in the spacetime surrounding spinning masses, is demonstrated by solitons rotating the space around them via nonlocal nonlinearities, transferring angular momentum to probe beams.

articleTitle: Thulium-doped fiber laser actively mode locked by modulated pumping
abstract: We demonstrate a thulium-doped fiber laser actively mode locked by modulated pumping for the first time. Active CW mode locking is achieved with the pulse duration of 5ps and the spectral width of 0.9nm.

articleTitle: Directly observing particle manipulations along light trajectories with axial plane optical microscopy
abstract: We demonstrate the direct observation of optical particle manipulations along light trajectories with the axial plane optical microscopy (APOM). Optically trapped particles moving along both straight and curved trajectories are successfully monitored by the APOM.

articleTitle: Two-octave-wide UV-VIS Raman spectra generated in hollow-core PCF filled with gas mixtures
abstract: A ro-vibrational Raman comb spanning 280 to 1000 nm is generated in a H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-filled anti-resonant-guiding kagomé hollow-core PCF pumped at 532 nm. Addition of xenon produces a dense cluster of >150 side-bands in the visible.

articleTitle: High power pulse generation and compression with photonic crystal fibers
abstract: The achievements of photonic crystal fiber based ultrashort laser sources will be reviewed.

articleTitle: Modal analysis of an ultrafast frequency comb: Application to laser dynamics and quantum metrology
abstract: A real time, spectrally resolved detection system is developed to characterize the time/frequency modes of an optical frequency comb. Covariance matrix approached is used both for laser dynamics study and quantum metrology experiments.

articleTitle: Raman scattering for intense high orbital angular momentum harmonic generation
abstract: We identify a mechanism, based on Raman scattering, to endow near-infrared laser beams with high orders of orbital angular momentum (OAM). In combination with high-harmonic generation, this could lead to very high OAM harmonics in the soft x-ray region.

articleTitle: Unidirectional, common-path dual-comb lasing enabled by multiple soliton formation mechanisms in a passively hybrid mode-locked fiber ring laser
abstract: Simultaneous oscillation of two pulses under different regimes in a hybrid mode-locked fiber laser is demonstrated. The coherent picosecond and femtosecond pulses with a small frequency difference are applied to asynchronous-sampling and dual-comb measurement.

articleTitle: UV-LED based fiber-optic sensor system for gas analysis
abstract: We report on the development of a fiber-based photometer for diagnostics of next generation gas-insulated electrical switchgear. The UV-LED based sensor system enables accurate concentration measurement of a specific gas in a gas mixture.

articleTitle: Investigation of optical phase noise in long, deployed fiber links for quantum networks
abstract: We investigated the phase noise of an ~83-km-long optical fiber link between Lincoln Laboratory and MIT for a quantum communication system and observed a noise process that is not governed entirely by a random-walk process.

articleTitle: Rayleigh's criterion is irrelevant to the localization of two incoherent optical point sources
abstract: Using the quantum Cramér-Rao bound, we prove that Rayleigh's criterion is fundamentally irrelevant to the estimation of the separation between two incoherent optical sources. We also propose measurement schemes that attain the bound.

articleTitle: Nonlinear stage of modulation instability in dispersion oscillating fibers
abstract: We investigate the nonlinear stage of modulational instability in dispersion oscillating fibers in normal dispersion regime. We unveil a heteroclinic structure leading to the excitability of superbreathers and parametric amplification outside the linear gain bandwidth.

articleTitle: Superradiance in two-dimensional arrays of nanoantennas
abstract: We demonstrate by experiment, simulation, and a simple analytical model that superradiance can be observed in a planar array of nanoantennas, with a linewidth that scales with the number of nanoantennas within a square wavelength.

articleTitle: QCL-based real-time terahertz digital holography
abstract: We demonstrate real-time transmission and reflection digital holography at THz frequencies exploiting the high spectral purity and the mW output power of a QCL laser combined with high sensitivity and resolution of a microbolometric array.

articleTitle: Enhanced dispersive and dissipative coupling regimes in graphene optomechanics
abstract: We numerically demonstrate that through its resistive and inductive (plasmonic) responses, graphene enables strong (~1 GHz/nm) optomechanical coupling in the THz/infrared spectrum. Distinct dispersive and dissipative coupling regimes emerge as functions of graphene's intrinsic properties.

articleTitle: Complete bandgap in three-dimensional chiral gyroid photonic crystals for topological photonics
abstract: We fabricate chiral gyroid photonic crystals using a symmetry-preserving laser direct fabrication method. A three-dimensional complete photonic bandgap at mid-infrared wavelengths is opened through a uniform three-dimensional coating of high refractive-index Sb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Te<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> thin films.

articleTitle: Efficient second harmonic generation in lithium niobate on insulator
abstract: We demonstrate doubly resonant second harmonic generation from 1550 to 775 nm in microdisks fabricated from lithium niobate on insulator wafers. We use a novel phase matching technique to achieve a conversion efficiency of 0.167%/mW.

articleTitle: Waveguided source of broadband entangled photons for quantum interferometry and sensing
abstract: Broadband entangled photons enable quantum interferometry, a technique for ultra-high resolution measurement of polarization mode dispersion [1,2]. We present designs and preliminary results from a broadband entangled photon source in periodically poled lithium niobate waveguides

articleTitle: Ultra-high-Q silicon nitride micro-resonators for low-power frequency comb initiation
abstract: We report the fabrication and characterization of SiN resonators with intrinsic Qs up to 17 million verified with cavity ring-down measurement. Frequency comb generation threshold down to 2.36 mW is consistent with theoretical estimation.

articleTitle: Closing optical transitions for single rare-earth ion spin readout
abstract: We present a protocol that makes rare-earth ion spin-states robust against optical cycling by applying specifically oriented magnetic fields. The resultant closed optical transitions open a pathway for rare-earth qubits at the single ion level.

articleTitle: Nonlinear phase added by a Raman fiber amplifier to a single-frequency seed laser
abstract: We report on analysis of phase perturbation in single-frequency Raman fiber amplifiers. Nonlinear phase is added by Raman gain and cross-phase modulation. A simple relation is derived and has been verified experimentally.

articleTitle: Polarization encoded chirped pulse amplification in Ti:Sapphire — A way towards few cycle PW lasers
abstract: The new technique of polarization encoded amplification (PE-CPA) allows to resolve the problem of gain narrowing in Ti:Sapphire amplifiers. This can allow multi-joule pulses with bandwidth of ~200nm, making few cycle PW Ti:Sapphire systems feasible.

articleTitle: Full mode reconstruction of a light field via a photon-number resolved measurement
abstract: We present a method to reconstruct the mode structure of multimode conjugated optical fields using an experimentally measured joint photon-number probability distribution. We reconstructed a mode structure of a bright parametric down-conversion source.

articleTitle: Time-domain interferometric characterization of nonlinear and thermal-induced phase-shift in silicon waveguides
abstract: Time-domain interferometry is used to simultaneously characterize nonlinear and self-heating phase-shifts in silicon waveguides under long-pulse optical pumping. Applied to a strip waveguide, the method enabled measurements of both stationary phase-shifts and thermal time constant.

articleTitle: Ultra-high-q silica-on-silicon ridge-ring-resonator with an integrated silicon nitride waveguide
abstract: A microcavity resonator having a Q factor exceeding 100 million and featuring a monolithic silicon nitride waveguide is demonstrated. This device enables full integration of ultra-high-Q resonators with other photonic components.

articleTitle: Handedness of Laguerre-Gaussian LG01 mode in a unidirectional ring laser
abstract: A single-frequency Nd:YAG ring laser operating on the Laguerre-Gaussian LG<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> mode with well determined handedness of helical phase front is demonstrated. We show that by reversing the lasing direction the handedness can be changed.

articleTitle: Tunable third-harmonic generation in silicon oxide wedge microcavities
abstract: We demonstrate tunable third-harmonic generation (THG) using a multimode microcavity. The silicon-oxide wedge-resonator is pumped around 1550 nm telecom band and generates tunable THG (512-520 nm) with a collected power efficiency of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>.

articleTitle: Performance of 90GHz electro-optic modulator with patch-antennas in high-power wireless irradiation
abstract: We report a recent progress for performance of 90GHz electro-optic modulator with patch-antennas in high-power wireless radio irradiation. Optical sidebands to carrier ratio of -40dB can be achieved by wireless radio irradiation power of 33dBm.

articleTitle: Hybrid perovskite vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser deploying nanoporous GaN dielectric reflector technology
abstract: Microstructure optimized, solution-grown perovskite thin film with high optical gain is sandwiched between two nanoporous GaN-based DBRs forming a vertical cavity. Low threshold spectrally and spatially coherent near infrared lasing is achieved by optical pumping.

articleTitle: III-V/Si tunable vernier-ring flexible grid comb laser
abstract: We demonstrate the first 200 GHz III-V/Si hybrid tunable, individually addressable four channel comb laser defined by a single shared tunable Si ring mirror, Vernier-paired with four rings filters using <; 2.5 mW per channel.

articleTitle: Multiple beam ptychography for high throughput data acquisition
abstract: We extend ptychography CDI to allow for imaging of multiple areas on a sample simultaneously using multiple identical beams. This enables high throughput imaging of large samples without increased data collection or loss in resolution.

articleTitle: A 0.95 ps, 10 GHz, 60 mW HCN frequency-stabilized and mode-locked fiber laser at 1.55 μm
abstract: We have successfully demonstrated a 0.95 ps, 10 GHz, 1.55 μm HCN frequency stabilized and mode-locked fiber laser with an output power of 60 mW and a frequency stability of 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−11</sup> for τ=1 s.

articleTitle: Silicon photonic thermometer operating on multiple polarizations
abstract: A silicon photonics optical thermometer simultaneously operating on the multiple polarizations is designed and experimentally demonstrated. Measured sensitivities are 86pm/°C and 48pm/°C for the transverse-electric and transverse-magnetic polarizations, respectively.

articleTitle: Electrically pumped whispering gallery mode lasing from Au/ZnO microwire schottky junction
abstract: Whispering gallery mode lasing has been realized from Au-ZnO hexagonal microwire Schottky diode. Electroluminescence characterization demonstrates ultraviolet lasing at room temperature with moderate threshold and high quality factor.

articleTitle: Highly integrated gas sensors based on bi-functional quantum cascade structures
abstract: We present gas sensors based on two concentric vertically emitting and detecting quantum cascade ring structures on the same chip. Both rings can be used as laser and detector at the same wavelength.

articleTitle: Complete coherent control of a strongly coupled quantum dot-cavity polariton system
abstract: We investigated an ultrafast phonon-assisted population transfer between polaritons from a strongly coupled quantum dot-photonic crystal cavity system. In particular, we demonstrated complete coherent control and single-photon generation from a polariton.

articleTitle: High-throughput microparticle screening by 1-μm time-stretch optofluidic imaging integrated with a field-programmable gate array platform
abstract: We demonstrate a new generation of ultrafast 1-μm time-stretch optofluidic imaging system - representing a cost-effective solution toward real-time, high-throughput, in-situ image processing and analytics of single microparticles/cells in a unified system.

articleTitle: Towards the realization of on-chip plasmon enhanced ODMR measurements
abstract: We report on the observation of nanodiamond magnetic resonance measurements at the far end of a silver nanowire. Our results may pave the way for the realization of on chip plasmonic enhanced magnetic sensing.

articleTitle: Extraordinarily large optical cross section for localized single nanoresonator
abstract: The optical cross section of a single nanoresonator is normally on the scale of wavelength. Here, we propose a mechanism to drastically enhance the cross section by three orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Ultrafast polarization-state dynamics of light beams measured by two-photon absorption
abstract: We employ two-photon absorption and polarization-selective Michelson interferometer to measure fs-scale polarization dynamics of stationary unpolarized beams, allowing us to estimate the time span within which the polarization state remains essentially unchanged.

articleTitle: THz generation and photoswitching of the nonlinear properties in a bistable prussian blue analogue
abstract: THz spectroscopy and generation indicates the Rb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.94</inf>Mn[Fe(CN)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>]<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.98</inf>.0.3H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O Prussian-blue analogue is an interesting nonlinear crystal in THz frequency range. A reversible photoswitching of its nonlinear properties is demonstrated within the thermal hysteresis loop of this compound.

articleTitle: A single InN nanopillar photodetector with extended infrared response grown by MOCVD
abstract: An extended infrared photoresponse is observed in a high quality InN pillar/p-GaN photodetector with self-assembly epitaxy grown by LP-MOCVD. The IR portion photocurrent as high as 14.2% can be measured via AM1.5G solar simulated spectra.

articleTitle: Ultra-narrow line filters with enhanced transmittance for low-frequency Raman spectroscopy
abstract: Volume Bragg grating based notch filters extend Raman spectroscopy in THz-frequency range, as low as 4 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. Recent advances in the technology enabled filters for visible region with high OD and losses below 5-10%.

articleTitle: Anisotropic anti-resonant elements gives broadband single-mode low-loss hollow-core fibers
abstract: Hollow-core fibers with node-free anisotropic anti-resonant elements give broadband low-loss fibers that are also single-moded. At 1.06 μm silica-based fiber designs show higher-order-mode extinction-ratio >1000 and losses below 10 dB/km over a broad wavelength range.

articleTitle: Measurements of high cooperativity optomechanical ring resonators
abstract: We present the first measurements of optomechanical ring resonators at room temperature and 4.2 K, demonstrating their large cooperativities with potential for optomechanical feedback cooling to near the quantum ground state.

articleTitle: Generation of an optical frequency comb in the green with silicon nitride microresonators
abstract: The first realization of a green-light frequency comb is reported in a silicon nitride ring microresonator, from third-order non-linear interaction of a near-infrared 1-THz spacing Kerr comb spanning 2/3 of an octave.

articleTitle: Picosecond energy scalable kHz OPO/OPA tunable in 3–3.5 μm mid-IR spectral range
abstract: We demonstrate 740 ps, 4.1-mJ tunable mid-IR PPSLT based OPO/OPA pumped by 38-mJ, 800 ps, Nd-laser system operated at 0.5-1kHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Discrete-variable time-frequency quantum key distribution
abstract: We demonstrate a setup for realizing a four-dimensional time-frequency quantum key distribution protocol, where discrete temporal states are secured using discrete frequency states. The high-dimensional frequency states are detected using a tree of passively stabilized time-delay interferometers.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact source for THz time domain spectroscopy
abstract: We present a regular fiber based THz spectrometer, which is driven by a monolithic semiconductor laser. Clean THz pulses with frequency components up to 0.9 THz can be generated with this ultra-compact light source.

articleTitle: Hot-carrier mediated photon upconversion in metal/semiconductor heterostructure
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a new photon upconversion technique based on hot-carriers in plasmonic systems. We show that metallic nanostructures on GaN/InGaN multiquantum well can upconvert ∼2.48 eV photons to 2.82 eV photons via a linear process.

articleTitle: Super-dispersive off-axis meta-lenses for high resolution spectroscopy
abstract: We demonstrate compact and highly efficient off-axis meta-lenses in the telecom region. Focusing at large angles, as high as 80°, while having a diffraction-limited focus spot enables resolving wavelength differences down to 200 picometers.

articleTitle: Study of orbital angular momentum mode crosstalk induced by propagation through water
abstract: We present measured inter-channel crosstalk for a set of OAM modes propagating through 2.5m of slowly flowing water, similar to that found in oceanic environments. The water induces both tip-tilt and higher order optical aberrations.

articleTitle: A 10-GHz optical frequency comb from a SCOWA-based laser with an intra-cavity 10,000 finesse etalon
abstract: We present preliminary results from the first-ever demonstration of a SCOWA-based harmonically mode-locked laser with intra-cavity etalon with a finesse of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>, producing a 10 GHz optical frequency comb.

articleTitle: Duality in entanglement tested with bell measurements
abstract: Experimental test of dualism in the entangled state of two identical particles using the modification of a Bell-state apparatus.

articleTitle: Enhancement of the modulation bandwidth for surface plasmon coupled LEDs for visible light communication
abstract: The modulation bandwidth of surface plasmon coupled GaN-based LEDs is increased by ∼1.2 times to 434.5 MHz compared with normal LED by applying Ag nanoparticles. These findings will help for the industrialization of VLC system.

articleTitle: Establishing quantum hybrid systems with tailored photons
abstract: We introduce components for future quantum hybrid networks. A tailored narrowband photon pair source, tunable emission of Fourier-limited photons from a quantum dot, and single photon frequency conversion to the telecom C-band are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Efficient and low noise frequency downconversion from the 980 nm band to the 1550 nm band using Si3N4 microrings
abstract: We demonstrate frequency downconversion from 980 nm to 1550 nm with an efficiency of 60% and pW-level background noise power, via four-wave-mixing Bragg scattering in Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> microrings using <; 60 mW continuous wave pump power.

articleTitle: Sinusoidally gated InGaAs/InP avalanche photodiode with 53% photon detection efficiency at 1550 nm
abstract: We report on the high-efficiency single-photon detector at 1550 nm using an InGaAs/InP avalanche photodiode gated with 50-V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p-p</sub> sinewave. The saturated photon detection efficiency of 53.7% was obtained without significant increase of afterpulse probability.

articleTitle: Interferometric signal retrieval in single-beam coherent anti-stokes Raman scattering
abstract: Interferometric retrieval of coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering signal through pulse shaper is demonstrated. The method allows for fast acquisition, and is beneficial in detecting broad Raman structure that has short coherence lifetime.

articleTitle: Graphene plasmon-modified THz laser waveguides
abstract: Here we calculate the electric field and reflection gain for a graphene-incorporated THz semiconductor laser waveguide. By controlling the Fermi level of graphene, the lasing modes of the waveguide are modified via graphene plasmons.

articleTitle: Metafilm: Metamaterial array embedded in organic thin film
abstract: A flexible metamaterial device consisting of metal split rings embedded in a transparent polymer film is demonstrated. The device is useful to construct three-dimensional metamaterial systems to develop novel terahertz- and photonic applications.

articleTitle: Intense terahertz field generation via two-color laser filamentation at 1 kHz repetition rates
abstract: We report the generation of intense THz fields (15 MV/cm) at kHz repetition rates by two-color laser filamentation in air. We find the refocused THz spot size can be maintained small even with long filamentation.

articleTitle: Passively Q-switched Ytterbium-doped fiber laser based on mechanically exfoliated black phosphorus
abstract: Few-layer black phosphorus (BP) is a two-dimensional material. BP was fabricated by mechanical exfoliation method. We have experimentally shown that the Q-switched pulse was generated in Yb-doped fiber laser based on the BP staturable absorber.

articleTitle: Design and verification of a flat-field aberration-corrected concave blaze grating for hyperspectral imaging
abstract: A flat-field aberration corrected concave blaze grating for 400-1100nm is designed and fabricated. An optical system is setup to measure the focused spot size, spectral resolution and grating efficiency to evaluate the performance of grating.

articleTitle: First demonstration of CMOS compatible electrical programmable photonic memory cell
abstract: We propose an electrically programmable, multi-level non-volatile photonics memory cell (PMC) fabricated by standard CMOS compatible processes. A micro-ring resonator (MRR) was built using the PMC to demonstrate programmable and erase functions.

articleTitle: Global k-space analysis of electron-phonon interaction in graphene
abstract: Electron-phonon coupling in graphene is studied across the Brillouin zone. The contributions from modulated hopping and conventional deformation potential coupling, and from intraband and interband coupling are analyzed and related to available experimental M-point spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Entangling gate with trapped ions using long
abstract: The use of long-wavelength radiation for gate operations is a promising approach for trapped-ion quantum computation. We demonstrate the key principle of this approach by generating a maximally entangled two-qubit Bell-state with fidelity of 0.985.

articleTitle: Fast-convergent adaptive frequency-domain recursive least-squares algorithm with reduced complexity for MDM transmission systems using optical few-mode fibers
abstract: We investigate a single-stage adaptive frequency-domain recursive-least-square algorithm for simultaneously compensating CD&DMGD in few-mode fiber systems, which increases the convergence speed by 53.7% over conventional FD-LMS method, with 11% hardware complexity reduction over two-stage approach.

articleTitle: Raman-like stimulated Brillouin scattering in SiN waveguides
abstract: We present stimulated Brillouin (SBS) scattering in SiN based on combining optical waveguides with pillar-based phononic crystals. We utilize breathing modes inside the phononic crystals that strongly interact with optical modes, enabling low-threshold GHz SBS.

articleTitle: Intracavity hyperpolarizability measurement from carrier envelope phase demodulation
abstract: Using an intracavity high-voltage capacitor, we experimentally show a CEP modulation arising from the quadratic electro-optic effect in atmospheric air, offering a novel approach towards precise measurements of the third-order nonlinear susceptibility of gases.

articleTitle: Femtosecond four-wave mixing from near-infrared to mid-infrared in a tellurite step-index fiber
abstract: Based on a tellurite step-index fiber, femtosecond four-wave mixing from near-infrared to mid-infrared is achieved. The signal can be tuned from 1550 to 1434 nm, and idler can be generated from 1757 to 2400 nm.

articleTitle: Sensitive trace gas and isotope measurements using cavity enhanced absorption spectroscopy
abstract: This presentation will review cavity-enhanced techniques for the measurement of trace gas concentrations and isotope ratios in particular. It will give an introduction to the principle of optical isotope ratio measurements and discuss recent advances.

articleTitle: Time-resolved gain spectroscopy on type-I and type-II VECSEL chips
abstract: Time-resolved reflectivity spectra of a type-II VECSEL chip are presented and compared to that of a type-I VECSEL chip. For both structures we discuss gain, cooling and recombination dynamics.

articleTitle: Integrated optofluidic cell stretchers using optical lattices generated from vertically embedded multimode-interference waveguides
abstract: We report on-chip optical lattice generation using SU8-filled vertically embedded multimode-interference waveguides in a silicon substrate. We show stretching of rabbit red blood cells using the generated optical lattices in a fluidic channel.

articleTitle: Performance characterisation and limitations of high-gain discrete Raman amplification
abstract: We experimentally characterise discrete Raman amplification by varying pump power, fibre length and signal feedback level. We achieve up to 35dB gain for <; 1dB bit error rate penalty using a fibre length of 8.65km.

articleTitle: Non-destructive inspection using phase-shifting resonant vibrometry
abstract: We present experimental demonstration utilizing phase-shifting resonant vibrometry to determine the presence and position of embedded defect inside a device under test (DUT) whose awkward surface shape prohibits the use of conventional ultrasonic transducers.

articleTitle: Dynamic plasmonic trapping and manipulation of nanoparticles and nanowires
abstract: The hybrid plasmonic mode in a narrow gap, between a nanoparticle and a metal film with surface plasmon polaritons, strongly enhances the electromagnetic field and the induced optical forces. Here, we employ the plasmonic mode to achieve dynamic trapping and manipulation of nanoparticles and nanowires on a flat metal surface. We reveal that the plasmonic forces can trap metallic, dielectric and semiconductor nano-objects, and control its position and orientation. Finally we show potential applications of such plasmonic tweezers in surface-enhanced Raman scattering and fabrication of lab-on-a-chip nanowire devices.

articleTitle: Photothermal mid-infrared spectroscopy using Fano resonances in silicon microring resonators
abstract: A novel photothermal mid-infrared spectroscopy method is demonstrated in the 3.5μm wavelength range on a polymer analyte using an asymmetric Fano-type resonance in a silicon-on-insulator microring resonator.

articleTitle: Super-coulombic dipole-dipole interactions in hyperbolic media
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally that hyperbolic metamaterials fundamentally alter dipole-dipole interactions conventionally limited to the near-field. The effect is captured in long-range energy transfer and lifetime reduction of donor emitters due to acceptors placed 100 nm away.

articleTitle: Fabricating a linear variable filter using nanoreplica molding
abstract: We present a new technique for fabrication of a linear variable guided-mode resonance (GMR) filter based upon nanoreplica molding. The developed process utilizes a wedge-shaped elastomeric mold, which is stretched to obtain 1D gratings with a linearly graded period. A high refractive index dielectric film is deposited on the graded-period grating to serve as the waveguide layer of the GMR filter. The GMR wavelength varies in a range of 680.2-737.0 nm depending on measurement location on the filter.

articleTitle: Hybrid nanolayer architetures for acousto-plasmonics in soft matter
abstract: We introduce a method to analyze optical and viscoelastic properties of the surrounding medium of GNRs by using hyper-sound waves, generated by new, efficient, inexpensive optoacoustic soft-matter transducers.

articleTitle: Integration of III-V nanopillar resonator to in-plane silicon waveguides
abstract: We proposed, fabricated, and characterized new structures based on III-V compound semi-conductor nanopillars, monolithically integrated to silicon platform, for coupling spontaneous and stimulated emission to silicon waveguides.

articleTitle: Observation of Mollow-triplet in micro-fabricated μm channels
abstract: We construct a microscale vapor cell, which enables high confinement of both light and vapor, and thus to reduce Doppler broadening via the velocity selection process. Consequently, we could demonstrate sub-Doppler emergence of Mollow triplets.

articleTitle: High power Yb:YAG waveguide amplification of a femtosecond semiconductor disk laser
abstract: We demonstrate the first amplification of an ultrafast semiconductor disk laser inside a crystalline waveguide. The 8.3-mm long fs-laser written Yb:YAG channel waveguide generates 2.89 W in 630 fs pulses at 1030 nm.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of the de-magnifying hyperlens
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate de-magnification functionality of a hyperlens. The original patterns with a feature size of 300nm were scaled down to 190nm, which was smaller than half of the wavelength of the incident beam.

articleTitle: Helium-ion milling of gold slot antennas
abstract: We demonstrate helium-ion milled gold slot antennas with controllable 20-nm gap spacing that show large scattering polarization ratios of ~37× and resonance shifts with length. Antennas with larger gaps show comparable quality to gallium-milled antennas.

articleTitle: Record low differential resistance using lithographic VCSELs
abstract: A lithographic VCSEL approach is used in GaAs-based VCSELs to eliminate the oxide aperture. Record low voltage drive and differential resistance are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional free-form fabrication and lifetime-tuning of quantum dots
abstract: We perform free-form fabrication of CdSe/ZnS quantum dots (QDs) on a plasmonic substrate using optically generated microbubbles, with control over the concentration of QDs. We further tune the QD-plasmon interaction to achieve tunable QD lifetime from 80ps to 1 ns.

articleTitle: Characterization of a new frequency tuning and modulation mechanism for spectroscopy in a quantum cascade laser
abstract: We present for the first time an investigation of the tuning and modulation properties of a quantum cascade laser with an integrated heater providing a new tuning mechanism. We also show the benefit for spectroscopy applications.

articleTitle: Chalcogenide-based optical parametric oscillator
abstract: We report a chalcogenide microwire-based optical parametric oscillator (OPO). The all-fiber OPO is tunable in the wavelength band of 2 μm, with a threshold peak power of 5 W and slope efficiency of 2%.

articleTitle: Engineered quasi-phase matching for conversion efficiency optimization of coupled χ(2) processes
abstract: We propose an algorithm to optimize the efficiency of coupled χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> processes in an aperiodic optical superlattice. Frequency tripling efficiency 33% higher than the limit of sequentially periodic structure is numerically demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Direct imaging of iso-frequency contours in photonic crystal slabs
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally demonstrate a method for directly imaging iso-frequency contours in photonic crystal slabs using resonance-enhanced scattering from fabrication disorder. The results agree quantitatively with numerical simulations and provide information on fabrication errors.

articleTitle: Ptychographic reconstruction algorithm for FROG: Supreme robustness and super-resolution
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a ptychographic-based algorithm for characterizing ultrashort laser pulses from FROG spectrograms. Our approach is highly robust, even when the spectrograms are incomplete; spectrally filtered or under-sampled in the time delay axis.

articleTitle: Impact of DWDM at 50GHz spacing in the 2μm waveband
abstract: In this paper, we show for the first time the impact of decreasing DWDM channel spacing to 50GHz in the 2μm waveband, using 6×12.5Gbit/s and 2×8Gbit/s OOK signals.

articleTitle: Interface roughness scattering rate equation model of long-wavelength quantum cascade lasers
abstract: The consideration of interface roughness scattering in the model of quantum cascade lasers enables the optimization of long-wavelength designs and predicts a twofold reduction in threshold current of our design compared to the current designs.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared broadband absorber of full semiconductor
abstract: We demonstrate a mid-infrared broadband absorber of full semiconductor epi-layers theoretically. The structure is of MIM-like with grating InAs(n-type, 220 nm)/InAs(I,220 nm)/InAs(n-type, 1000 nm). The absorptivity is over 80% from 8 μm to 12 μm.

articleTitle: Ultrashort pulse characterization from dispersion scans with a grating compressor
abstract: A grating compressor is characterized using the dispersion scan technique and a reference piece of glass. The procedure yields both the spectral phase of the ultrashort pulses and the dispersion of the compressor itself.

articleTitle: Optical homodyne with optical bandwidth
abstract: Broadband squeezing is easily produced, yet practically impossible to utilize, since the detection bandwidth of standard homodyne is severely limited. We exploit parametric amplification to demonstrate direct optical homodyne with effectively unlimited bandwidth.

articleTitle: SDL in-band pumped Q-switched 2.1 μm Ho:YAG laser
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time to our knowledge a Q-switched Ho:YAG laser in-band pumped by a 1.9 μm semiconductor disk laser (SDL). 3.3 mJ of pulse energy were achieved in a compact setup.

articleTitle: Analog performance of multiple, discretely tunable time delays based on a frequency comb and a chromatic dispersion element
abstract: We demonstrate the analog performance of multiple, coherent, and discretely tunable time delays based on a frequency comb and a chromatic dispersion element. The amount of 0.6ns delay is measured between adjacent selected comb lines. The linear phase frequency response of the system is verified and the SFDR is measured.

articleTitle: Comparison of photon pair generation in a-Si:H and c-Si microring resonators
abstract: We generate photon pairs via SFWM in hydrogenated amorphous silicon microring resonators, and compare the behavior to crystalline silicon.

articleTitle: Observation of Poynting's vector reversal in an active optical cavity
abstract: We observe the reversal of Poynting's vector inside a cavity when the gain exceeds a pre-lasing threshold and demonstrate that the vector's direction can be reversed without changing its amplitude using a passive intra-cavity element.

articleTitle: 50 GHz quantum photonic storage in a cavity-protected rare-earth ensemble
abstract: We demonstrate ultrafast transfer of a broadband photonic qubit to a dense rare-earth ensemble cavity protected against decoherence due to inhomogeneous broadening. Storage in highly coherent superradiant collective states enables long-lived memories and optical-to-microwave conversion.

articleTitle: Single-shot, full characterization of a single-photon state
abstract: Quantum light parameters (purity, indistinguishability, ...) are usually determined using multiple sequential measurements. We demonstrate an efficient single-shot scheme to characterize a quantum dot light using two number-resolving detectors, here simulated by four single-photon detectors.

articleTitle: Coherent diffraction imaging of buried nanostructures in a reflection geometry with extreme ultraviolet light
abstract: We use reflection-mode ptychography CDI with HHG illumination to image copper nanostructures buried beneath 100nm of aluminum. Our technique yields absolute reflectivity images, allowing non-destructive detection of diffusion at the Al-Cu boundary, confirmed by Auger-Electron-Spectroscopy.

articleTitle: The FERMI free-electron laser
abstract: FERMI is a seeded free-electron laser (FEL) delivering extreme ultraviolet (EUV) light in the wavelength range between 100 and 4 nm. An overview of generation and control of fully coherent stable EUV pulses is presented.

articleTitle: Broadband mid-infrared difference frequency generation using apodized aperiodically poled LiNbO3 waveguide
abstract: Apodized aperiodically poled LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> waveguide was fabricated by varying the duty cycle of sampled χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> grating. Broadband 3 μm difference frequency generation and gas spectroscopy were demonstrated using the device.

articleTitle: Ultratrace plasmonic sensing below the shot noise limit
abstract: A balanced SPR sensor utilizing intensity squeezed states to resolve signals below the shot-noise-limit is demonstrated. At the inflection point, this sensor demonstrates 2.5 dB greater sensitivity than the best comparable classical sensor

articleTitle: Dimension control of superradiance
abstract: We show how superradiant emission can be controlled by dimensional confinement, including near-field and dipole-orientation effects. Our model naturally interpolates for all real dimension between one dimension and three dimensions.

articleTitle: Coherent bidirectional microwave-optical conversion using Rydberg atoms
abstract: Deterministic quantum information processing will require hybrid quantum systems like an interface between microwave and optical photons. We propose a scheme for efficient, multimode and coherent microwave-optical conversion based on frequency mixing in Rydberg atoms.

articleTitle: Octave-band tunable (0.74–1.89μm) optical vortex laser
abstract: We developed an octave-band tunable optical vortex laser based on a 0.532-μm optical vortex-pumped optical parametric oscillator with an extended cavity configuration by employing cascaded non-critical phase-matching LiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> crystals. The optical vortex output was tuned within a wavelength range of 735nm-1893nm, and a pulse energy of 0.24-2.36 mJ was also achieved.

articleTitle: Characterization of the local charge environment of a single quantum dot via resonance fluorescence
abstract: Resonant photoluminescence excitation spectra and autocorrelation measurements indicate that a quantum dot experiences discrete spectral shifts and continuous drifts due to fluctuations in the local charge environment. Specifically, the fluctuations of few nearby charge traps.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional measurement technology for additive manufacturing
abstract: We proposed the 3D sensing system which is composed of a structured light generating device and an image capturing device to measurement height variation of each layer during selective laser melting(SLM) process.

articleTitle: Optofluidic plasmonic NanoLenses: High throughput single bacterial cell sorting
abstract: We demonstrated that the integration of nanoplasmonic and nanofluidic platform paves the way to sort bacteria like bio-particles of size in the range from 100 nm to 1 μm by simply modulating incident light power.

articleTitle: All-optical image recognition and processing with plasmonic metasurfaces
abstract: We engage effective nonlinearity of the coherent wave interaction on a thin metamaterial absorber to demonstrate all-optical image recognition and logical functions that in principle can be performed at THz frame rates and quantum-limited intensities.

articleTitle: Spectroscopy and imaging using a Mid-IR quantum cascade optical coherence tomography (OCT) system
abstract: We have successfully designed and tested the first working high-resolution, mid-IR OCT system that can simultaneously perform structural and chemical analysis of samples using novel low-coherent, high power QC emitters.

articleTitle: Coupling between a plasmonic V-groove waveguide and single fluorescent bacterial cells
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate coupling of fluorescent light from a single bacterium into a plasmonic V-groove waveguide mode. This result is the first step in the construction of an efficient bioplasmonic chip for diverse sensing applications.

articleTitle: Comparison of germanium and copper seed layers for the fabrication of smooth silver thin films
abstract: Seed layers can reduce surface roughness and increase optical transmissivity of silver thin films used in plasmonic applications. We compare germanium and copper seed layers and find germanium preferable for 10-40 nm thick silver films.

articleTitle: Towards quantum effects with a μg-scale mechanical oscillator
abstract: We present an optomechanical system made from a quartz micropillar in a cryogenic Fabry-Perot cavity. To reach the optomechanical quantum regime, we have developed techniques to suppress photothermoelastic instabilities and mirror substrate Brownian noise.

articleTitle: CMOS-compatible deposition of tunable crystalline SiGe composition on insulator
