abstract: In this invited talk I will review the results of several recent studies wherein electronic structure and the metal-insulator transition temperature in the strongly-correlated oxide VO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is controlled via external stimuli, such as strain, temperature and ultrafast THz electric fields.

articleTitle: High-speed spectral shearing contrast time-stretch microscopy
abstract: We present a straightforward high-performance technique for measuring the amplitude and phase of low contrast microscopic subjects at very high speed utilizing photonic time-stretch and spectral shearing interferometry.

articleTitle: Circular gratings for efficient collection from implanted silicon vacancy centers in diamond
abstract: We report a chirped circular nanograting in bulk diamond coupled with implanted silicon-vacancy centers. From simulations we determine 41% low-numerical-aperture collection efficiency, and an expected and measured directionality of ∼30 and ∼5 respectively.

articleTitle: Black phosphorus photodetector on silicon photonic and plasmonic hybrid platform
abstract: Silicon photonics, plasmonic structures and two dimensional material are integrated vertically on SOI (Silicon on Insulator) substrate to produce a short channel photodetector. Its estimated average intrinsic responsivity is 220 mA/W.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser quantized structuring in thin SiOx film
abstract: Time dynamics of thin plasma disk generation and ablation dynamics in SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> film on silicon are examined by femtosecond laser pump and probe experiments. Quantized etching, nanovoids and blisters are revealed on half-wavelength interference period.

articleTitle: Experimental realization of color hologram using pancharatnam-berry phase manipulating metasurface
abstract: We design and fabricate a Pancharatnam-Berry phase manipulating metasurface to experimentally demonstrate a three-color RGB pattern. The color pattern is produced by illuminating a nanostructured silver metasurface hologram with a white light source.

articleTitle: Electrical and optical performance of textured silicon solar cells improved by plasmonic scattering and luminescent down-shifting effects
abstract: This study presents electrical and optical performances of textured silicon solar cell improved by plasmonic-scattering and luminescent-down-shifting effects. The cell with the proposed effects demonstrated a 1.79 % absolute-gain in efficiency compared with a reference-cell.

articleTitle: “Teramometry” and plasmonic nanoparticle imaging for temperature-sensing in the terahertz regime
abstract: We develop a novel temperature mapping technique for bio-systems exploiting the high sensitivity of terahertz waves to aqueous media. The proposed method allowed us to investigate in deep nanoplasmonic-induced photothermal effects such as collective heating phenomena.

articleTitle: Broadband multimode fiber spectrometer
abstract: Using a wavelength division multiplexer, we increase the spectral bandwidth of a multimode-fiber-based spectrometer to 100nm with the spectral resolution of 0.03nm. An effective algorithm is developed to achieve fast, accurate reconstruction of diversified spectra.

articleTitle: Efficient coupling of single nitrogen-vacancy center photons to a GaP-on-diamond integrated optics platform
abstract: We present high single-photon collection rates into a bus waveguide from a nitrogen-vacancy center coupled to an integrated disk resonator. The resonator is built on a gallium phosphide (GaP)-on-diamond chip alongside passive photonic devices.

articleTitle: Long-haul coherent transmission using a silicon nitride microresonator-based frequency comb as WDM source
abstract: We demonstrated transmission of polarization-multiplexed quadrature phase-shift keying data over 6000 km using a low-noise silicon nitride microresonator frequency comb as light source. These results show the technology's suitability for long-haul fiber communications.

articleTitle: Thickness dependent third-harmonic generation in few-layer black phosphorus
abstract: We observe third-harmonic generation in black phosphorus and find that χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> is strongly dependent on both the number of layers and incident polarization. We also use the third-harmonic signal to measure the pulse width of our ultrafast laser.

articleTitle: Plasmonic coloring of silver using picosecond laser pulses
abstract: We report fast angle-independent coloring of silver due to plasmonic effects arising from the creation of random nanoparticle distributions. Each individual color is linked to a unique total accumulated fluence rendering the process compatible with industry.

articleTitle: Cladding-dependent nature of electro-optic effects in silicon waveguides
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate how dielectric claddings can alter the nature of capacitively-induced electro-optic effects in silicon waveguides. The free-carrier effects reported here can be extended to the study of any dielectric-clad semiconductor waveguide.

articleTitle: Optofluidic tunable lens using laser-induced thermal gradient
abstract: This paper presents an optofluidic tunable lens using laser-induced thermal gradient to focus the light to one point. By use of the thermo-optics effect, we demonstrated a tunable focal length from infinite to 1.3 mm.

articleTitle: Generation of spectrally-isolated violet to blue wavelengths by cascaded degenerate four-wave mixing
abstract: The spectrally-isolated violet to blue wavelengths within the spectral range of 430 to 472 nm are experimentally generated by cascaded degenerate four-wave mixing in a tailor-made photonic crystal fiber with two adjacent zero dispersion wavelengths.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of multiple four-wave mixing induced by optical solitons in a tellurite microstructured optical fiber
abstract: Multiple four-wave mixing in a 3 m four-hole tellurite microstructured optical fiber is investigated with the pump pulse propagating near the zero-dispersion wavelength.

articleTitle: Highly stable two-photon oxygen imaging probe based on a ruthenium-complex encapsulated in a silica-coated nanomicelle
abstract: A nanomicelle-based ruthenium-complex oxygen imaging probe is coated with a silica shell. The biostability of the silica-coated probe is improved by a factor of 4, while the oxygen-sensitivity is reduced by a factor of 3.

articleTitle: Femtosecond OPO based on orientation-patterned gallium phosphide (OP-GaP)
abstract: We report the first femtosecond OP-GaP based OPO suitable for ultrabroadband frequency comb generation. The 15-dB bandwidth of 2.6-4.2 μm was obtained from a compact low-threshold (14 mW) OPO pumped by 85-fs Er-fiber laser.

articleTitle: Ultra small cross-section photonic probes for deep tissue non-invasive light delivery
abstract: We demonstrate a new platform for minimally invasive, photonics light delivery. The fabricated probes have sub-10μm cross-sectional dimensions and lengths greater than 3mm (a 1000:1 aspect ratio). We show mechanical robustness and low optical losses.

articleTitle: An all-fiber supercontinuum laser source with high power of 30.4 W and ultra-wide spectrum of 385–2400 nm
abstract: We demonstrated an all-fiber supercontinuum laser source with high average power of 30.4 W and blue-enhanced spectrum ranging from 385 nm to 2400 nm, pumped by a picosecond ytterbium-doped fiber MOPA.

articleTitle: Printed plasmonic GaAs nanolasers
abstract: We present optically-pumped plasmonic GaAs nanolasers operating at room temperature. Built on suspended GaAs membranes, the etchless fabrication involves only a printed metal film, which defines the plasmonic cavity and confines the optical mode.

articleTitle: Measurement of free-space coupling efficiency in a deformed microcavity using stimulated Raman scattering
abstract: We identify experimentally the efficiency of the free-space coupling through measuring the threshold of stimulated Raman scattering in a slightly deformed microtoroid cavity, and the measured efficiency is up to 30%.

articleTitle: Frequency-chirped multi-cycled terahertz pulse generated from periodically poled lithium niobate for frequency-modulated continuous-wave radars
abstract: Broadband down- and up-chirped THz pulses are generated from PPLNs. Their temporal frequency shift and temporal amplitude are demonstrated. In the case of the down-chirped THz pulse, square-shaped waveform with broadband frequency shift is observed.

articleTitle: Shape memory photonic metamaterial
abstract: We report the first reconfigurable metamaterial based on the shape memory alloy. In the heating cycle structural elements of this metamaterials exhibit a hysteresis-type shape transformation that leads to non-volatile switching of its plasmonic properties.

articleTitle: Backward phase-matching in negative-index materials
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the nonlinear mirror effect in a negative-index medium using a waveguide configuration. This confirms for the first time a decade old prediction and expands the scope of nonlinear optics in artificially-structured media.

articleTitle: 2×2 PolMux-MIMO RoF system employing interference cancellation based OFDM/OQAM technique
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a polarization multiplexed RoF system with 2×2 MIMO wireless link using OFDM/OQAM technique. By using interference-cancellation-based channel estimator, 4.4 Gb/s 16QAM-OFDM/OQAM signal has been successfully transmitted over 25km SSMF and 0.4m air distance.

articleTitle: Blood glucose measurement using mid-infrared hollow-optical fiber probe with ATR multi-reflection prism
abstract: Mid-infrared ATR spectroscopy system comprising hollow optical fibers and a multi-reflection prism are developed for blood-glucose measurement. Absorption spectra of lip mucosa revealed clear signatures of glucose and measurement errors less than 20% was obtained.

articleTitle: Shifted plasmonic nanorods to enhance the density of hot-spots for surface-based nonlinear optics
abstract: Strong field enhancements are observed in the nano-gaps of plasmonic nanostructures. We propose a novel structure made of shifted nanorods to maximize the density of hot-spots, which is a crucial parameter for surface-based nonlinear optics.

articleTitle: Coherent absorption of N00N states
abstract: We experimentally investigate two-photon N00N state coherent absorption in a multilayer graphene film and show that coherent loss can be used as a resource for quantum operations.

articleTitle: Modular optofluidic systems: A toolbox for fast and simple assembly of a photonic lab on a chip
abstract: A powerful modular optofuidic systems (MOPS) toolbox, which allows in-situ implementation of reconfigurable Photonic lab on a chip (PhLoC) has been developed. Each module has specific optic, fluidic or optofluidic elements that enable defining arbitrarily complex PhLoC systems. After having measured the optical total losses of the MOPS concept, it has been used for defining either absorbance or fluorescence measurements. In the first case, LoD below the μM level of Crystal Violet was obtained, whereas in fluorescence, the use of a specifically designed MOPS building block allows blocking excitation wavelength, resulting in a 2-fold increase of the sensitivity.

articleTitle: Laser fabricated ultrathin flat lens in sub-nanometer thick monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides crystal
abstract: A flat lens with sub-nanometer (7 Å) thickness is fabricated in a monolayer WS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> crystal flake using direct laser writing. The ultrathin lens is able to focus visible light with diffraction limited three-dimensional spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Chiral switchable THz metamaterial with MEMS reconfigurable spirals
abstract: We proposed a chiral switchable metamaterial using MEMS technology in the terahertz frequency region. Deformation of a flat metal spiral unit of the metamaterial creates three-dimensional spirals, and symmetrical chiral switching of the spiral could be performed by selecting the deformation directions; upper or lower. Ellipticity modulations amplitude as large as ±28° could be obtained in 1.08 THz, and optical responses were numerically analyzed.

articleTitle: Performance of an optical differentiation wavefront sensor based on binary pixelated transmission filters
abstract: An optical differentiation wavefront sensor based on binary pixelated transmission filters allows for accurate wavefront metrology from two measured orthogonal wavefront gradients. Numerical and experimental investigation of its performance is presented.

articleTitle: Short-gate techniques for high-speed photon counting with InGaAs/InP SPADs
abstract: This work shows that InGaAs/InP Single-Photon Avalanche Diodes (SPADs) can achieve high count rate (> 500 Mcps) and high detection efficiency (> 30 % at 1550 nm) when operated with sub-nanosecond gates.

articleTitle: Low excess noise AlxIn1-xAsySb1-y (x: 0.3∼0.7) avalanche photodiodes
abstract: We report avalanche photodiodes fabricated from a previously uncharacterized material system, Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</sub>Sb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-y</sub> digital alloy. A series of Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</sub>Sb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-y</sub> (x: 0.3~0.7) p-i-n avalanche photodiodes have been grown on GaSb substrate. Dark current characteristics, avalanche multiplication, external quantum efficiency, and excess noise are presented. Very low excess noise, corresponding to k = 0.03~0.05, has been observed.

articleTitle: Coherent control of the optical absorption in a plasmonic lattice coupled to a luminescent layer
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the coherent control, i.e. the phase controlled enhancement and suppression, of the absorption and optical loss in an array of plasmonic particles covered by luminescent layer.

articleTitle: Lasing in strong-field ionized nitrogen molecules: Influence of nuclear dynamics on population inversion
abstract: We investigate nuclear dynamics and population transfer among multiple electronic states in tunnel ionized nitrogen molecules, and clarify the underlying mechanism behind the population inversion responsible for free-space N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> lasers.

articleTitle: Single-photon-sensitive solid-state image sensors for flash lidar
abstract: MIT Lincoln Laboratory has developed lidar systems based on Geiger-mode avalanche photodiodes using both silicon and InGaAs. This technology has enabled terrain mapping and foliage penetration systems with exquisite sensitivity and high area coverage rate.

articleTitle: 6-ps pulse generation from a hybrid MOPA seeded by a gain-switched laser diode
abstract: We have generated a 6–14 picosecond optical pulses at 200-kHz repetition rate from a hybrid MOPA seeded by a 1064-nm gain-switched distributed-feedback-Bragg laser diode. Thanks to the narrow gam bandwidth of Nd doped bulk-crystal amplifiers, the optical pulse-width was tunable by changing the laser diode chip temperature.

articleTitle: A high-frequency regenerative optomechanical oscillator on lithium-niobate-on-insulator platform
abstract: We demonstrate a regenerative optomechanical oscillator operating at a high frequency of 375 MHz on lithium-niobate-on-insulator platform based upon a compact high-Q lithium niobate microdisk resonator with an intrinsic optical Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sub> of 2.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> and intrinsic mechanical Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> above 5000 in the air.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of an As2Se3 optical microwire cladded with perfluorinated CYTOP
abstract: We demonstrate linear and nonlinear optical transmission results of a highly nonlinear As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> optical microwire cladded with perfluorinated CYTOP. This polymer enables the operation of the microwire in mid-infrared wavelengths up to >2.5 μm.

articleTitle: Simultaneous access to C and N absorption edges of B:SubPC:Cl in the water-window with an attosecond pulse
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous identification of double core-band transitions of an organic film with an isolated attosecond pulse whose bandwidth covers the entire soft X-ray water window.

articleTitle: Convex decompositions of thermal equilibrium for non-interacting non-relativistic particles
abstract: We provide convex decompositions of thermal equilibrium for non-interacting non-relativistic particles in terms of localized wave packets. These quantum representations offer new calculation tools and insights as they help relate to the classical picture.

articleTitle: Yb:YAG thin-disk multi-pass amplification system with image relay
abstract: We have developed Yb:YAG thin-disk multi-pass amplification system adopting image relay to keep the beam size on the thin-disk constant. By this system pulse energy amplification to > 20 mJ was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser machining of micron-diameter graphitized columns in diamond
abstract: Graphitized columns with ~1 μm diameter through ~500 μm-thick diamonds are formed by femtosecond laser machining using both aberration-corrected and Bessel beam focusing with high numerical aperture for development of radiation-hard, high-energy particle detectors.

articleTitle: Long-lived anisotropy of photoexcited graphene electrons
abstract: In polarization resolved pump-probe experiments complemented by microscopic modeling we show that an anisotropic carrier distribution persists on ps timescales. In particular, we evaluate the role of non-collinear Coulomb scattering.

articleTitle: Graphene enhanced surface plasmon resonance fiber-optic biosensor
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a side-polished optical fiber based graphene-on-gold biosensor. Single layer of graphene is deposited to improve the sensitivity in single-stranded DNA detection. Our proposed biosensor provides a detection limit lower than 1 pM.

articleTitle: Singe Nanoparticle detection using the dissipative interaction with a high-Q microcavity
abstract: Different from the conventional whispering-gallery-mode sensing using reactive interaction, the dissipative interaction is proposed and demonstrated to detect single nanoparticles which are lossy and with an ultra-small real part of the polarizability.

articleTitle: 3-D endoscopic imaging using plenoptic camera
abstract: Three-dimensional endoscopic imaging using plenoptic technique combined with F-matching algorithm has been pursued in this study. A custom relay optics was designed to integrate a commercial surgical straight endoscope with a plenoptic camera.

articleTitle: 7 μm, sub-8 cycle OPCPA pumped at 2 μm by Ho:YLF
abstract: We present the first ultrafast and all-fiber pumped OPCPA operating at 7 μm and generating 0.55 mJ pulses at 180 fs (7.7 optical cycles).

articleTitle: Enhanced monolithically integrated high power repetition-rate tunable mode-locked laser diode
abstract: We present a monolithically integrated mode-locked laser with integrated pulse-selector and power booster. High peak power (>1 W) pulses are generated with durations of 15.4 ps at a 55 MHz selected rate.

articleTitle: Coupled bright solitons in the normal dispersion regime in whispering-gallery-mode resonators
abstract: We study nonlinear mode coupling in whispering gallery mode resonators. We computationally show the formation of trains of mode-locked bright solitons in the normal dispersion regime under particular conditions.

articleTitle: Highly directional fluorescent emission at visible wavelengths with a silicon metasurface
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate, for the first time to our knowledge, highly-directional fluorescence emission at visible wavelengths from a silicon metasurface covered with a dye-doped thin film. We provide a physical interpretation based on multipole expansion.

articleTitle: Dual-comb spectroscopy for city-scale open path greenhouse gas monitoring
abstract: We demonstrate dual-comb spectroscopy over a 11.6-km long urban open air path. The system provides time-resolved, high accuracy measurements of atmospheric transmission in the 1.6 micron atmospheric window for greenhouse gas quantification.

articleTitle: Room temperature CW 1.3 μm single mode lasing of InAs quantum dot micro-disk lasers grown on (001) Si
abstract: Heteroepitaxially grown InAs quantum dot micro-disk lasers were demonstrated on planar Si (001) substrates. Room-temperature continuous-wave lasing 1.3 μm with a threshold pump power of 250 μW was achieved for a 4 μm disk.

articleTitle: Planar microparticle assembly and photopolymerized joining with holographic optical tweezers
abstract: Holographic optical tweezers are able to assemble and permanently join polystyrene microspheres into planar patterns using an acrylamide-based photopolymerization reaction. This approach holds potential as a new method for additive fabrication of multi-material microstructures.

articleTitle: Structural phase progression in photo-excited VO2
abstract: We reveal inhomogeneous structural phase transformation in photo-excited VO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> thin films by time-resolved X-ray diffraction microscopy. The in-plane plane phase progression is a result of displacive lattice transformation rather than driven by thermal transport.

articleTitle: Record fifth-harmonic-generation efficiency producing 211-nm pulses using cesium lithium borate
abstract: The fifth harmonic of a pulsed Nd:YLF laser has been realized in a cascade of nonlinear crystals with a record efficiency of 25%. An output energy of 250 mJ was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Frequency modulate laser based interferometric optical gyroscope
abstract: We report the performance of a high-speed frequency modulated laser based interferometric optical gyroscope. The motivation lies in the advantages of a laser based system enabled on advanced integrated optics. We demonstrate that this approach improves both angular random walk and bias stability.

articleTitle: Cell and tissue response to modified by laser-induced periodic surface structures biocompatible materials for dental implants
abstract: The use of femtosecond laser-induced periodic surface structures (LIPSS) for dental implants surface modification for improving cell adhesion and proliferation is reported. Results demonstrated higher response of cells on modified surface compared to untreated ones.

articleTitle: A 100J-level nanosecond pulsed DPSSL
abstract: We report the generation of 108 J pulses of duration 10 ns at 1 Hz with a conversion efficiency of 21% confirming the energy scalability of DiPOLE, a DPSSL based on cryogenically-cooled Yb:YAG amplifier technology.

articleTitle: Abnormal polarization in nitrogen ion laser fields induced by strong field ionization followed by seed amplification
abstract: We experimentally investigate elliptically polarized nitrogen ion laser fields by changing the polarization directions of the pump and probe pulses, which is interpreted as a result of strong birefringence of the gain medium near the wavelengths of the laser.

articleTitle: Broadband mid-infrared dual comb spectroscopy with independent asynchronous optical parametric oscillators
abstract: By using free-running femtosecond optical parametric oscillators with a repetition-rate difference > 200 Hz we demonstrate methane absorption spectroscopy at a resolution <; 0.2 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> and simultaneously covering the P, Q and R branches.

articleTitle: Real-time absolute frequency measurement of continuous-wave terahertz radiation using a free-running, dual-wavelength, dual-comb mode-locked fiber laser
abstract: A free-running, dual-wavelength mode-locked fiber laser is used for the real-time absolute frequency measurement of CW-THz radiation based on dual photo-carrier-THz-comb with different frequency spacing. This opens the door for compact and low-cost dual-THz-comb systems.

articleTitle: Mid-IR kerr frequency comb generation from 4000 to 10000 nm in a CMOS-compatible germanium microcavity
abstract: Ge/Si material combination is proposed for microresonator-based frequency combs in mid-IR. A new dispersion engineering approach is used, enabling octave-spanning mode-locked comb generation with a pump power as low as 190 mW.

articleTitle: Inter-channel interference mitigation of heterogeneous wavelength-overlapped channels of different baud rates and pulse shapes using nonlinear optical signal processing
abstract: An optical inter-channel interference mitigation approach for wavelength-overlapped channels with combinations of different baud rates and pulse shapes is experimentally demonstrated. The robustness of this approach is verified by OSNR improvements under distinct system configurations.

articleTitle: Towards low-loss mid-infrared waveguides in Ge-on-SOI
abstract: Mid-infrared waveguides of different Ge core thicknesses have been developed in Ge-on-SOI. Minimum propagation loss of ~8 dB/cm has been achieved for 0.85 μm thick Ge core using 3.682 μm laser excitation. The waveguides are transparent up to at least 3.82 μm.

articleTitle: Laser frequency stabilization using pound-drever-hall technique with an integrated TiO2 athermal resonator
abstract: We demonstrate frequency stabilization of a continuous-wave laser using an integrated TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> athermal cavity as a reference for the first time, and show linewidth improvement by a factor of 6 compared to a SiN cavity.

articleTitle: Saturable absorber decouples noise stabilization in dual-comb modelocked lasers
abstract: We present the stabilization and noise analysis of the pulse repetition rates of dual-comb modelocked lasers using an intracavity birefringent crystal for polarization-duplexing to obtain simultaneous emission of two modelocked beams from the same cavity.

articleTitle: Engineering spectral dispersion with multi-ordered optical metasurfaces using insertion-loss method
abstract: Metasurfaces as multi-ordered optical metatronic filters can be engineered using electronic circuit design procedures. Numerical examples with different functionality (low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, and band-stop) illustrate the ability of this procedure to synthesize optical frequency dispersion.

articleTitle: Ultrafast molecular structure determination of fragmentation pathways of acetylene
abstract: We apply laser-induced electron diffraction imaging driven by mid-IR electric waveforms towards probing molecular dynamics at few-femtosecond temporal resolutions. Combined with coincidence detection we can extract structural information of fragmentation pathways of acetylene.

articleTitle: Tunable microwave phase shifter with low RF-power variation based on high-Q epitaxial AlN ring resonator
abstract: A novel optically tunable microwave phase shifter is demonstrated based on high-Q (intrinsic quality factor ∼ 3.3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>) epitaxial AlN microring, exhibiting a tuning range of 0–332° and RF-power variation less than 3 dB for a 19 GHz signal.

articleTitle: High-efficiency UV superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors from amorphous MoSi
abstract: We demonstrate high-efficiency detection of 370 nm photons using superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors. The detectors employ amorphous MoSi (bulk T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> = 6.8 K) to enable operation on a compact cryocooler system.

articleTitle: 4.3-Cycle near-infrared pulses from a degenerate 1-GHz optical parametric oscillator
abstract: We report transform-limited 23-fs pulses at 1.6-μm from a degenerate 1-GHz optical parametric oscillator (OPO), supported by a 169-nm FWHM bandwidth. This OPO forms the basis for a frequency comb for astronomical spectrograph calibration.

articleTitle: A two-channel source of spectrally degenerate polarization entangled states on chip
abstract: In the last years the increasing complexity of quantum information protocols triggered the development of integrated waveguide technology for quantum applications [1–3] such that stability is intrinsically obtained thanks to the combination of many optical elements on a monolithic chip and scalability is potentially achievable. In this context the realization of integrated sources of quantum light is of fundamental interest. Some experimental implementations using parametric down conversion in nonlinear materials [4], as well as in semiconductors [5] have been reported. However, in the landscape of integrated devices, the realization of one important source of entangled states is still missing: a source of spectrally indistinguishable photon pairs emitted on two different spatial modes, which share entanglement in the polarization degree of freedom without the need of post-selection. This source is widely adopted in bulk setups [6], indeed entanglement is a fundamental requirement for quantum information purposes and the polarization of photons is the most used degree of freedom for quantum information encoding. However the implementation of such a scheme in integrated waveguides is a challenging task due to the combination of orthogonal polarizations and the need of two different spatial modes.

articleTitle: Layer-dependent third-harmonic generation in multilayer graphene
abstract: We report third-harmonic generation in multilayer graphene on fused silica with layer numbers of up to <;50. Calibration of the thickness is carried out using atomic-force microscopy. High-contrast microscopy demonstrates its layer-dependence and coherent nature.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive wavelength conversion of real-time coherent 100G channel by signal translation across C-band
abstract: We demonstrated a polarization-insensitive, ultra-wide range wavelength converter by cascading an integrated coherent receiver with a DP-IQ modulator. Conversion of a real-time 100G channel was done at ROADM node with error-free operation after 1,068-km transmission.

articleTitle: Focusing of terahertz waves by self-complementary meta-atom toward electromagnetically induced transparency
abstract: We reported unique characteristics of self-complementary meta-atoms (SCMs) by combining two opposite structures. Experimental results of fabricated meta-atoms well agreed with simulation results and verified that the proposed SCMs could realize electromagnetically induced transparency analogue.

articleTitle: Topological lasers
abstract: We present the first topological laser: topologically-protected lasing in photonic honeycomb lattices. We show that the lasing modes are unidirectional and robust to defects.

articleTitle: Higher order mode suppression in high-Q anomalous dispersion SiN microresonators for temporal dissipative Kerr soliton formation
abstract: Frequency comb generation based on dissipative Kerr solitons (DKS) in microresonators is important for many applications. We show higher order mode suppression in silicon nitride microresonators, that reduces avoided modal crossing to enable DKS generation.

articleTitle: Silicon carbide microdisk on silicon pillar probed by evanescent coupling
abstract: We present fabrication, simulation and characterization of silicon carbide microdisk on silicon pillar aiming at non-linear operation from near-infrared to mid-infrared. We report experimental Q factor of 1800 at telecom wavelength.

articleTitle: Evanescent guiding of acoustic waves for chip-scale optomechanical circuits
abstract: We investigate evanescent guiding of acoustic waves in solids without suspension by utilizing impedance contrast in silicon-based materials. This enables construction of waveguides, resonators and other building blocks to form complex optomechanical circuits.

articleTitle: QPSK regeneration without active phase-locking
abstract: QPSK regeneration without active phase stabilization is investigated in numerical simulations. We propose an improved scheme for phase-locking free QPSK regeneration showing significant improvements in the error vector magnitude of the signal.

articleTitle: Laser beam cutting — A mature and still advancing laser application becomes calculable
abstract: Laser cutting models provide solutions, varying from analytical steady-state equations based on singular physical sub-processes easily to be calculated, to fully numerical time dependent simulations requiring several days for the calculation of a single cut. In order to solve this dilemma CALCut calculates the three-dimensional, steady-state process including all relevant sub-processes by a combination of semi-analytical and semi-numerical algorithms. Systematic parameter screening is enabled.

articleTitle: Non-linear behavior of ring-down time in cavity ring-down spectroscopy with tapered fibers
abstract: The effect of surrounding refractive index (n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) on ring-down time (τ) is studied in conventional and amplified cavity ring-down spectroscopy with tapered fibers. Simulation and experimental results indicate that τ varies as rational function of n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Raman self-frequency shift of dissipative Kerr solitons in an optical microresonator
abstract: We experimentally observed the Raman-induced self-frequency shift of high-intensity dissipative Kerr solitons in high-Q silicon nitride microresonators. The Raman redshift is linearly dependent on the pump-frequency-detuning, associated with the tunability of the soliton pulse duration.

articleTitle: Integrated optical frequency shifter on a silicon platform
abstract: An integrated optical frequency shifter on a standard silicon photonics platform completely fabricated in a CMOS pilot line and showing MHz frequency shifts with a sideband suppression ratio up to 36 dB is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Strong field above threshold ionization of rydberg electrons localized to a gold nanotip
abstract: We report the first observation of atomic-like above-threshold-ionization from a gold nanotip by exciting long-lived Rydberg electron wave packets. These results transfer high harmonic generation and attosecond gating techniques from atoms to solid state nanostructures.

articleTitle: Whispering gallery modes in a single silica microparticle attached to an optical microfiber
abstract: A stable and compact structure is experimentally demonstrated to excite whispering gallery modes in a silica microparticle (~10 μm) attached to a microfiber. With extinction ratios over 15 dB, Q factors over 450 are achieved.

articleTitle: Coherent evolution of inhomogeneous exciton/biexciton system in an InAs quantum dot ensemble
abstract: We study the coherent evolution of inhomogeneously broadend exciton/biexciton system in an InAs quantum dot ensemble using pre-pulse 2D coherent spectroscopy and successfully reproduce their behavior by the calculation of 4 level optical Bloch equation.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional fluorescence spectroscopy of Al in laser-produced plasmas
abstract: We present tunable laser induced fluorescence of selected Al transitions in a laser produced plasma at atmospheric pressure levels. Two-dimensional mapping of absorption-emission spectroscopy of Al transitions is made.

articleTitle: Optical technology development for mouse brain imaging
abstract: Optical imaging of the structure and function deep within a mouse brain is a major scientific challenge in neuroscience. We review recent advances in multiphoton microscopy for mouse brain imaging, and discuss some future directions.

articleTitle: Cnoidal waves in microresonators
abstract: Cnoidal waves are the periodic analogs of solitons. Like solitons, they can be generated in microresonators and correspond to frequency combs. We describe their properties and potential uses.

articleTitle: On-chip rectangular microwave photonicperiodic filter with large bandwidth tunability
abstract: A rectangular microwave photonicfilter is proposed using on-chip silicon nitride ring resonators. The bandwidth of such filter can be largely adjusted from 1GHz to 13GHz in a very simple scheme.

articleTitle: Ytterbium-doped 30/400 LMA fibers with a record-low ∼NA of 0.028
abstract: We report ytterbium-doped LMA fibers with ~30μ and ~40μ cores and a record-low NA of 0.028, i.e. ΔN=2.7times;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> critical for overcoming transverse-mode-instability threshold in single-mode fiber lasers and made possible by an innovative fabrication process.

articleTitle: Sulfur-hyperdoped silicon photodetector with broadband spectral response and high gain at low bias
abstract: Sulfur-hyperdoped silicon photodetector prepared by femtosecond laser exhibits high gain with broadband spectral response ranging from 400 to 1200 nm, with external quantum efficiency > 28000% at 1100 nm at 5 V reverse bias voltage.

articleTitle: High-resolution optical coherence microscopy using highpower supercontinuum source in 1700 nm spectral band
abstract: We developed high-resolution optical coherence microscopy using a high-power supercontinuum source in 1700 nm spectral band, and demonstrated to image biological samples with 1.4 μm lateral and 2.8 μm axial resolution at high imaging depth.

articleTitle: Synchronously-pumped microring resonator for efficient optical comb generation
abstract: Synchronous pumping of microring resonators is proposed for power-efficient optical comb generation. It is shown that the average power requirement is reduced by the duty cycle of the pulse, when compared with the continuous-wave case.

articleTitle: Mode division multiplexed 3 × 28 Gbit/s on-chip photonic interconnects
abstract: We demonstrate a single wavelength 3×28 Gbit/s mode division multiplexed on-chip communications link with integrated optical modulators and mode add-drops. The mode crosstalk was less than -30 dB for optical wavelengths between 1530 nm and 1540 nm.

articleTitle: Optical gradient force between coupled graphene sheets
abstract: Optical gradient force between monolayer graphene sheets at mid-infrared frequencies is theoretically investigated for the first time.

articleTitle: Polarization-rotatable terahertz wave source generated in argon cluster plasma produced by double pulse-laser beams
abstract: Irradiating double pulse-laser beams into cluster gas, THz wave emission is enhanced 10 times as much as that for a single laser beam. The emission polarization is rotatable by changing directivities of the two beams.

articleTitle: 2.1 μm picosecond source generating 7 W at 80 MHz
abstract: We report an Yb-fiber-pumped, high-power, linearly polarized, picosecond source operating at 2.1 μm, providing as much as 7.1 W of average power at 39.4% conversion efficiency in 20 ps pulses at 79.3 MHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Simultaneous measurement of distance and temperature using FBGs and two-photon absorption process in Si-APD
abstract: We propose simultaneous measurement of distance and temperature using a multipoint sensor based on fiber Bragg gratings and two-photon absorption process in a silicon avalanche photodiode. Proof-of-concept experiments demonstrate high precision measurement.

articleTitle: Tomographic reconstruction of circularly polarized high harmonic fields
abstract: Using laser-dressed photoelectron spectroscopy from solids, we completely characterized the circularly polarized harmonics and reconstructed the complex 3D waveform of the circularly polarized attosecond pulse train.

articleTitle: 87-W, 1018-nm Yb-fiber ultrafast seeding source for cryogenic Yb:YLF amplifier
abstract: We demonstrate a compact Ytterbium-fiber MOPA system operating at 1018 nm, serving as powerful and compatible seed for cryogenically-cooled Yb:YLF amplifier. The output average power reaches 87 W with pulse energy of 4.9 μJ.

articleTitle: 3 μm MIR comb generation based on high repetition rate Er-doped fiber laser with carbon nanotube
abstract: Offset-free, MIR comb was stably generated around 3 μm wavelength through DFG pumped by supercontinuum generated with high repetition rate, Er-doped, single wall carbon nanotube fiber laser and dispersion shifted highly nonlinear fiber.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal localization of intense pulses in gas-filled capillaries
abstract: We investigate pulse propagation from the ultraviolet to the mid-infrared in gas-filled capillaries. For shorter wavelength pulses and smaller capillary diameters, ionization-induced refraction excites higher-order modes, and their constructive interference leads to spatio-temporal localization.

articleTitle: Optimal tuning fork for quartz enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy
abstract: Two custom tuning forks for quartz enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy have been designed using analytical geometry optimization. Their performances are presented and they will be used in experiments to further improve the sensibility of the technique.

articleTitle: Giant collective incoherent shock waves in strongly nonlinear turbulent flows
abstract: Contrary to conventional coherent shocks, we show theoretically and experimentally that nonlocal turbulent flows lead to the emergence of large-scale incoherent shock waves, which constitute a collective phenomenon of the incoherent field as a whole.

articleTitle: Visible supercontinuum generation in a low DGD graded index multimode fiber
abstract: We demonstrate over two octaves supercontinuum generation in a graded index multimode fiber using a picosecond microchip laser at 1064 nm. Enhanced visible supercontinuum is obtained in a tunable fashion based on initial launching conditions.

articleTitle: Collapse regularization of filaments by resonant radiation
abstract: We show that the transfer of optical power via emission of resonant radiation plays an important role for regularizing the optical collapse enabling stable filament propagation of high-power near-infrared pulses in bulk silica.

articleTitle: Generation of 800 nJ, 133 nm femtosecond vacuum UV pulses by third harmonic generation in argon
abstract: High energy of up to 800 nJ Vacuum UV pulses at 133 nm were generated by frequency tripling of second harmonic pulses of a Ti:sapphire amplifier in argon. Numerical simulations suggest six-wave-mixing as underlying nonlinear process.

articleTitle: Novel saturable absorbers for mode-locked Tm:ZBLAN waveguide chip lasers
abstract: Novel saturable absorbers based on carbon nanotubes, graphene, topological insulators, transition metal dichalcogenides and black phosphorus were fabricated and characterized. Their performance for short pulse generation in Tm:ZBLAN waveguide chip lasers was analyzed. For the first time to our knowledge, Q-switched mode-locked operation of a mid-IR ZBLAN waveguide chip laser was realized using topological insulators.

articleTitle: Cerenkov radiation from particles carrying orbital angular momentum in a cylindrical waveguide
abstract: We find the Cerenkov radiation emitted from charged particles carrying OAM in a cylindrical waveguide. The spectrum contains sharp resonances correlated to the particle's OAM, offering a novel spectroscopy method for OAM of charged particles.

articleTitle: Enhancement of spatial resolution in distributed measurement of Brillouin dynamic grating spectrum by optical correlation domain analysis
abstract: We demonstrated the spatial resolution in distributed and discriminative measurement of temperature and strain by optical correlation domain analysis with Brillouin dynamic grating could be improved by applying apodization to read wave.

articleTitle: Characterization of spectral and temporal properties of plasma-based XUV laser pulses
abstract: We review our recent work devoted to the experimental characterization and numerical simulations of XUV laser pulses generated from hot and dense plasmas. We discuss the specific properties exhibited by few-picosecond, partially coherent pulses arising from Amplification of Spontaneous Emission. We describe our ongoing effort to develop a single-shot time-resolved measurement tool adapted to shorter, femtosecond pulses, which are foreseen with advanced seeded XUV lasers developed in several laboratories.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a robust second-order correlation for twin parametric beams above threshold
abstract: We report the first correlation measurement between the twin beams generated by optical parametric process above threshold. This high-visibility correlation can be observed at significant power levels with up to a conversion efficiency of 19.7%.

articleTitle: Engineered far-fields of metal-metal terahertz quantum cascade lasers with integrated planar horn structures
abstract: The far-field emission profile of terahertz quantum cascade lasers (QCLs) in metal-metal waveguides is controlled in directionality and form through planar horn-type shape structures, whilst conserving a broad spectral response.

articleTitle: Towards a large-area plasmonic polarization detector
abstract: We demonstrate an approach that can characterize the polarization of incident light using a plasmonic crystal realized via bottom up fabrication technique. The concept of spin-orbit interaction is invoked to explain the observed effects.

articleTitle: High-order sideband generation in semiconductors: Beyond the three step model
abstract: Measurements of high-order sideband generation and absorption as a function of near-ir frequency in strong monochromatic sub-THz fields highlight opportunities to explore recollision physics in regimes that are difficult to access in atomic systems.

articleTitle: Quantum-shot-noise-driven optical antennas
abstract: Optical antennas so far have been driven by irradiation of light or by optical pumping of nearby emitters. Electrical driving - as is common for radiowave antennas - has not been possible due to the high frequencies that would be required. We show that electrical driving of an optical antenna is possible via the quantum shot noise that is created by electrons that tunnel across the antenna's atomic scale feedgap. Although the quantum shot noise has a broad frequency distribution, the resulting spectrum of the emitted photons is determined by the antenna resonance and the applied voltage. The spatial pattern and the polarization of the emitted photons is also determined by the antenna geometry.

articleTitle: An 8 kHz linewidth, 50 mW output wavelength tunable DFB LD array over the C-band with self optical feedback
abstract: A narrow linewidth, high output-power tunable DFB-LD array with self optical feedback is demonstrated. A linewidth of less than 8 kHz and an output power of above 50 mW over the C-band are simultaneously achieved.

articleTitle: Transient spatiotemporal optimization of octave-spanning Ti:Sapphire oscillators
abstract: The complete spatiotemporal dynamics in an octave-spanning oscillator is captured to further optimize its transform-limited pulse duration and beam profile for simultaneous short pulse generation and CEP locking.

articleTitle: Plasmonic hot—electron transfer in the strong coupling regime
abstract: Hybrid states that result from strong light-matter coupling have been shown to exhibit material properties that differ significantly from those of the uncoupled states, including the work function[1], chemical reactivity[2], ultra-fast energy relaxation[3, 4] and electrical conductivity[5]. In this talk we will show that waveguide-plasmon polaritons, which result from the strong coupling of localised plasmon resonances in metal nanowires and waveguide modes (see diagram of figure 1), result in hybrid states exhibiting hot-electron characteristics that are modulated by the degree of plasmon-exciton coupling. Ultra-fast visible pump, near-IR probe spectroscopy measurements reveal a strong correlation between the amplitude of the transient signals, attributed to electrons residing in the semiconductor, and the degree of hybridization of waveguide and plasmon excitations. Our work has potential implications for the design of efficient opto-electronic devices that exploit plasmonic hot carrier phenomena.

articleTitle: Visible laser oscillation in single-mode Pr-doped double-clad structured waterproof fluoro-aluminate glass fiber
abstract: We demonstrated a visible laser oscillation in a Pr-doped double-clad structured waterproof fluoro-aluminate glass fiber. The maximum output power and the slope efficiency were measured to be 251.7 mW at 639.0 nm and 43.4%, respectively.

articleTitle: Multispectral chiral imaging with a planar lens
abstract: We report for the first time chiral imaging using a single planar meta-lens. Using only this meta-lens and a camera, chiroptical properties of a biological specimen is mapped across the visible spectrum.

articleTitle: PHz-wide spectral interference through plasma-induced fission of higher order solitons
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate plasma-induced soliton fission in a gas-filled photonic crystal fiber. Launching few μJ, 30 fs pulses at 1030 nm, PHz-wide spectral beating is observed as a result of pulse splitting and spectral interference.

articleTitle: Intensity noise coupling in soliton fiber oscillators
abstract: We show experimentally and numerically that pump intensity noise in soliton fiber oscillators is predominantly coupled to the Kelly sidebands, while noise coupling to the soliton is damped.

articleTitle: A quarter century of photonic crystal fibre
abstract: Since their appearance two decades ago, PCFs have triggered a range of unique advances in light-matter interactions, including ultrabroadband supercontinuum generation, enhanced optomechanical nonlinearities, OAM-preserving twisted PCFs and diffraction-free pulse compression and nonlinear frequency conversion in gases.

articleTitle: Gate tunable THz plasmon generation on graphene based semiconductor chip via backward 2nd order nonlinearity
abstract: We demonstrate a graphene-alumina-graphene heterostructured semiconductor chip, on which THz plasmons are generated via backward phase-matched 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> nonlinearity all-optically. The on-chip plasmons are effectively gate tunable, with photon-efficiency ~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>, and Q factor > 60.

articleTitle: Mid-IR pulse post-compression in hollow-core waveguide
abstract: We report on 3.2 μm pulse post-compression via spectral broadening in hollow core capillary filled with noble gas. The mid-IR input pulses are generated in a femtosecond OPA based on KTA crystals, which delivers 6 mJ, 80 fs, 3.2 μm CEP-stable idler pulses. Pulses were spectrally broadened in a 3 meter long differentially pumped hollow-core capillary with ∼50% transmission and a statically filled 50 cm capillary. The spectrally broadened pulses were compressed in a CaF2 bulk material down to 31 fs and pulse bandwidth supporting Fourier-limited pulse duration below 15 fs were obtained, which corresponds to sub-two cycle pulse at this wavelength.

articleTitle: All-optical phase-preserved format conversion between QPSK and 2×BPSK based on FWM in a double-pass scheme
abstract: We proposed and experimentally demonstrated an all-optical phase-preserved format conversion from a 25-Gbps NRZ-QPSK signal to 2×12.5-Gbps NRZ-BPSK signals by applying FWM in a bidirectional orthogonally propagating architecture.

articleTitle: Useful light from photonic crystal fibres
abstract: Good lasers are few and far between - limited wavelength availability and often a limited selection of pulse types. The linear and nonlinear properties of photonic crystal fibre offer opportunities for bridging the gaps.

articleTitle: Hybridized fabrication of robust low-loss multimaterial chalcogenide fiber for infrared applications
abstract: Double-crucible cane fabrication of highly purified chalcogenide-glass was combined with multimaterial thermal fiber drawing to produce robust low-loss 0.2 NA chalcogenide fibers monolithically provided with a polymer jacket and featuring losses <;1 dB/m across the infrared.

articleTitle: Towards on-chip, tunable X-ray sources based on graphene plasmons
abstract: Leveraging the high field confinement of graphene plasmons enables the creation of table-top and chip-scale sources of intense, monochromatic, directional and robustly tunable free-electron sources from the IR to hard X-ray regime.

articleTitle: Compact mode-locked diode laser system for precision frequency comparisons in microgravity experiments
abstract: We present a compact mode-locked diode laser designed to generate a frequency comb in the wavelength range of 780 nm. The spectral bandwidth exceeds 15 nm (- 20 dB level) with 3.4 GHz mode spacing.

articleTitle: Big science in small packages: A constellation of cubesats to search for near earth asteroids
abstract: Astronomers for many decades have been searching for Near Earth Asteroids (NEA) that could potentially impact the Earth in the future. Large Synoptic Survey Telescope (LSST), when completed, would be by far the most powerful tool for a ground-based search for NEAs. In space, IR telescopes are undergoing detailed design studies. These facilities are projected to find 90% of potentially hazardous NEAs in about a dozen years. We introduce a different approach to search for these objects by using multiple micro- and nano-spacecraft distributed in orbit around the Sun. Their ability to faint moving objects with small telescopes is based on a new generation of low noise, fast-frame cameras combined with processors that can execute 100's of gigaflops in a low power space environment.

articleTitle: Coherent spectral characteristics of passive and active dual-racetrack resonators
abstract: Dual-racetrack resonator structures are experimentally investigated. A single spectral is observed in each free-spectral range and the spectral phase variation indicates sufficient phase dynamic range. Electro-optic tuning of the structure produces rich coherent behaviors.

articleTitle: Triply-resonant continuous wave parametric source with a microwatt pump
abstract: We demonstrate a record high normalized conversion efficiency of 3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> in coupled high-Q photonic crystal resonators, owing to resonantly enhanced four wave mixing. The rate of spontaneously emitted photons reaches 14 MHz.

articleTitle: Asymmetric second harmonic generation in anisotropic plasmonic crystals
abstract: Strong angular asymmetry of second harmonic generation (SHG) is observed in an anisotropic plasmonic crystal. The asymmetry is enhanced up to 95% by the surface plasmon polariton (SPP) excitation at the anisotropic interface. The SHG output is shown to be sentitive to the SPP propagation direction.

articleTitle: High-precision spectroscopy using ultra-compact lasers
abstract: We demonstrate high-precision spectroscopy of molecular iodine using ultra-compact diode laser modules at 531, 561 and 594 nm. Entire hyperfine structures of iodine lines are obtained with a linewidth of a few MHz.

articleTitle: Analysis of energy transfer processes for exciting in Cr3+ 4T1 level of Nd/Cr:YAG materials
abstract: Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> fluorescences excited in Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+ 4</sup>T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> level for Cr:YAG and Nd/Cr:YAG powders were measured. The energy transfer efficiency from Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> to Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> was increased from 68% to 78% with increasing concentration of Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional photoacoustic imaging using robotically tracked transrectal ultrasound probe with elevational synthetic aperture focusing
abstract: Three-dimensional photoacoustic imaging using robotically tracked transrectal ultrasound probe is introduced to improve brachytherapy seeds detectability. The feasibility was experimentally demonstrated, and synthetic aperture focusing improved elevational resolution and signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Acoustic wave induced Mach-Zehnder interferometer based on a sandwich-structured single mode fiber
abstract: An in-fiber acoustic wave induced tunable Mach-Zehnder interferometer based on a sandwich-structured single mode fiber was demonstrated. The proposed configuration gains advantage of simple structure and fast tuning speed.

articleTitle: Effect of dielectric interfaces on second-harmonic generation in integrated GaN resonators
abstract: We investigate the influence of second-harmonic generation efficiency through choice of dielectric cladding for a GaN integrated ring resonator. Our devices suggest cladding can enhance or inhibit intrinsic nonlinearities through electric field induced second harmonic (EFISH) contribution.

articleTitle: Towards mid-IR waveguide lasers: Transition metal doped ZnS thin films
abstract: Thin films of Cr and Fe-doped ZnS suitable for waveguide mid-IR applications, with well-isolated TM<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> peaks, and Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> absorption and fluorescence comparable to bulk crystals were investigated. Raman data indicate that the TM is substitutional.

articleTitle: Low chirp operation of transverse-coupled-cavity VCSELs
abstract: We present the coupling mode modeling and experimental measurements on the frequency chirp of the transverse-coupled-cavity VCSELs (TCC VCSELs). The simulation and experimental results both show a 3-dB-modulation bandwidth enhancement and chirp reduction simultaneously.

articleTitle: Demonstration of frequency conversion at an optical event horizon with cross polarized waves in birefringent nanophotonic waveguides
abstract: The frequency conversion of a probe beam by reflection on a soliton propagating in a birefringent nanophotonic waveguide is experimentally and numerically demonstrated using cross-polarized waves. A frequency conversion almost pump wavelength independent is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Atom-surface Van der Waals potential induced sub-Doppler transparencies in Rb vapor filled Kagome HC-PCF
abstract: We report on experimental observation of sub-Doppler transparencies in Rb filled HC-PCF. A theoretical analysis shows that they result from the optical pumping of wall trapped atoms into off-resonant spin state.

articleTitle: Investigation of semi-polar GaN Grown on (0001) C-plane nano-sized patterned-sapphire substrates
abstract: This paper reported the growth of semi-polar GaN epi-layers on (0001) c-plane nano-sized patterned-sapphire substrates (c-NPSSs). In addition, the impact of c-NPSSs on the quality of semi-polar film had also been studied.

articleTitle: High-speed InP-based quantum dot lasers with low temperature sensitivity
abstract: We report temperature insensitive high speed InAs/InP quantum dot lasers. At 14°C-60°C, the bandwidth is respectively 15–13GHz, at 8°C it is 8GHz. 25Gbit/s under constant drive parameters at 14–60°C and 32Gbit/s at 14°C were demonstrated.

articleTitle: A novel InSb-based photo-pixel with a monolithically integrated GaAs MESFET for video rate sampling
abstract: We demonstrate the monolithic integration of an active photo-pixel made in InSb on a GaAs substrate. Video rate sampling of photo-generated signal can be provided by the co-integration of a GaAs MESFET with an InSb photodiode.

articleTitle: On-chip spectral broadening of kerr frequency combs: Towards a fully integrated frequency metrology system with f-2f self-reference
abstract: Spectral broadening of on-chip microresonator-based frequency combs is studied, aiming at f-2f self-referenced comb stabilization, with an emphasis on feasibility of making all devices fully integrated on a single chip.

articleTitle: Dispersion compensation using chirped long period gratings
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, the use of a broadband (13.8nm) chirped long period fiber grating as an ultra-low loss (<;0.1dB) transmissive dispersion device, of potential utility in ultrashort-pulse fiber laser cavity design.

articleTitle: Real time observations of soliton bound states, with multiple binding mechanisms, in passive nonlinear cavities
abstract: We resolve in real-time the dynamics of bound states of temporal cavity solitons in a passive driven nonlinear resonator, and identify several new binding mechanisms involving Gordon/Kelly sidebands, birefringence, and dispersive waves.

articleTitle: Terahertz nanogap enabled phase transition engineering on vanadium dioxide
abstract: We investigate terahertz transmission through nanogap-patterned vanadium dioxide thin film. It is found that the nanogap structure allows the temperature shift of the apparent phase transition described by the normalized terahertz transmission.

articleTitle: Enhanced psuedo-random phase modulation for high power fiber amplifiers
abstract: A low-pass filter is used to suppress the high-frequency components of a PRBS signal and is used to modulate a fiber amplifier. Notably, the coherence length and SBS threshold of a kilowatt-class amplifier are increased.

articleTitle: An on-chip multi-wavelength photonic-phononic memory
abstract: We demonstrate the first integrated multi-wavelength photonic-phononic memory. The memory is based on stimulated Brillouin scattering and enables the storage of light pulses as acoustic phonons up to the acoustic lifetime.

articleTitle: Remote synchronization of a microwave clock to an optical clock at the femtosecond level
abstract: We show tight synchronization of a 10-GHz microwave oscillator to an optical clock across a 4-km intermittent free-space link. The microwave clock remains synchronized to within tens of femtoseconds.

articleTitle: Second- and third-harmonic generation nonlinear stokes-mueller polarimetric microscopy
abstract: Nonlinear Stokes-Mueller polarimetric (NSMP) microscopy using second-and third-harmonic generation is demonstrated for muscle and β-carotene crystallites. The complete polarimetric data from the sample reveals model-independent ultrastructure within each voxel of the image.

articleTitle: Second-order coherence measurement of a metallic coaxial nanolaser
abstract: The second-order coherence function is measured for a metallic coaxial nanolaser using a modified Hanbury Brown-Twiss technique. The results indicate that such nanoscale lasers can indeed generate coherent radiation.

articleTitle: Perovskite metamaterials
abstract: We report the first dielectric metamaterials nanostructured from solution-processed organolead halide perovskite thin films. Metamaterials exhibit strong resonances tunable by design across the visible spectrum, aiming applications in enhanced photovoltaics and light-emitting devices.

articleTitle: AM-to-PM conversion in silicon p-i-n photodiodes
abstract: Under femtosecond pulse illumination the AM-to-PM conversion gain of a silicon p-i-n photodiode was measured to be as high as 7 dB below the AM and exhibits deep nulls at discrete photocurrents with bias dependence.

articleTitle: Backward-pumped 1550 nm EYDF amplifier with ASE suppression by cladding feedback
abstract: We demonstrate a backward-pumped 1550 nm EYDF amplifier with ASE suppression by cladding feedback. Compared with the typical backward-pumped amplifier without feedback, the ASE power can be suppressed by over 2 dB without other filters.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of coherent beam combining with a two-dimensional conformal fiber laser array
abstract: In this manuscript, we present an experimental demonstration of coherent beam combining (CBC) with a two-dimensional conformal fiber laser array utilizing homemade adaptive fiber-optics collimator (AFOC) based on flexible hinges with simultaneous end-cap/tilt control and phase-locking control. The deflection displacements of the AFOC is in range of 0~48 μm in X direction and 0~34 μm in Y direction, and the effective working frequency of the device is about 700 Hz. Moreover, the conformal CBC system of three fiber lasers using the new type of AFOC is successfully achieved. Experimental results show that the tilt control makes the three separate beams overlapped well. By analysis the results, the average voltage value in PD increases from 2.56V in open loop to 6.11V in closed loop. The fringe contrast is improved from 0% to more than 88% correspondingly.

articleTitle: Finite-difference elastic wave mode solver for acoustic waveguide design
abstract: We demonstrate an eigenmode solver for acoustic waveguides based on the isotropic, linear elastic wave equation. This approach is more computationally efficient than commercial solvers, and enables design of integrated acousto-optic waveguides.

articleTitle: Lossless integrated dirac-cone metamaterials
abstract: Zero-index metamaterials exhibit inherent losses due to poor confinement. We present a 2D photonic crystal that achieves isotropic impedance-matched zero-index propagation, but suffers no material or radiation loss due to a bound-state in the continuum.

articleTitle: Topological optical waveguiding in silicon and beating between trivial and topological defect modes
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate topologically protected optical waveguiding in silicon at the interface between two topologically distinct dimer chains. Further, we propose and demonstrate beating between topological and trivial defect modes.

articleTitle: Measuring the degree of coherence of microresonator frequency combs
abstract: We use spectral interferometry to experimentally measure the degree of coherence across the full bandwidth of microresonator-based frequency combs. Our results show distinct coherence characteristics for two different frequency combs, supporting previous theoretical findings.

articleTitle: Hut-like pillar Si solar cells
abstract: This paper introduces an exciting new hut-like texturing pattern that shows lower Reflectance than pyramids and nanowires in the shorter and longer wavelengths respectively.

articleTitle: M-type fiber for exploiting higher-order-modes dispersion for application in mid-IR supercontinuum generation
abstract: We demonstrate an M-type fiber suitable for launching higher-order-modes (such as LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">02</sub> LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">03</sub>) as core-confined-modes, while guiding LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> and other lower-order-modes in a ring. The M-type fiber can shift the zero-dispersion-wavelength of bulk-material by several 1000 nanometers.

articleTitle: Valley-polarized microcavity exciton-polaritons in a monolayer semiconductor
abstract: We demonstrate the valley-polarized photoluminescence of exciton-polaritons in monolayer MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> embedded in a dielectric microcavity using near-resonant excitation. The results are described by a model incorporating cavity-modified relaxation dynamics of coherent valley-specific exciton-polaritons.

articleTitle: A coded illumination scheme for single exposure (instantaneous) multispectral imaging
abstract: We present the development of an instantaneous multispectral imaging technique exploiting spatially modulated light. Each encoded excitation source produces an image with a predefined position in the Fourier domain, allowing them to be separated computationally.

articleTitle: Experimental generation of high-coherence sub-prime comb lines with multiple sub-lines in a Kerr frequency comb using dual pumps
abstract: The generation of primary sub-comb-lines with high coherence using dual pumps in a SiN microresonator is investigated. A total capacity of 400 Gbit/s has been experimentally demonstrated in coherent communications based on the generated combs.

articleTitle: Power budget enhancement in an IMDD PON downstream with multicarrier code division multiple access
abstract: A multicarrier code division multiple access technique is experimentally demonstrated to enhance both the power budget and the network flexibility in an IMDD PON with equalized receiving performance among all subscribers over 50 km transmission.

articleTitle: Themo-optic oscillation dynamics in a high-Q lithium niobate microresonator
abstract: We report intriguing thermo-optic oscillation dynamics, for the first time in a high-Q LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> microresonator that results from combined effects of thermal refraction, thermal expansion, and photo-refraction.

articleTitle: Thermal modeling and heat mitigation for femtosecond-laser-based silicon processing
abstract: Femtosecond laser processing of silicon has shown effective material removal, but with heat-induced formation of raised surface features. The surface heating phenomenon was simulated to optimize laser parameters for mitigating thermal effects in femtosecond processing.

articleTitle: A one-dimensional heterodyne lens-free OPA camera
abstract: This paper presents a thin silicon-photonics integrated one-dimensional lens-free camera based on an optical phased array receiver on an SOI process. The camera has beam steering range in excess of 60° with no blind spots, a beam width of 0.74°, and is used to form images.

articleTitle: Use of a laser-based open path instrument to provide continuous long-term measurements of methane emissions from two landfills
abstract: Landfills are important sources of CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions. Continuous, long-term measurements of CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> fluxes were made using eddy covariance. Methane production and oxidation were studied using a flux model that is presented.

articleTitle: Electronic control of exciton coherence in a charged quantum dot photonic waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate electronic control of the charged exciton optical coherence time in quantum dots embedded in a photonic ridge waveguide. Through electronic manipulation of the electron and hole wavefunctions, coherence is extended by ~50%.

articleTitle: Picosecond, ultraviolet fiber laser at 300MHz repetition rate: Resonant quantum logic gate source
abstract: We engineered a fiber laser source capable to produce 2.5ps UV pulses at 300MHz repetition rate. Laser wavelength resonates with one of the strong transition in Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> ion, and it will enable us to coherently manipulate Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> via π-transitions to make fast entangling gates.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of symmetric WDM-SDM optical access network over multicore fiber
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated the bidirectional symmetric WDM-SDM optical access network with 48 users over 20km multicore fiber, achieving 1Gb/s access rate per user.

articleTitle: Arrayed waveguide grating near 760 nm wavelength for integrated spectral beam combining applications
abstract: An arrayed waveguide grating operating near 760 nm is demonstrated with 0.1 dB insertion loss and -23 dB crosstalk. This device is compatible with a heterogeneously integrated ultra-broadband spectral beam combiner.

articleTitle: First investigation of the noise and modulation properties of the carrier envelope offset frequency in a modelocked semiconductor laser
abstract: We report the first characterization of the CEO-frequency in a modelocked semiconductor laser, in terms of noise and modulation bandwidth, performed using a novel approach that does not require an octave-spanning spectrum and a self-referencing scheme.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of intermodal four-wave mixing by femtosecond pump pulses at 1550 nm
abstract: Intermodal four-wave mixing is experimentally demonstrated by coupling femtosecond pulses at 1550 nm deep into normal dispersion region away from the second zero-dispersion wavelengths of the first two guided-modes of a homemade photonic crystal fiber.

articleTitle: Refractive index sensing through dual-wavelength fiber laser based on thinned FBG
abstract: A dual-wavelength fiber laser based on thinned FBG for sensing refractive index is demonstrated by interrogating the separation of the two lasing wavelengths. The refractive index resolution of ~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> is achieved.

articleTitle: Measuring isotope ratios of large molecules using a swept external cavity quantum cascade laser
abstract: We measure isotope ratios for species with broadband absorption features using a swept external cavity quantum cascade laser. Isotopic precisions of ~1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>/<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> (per mil) are demonstrated for methanol (MeOH/MeOD) and ethanol (EtOH/EtOD) vapor.

articleTitle: Double-layered photonic crystal slabs with guided-mode resonance as a high-sensitivity biosensor and application for single nanoparticle detection
abstract: Double-layered guided-mode resonance (GMR) biosensor is designed to achieve an ultra-high sensitivity of 937.64 nm/RIU based on photonic crystal slabs. In addition, we demonstrate a theoretical study of such high-performance sensor for single nanoparticle detection.

articleTitle: In vivo quantitation of circulating tumor cells by high-speed intravital laser-scanning confocal microscopy
abstract: By utilizing custom-design high-speed video-rate laser-scanning confocal microscope system for visualizing fast-flowing cells at the great saphenous vein of mouse, we quantitated circulating tumor cells of whole body blood, in vivo, by hemocytometric imaging analysis.

articleTitle: High efficient, compact and broadband 2×2 polarization beam splitter on silicon nitride
abstract: A 2×2 SiN polarization beam splitter is proposed. The device has >10 dB extinction ratio throughout the measured band (1530 to 1610 nm) with low insertion loss of 0.13 dB (TE) and 0.34 dB ™.

articleTitle: Novel iron-based amorphous transparent conducting oxide
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an amorphous ternary metal oxide of Fe, Tb, and Dy exhibiting high electronic conductivity, Hall mobility, and optical transparency driven by partly filled d- and f-subshells.

articleTitle: Investigation of inter-core cross-talk in cladding pumped double-clad 6-core erbium doped fiber amplifier
abstract: We investigated the cross-talk in 6-core erbium doped amplifiers. Results indicate that the amplifier has lower cross-talk when the fiber bending radius >30 mm. The bending induced pump distribution nonuniformity can be reduced by randomly-twisting the fiber.

articleTitle: Optomechanical plasmonic trapping
abstract: Non-invasive and ultra-accurate optical manipulation of nanometer objects has recently gained a growing interest as a powerful enabling tool in nanotechnology and biophysics. In this context, Self-Induced Back-Action (SIBA) trapping in nano-optical cavities has shown a unique potential for trapping and manipulating nanometer-sized objects under low optical intensities. Yet, the existence of the SIBA effect has so far only been evidenced indirectly by its enhanced trapping performances. In this article we present for the first time a direct experimental evidence of the self-reconfiguration of the optical potential experienced by a nanoparticle trapped in a plasmonic nanocavity. Our observations enable us to gain further understanding of the SIBA mechanism and to determine the optimum conditions to boost the performances of SIBA-based nano-optical tweezers.

articleTitle: Nanoscale hyperbolic metamaterial resonators in semiconductors
abstract: Sub-diffraction mid-infrared resonators were fabricated in a n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-InGaAs/AlInAs hyperbolic metamaterial. Coupling to localized modes is observed in angle-dependent reflection measurement and agrees well with finite element simulations using an anisotropic permittivity.

articleTitle: High quality factor Si3N4 ring resonators achieved by surface roughness reduction
