abstract: Reproducible ultrahigh SERS enhancement in deterministic plasmonic hotspots allows chemical events on the single molecule level to be observed in real time, including plasmon-driven dimerization of 4NBT to DMAB, DMAB desorption and trans-cis conformation switching.

articleTitle: Optical fiber lens with parabolic effective index profile fabricated using focused ion beam
abstract: We fabricate a graded-index lens on the tip of a single-mode optical fiber for fiber-to-waveguide coupling, using focused ion beam milling. The lens focuses a 10.4 μm mode into a beam size of 3.4 μm, at a wavelength of 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Ultrafast nonlinear terahertz spectroscopy of quantum condensates in solids
abstract: We investigated the collective amplitude mode, namely the Higgs mode in superconductors by using terahertz pump-probe spectroscopy. The study of coherent terahertz nonlinear interaction with the Higgs mode will be reported.

articleTitle: Wavefront control for deep tissue fluorescence microscopy
abstract: We present our work on using optical wavefront control to achieve large field-of-view high resolution calcium imaging deep in mouse brain and to perform high-speed volumetric imaging of awake and behaving animals.

articleTitle: Resonant germanium-on-silicon photodetector with evanescent waveguide coupling
abstract: A 4.5-μm-radius resonant germanium-on-silicon photodetector is first demonstrated with evanescent coupling from bus waveguide, achieving 2.03nA dark current, 1.04A/W responsivity at 1530nm, 32.9GHz electro-optic bandwidth and enhancement on responsivities for longer wavelengths (>0.3A/W at 1630nm).

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of metasurface on conventional optical fiber facet for linearly polarized mode (lp11) generation at visible light wavelength
abstract: We design and fabricate metasurface on the facet of conventional G.652 single mode fiber (SMF). We also experimentally investigate the linearly polarized mode (LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>) generation in SMF using the fabricated metasurface at the wavelength of 632.8 nm.

articleTitle: A compact two photon light sheet microscope for applications in neuroscience
abstract: We present a compact setup for two photon light sheet microscopy. By using pulsed Airy beam illumination we demonstrate eight-fold increase of the FOV compared to Gaussian light sheet with the same axial resolution.

articleTitle: Long-wave infrared source with 45 mJ pulse energy based on nonlinear conversion in ZnGeP2
abstract: Nanosecond pulses at 8 μm wavelength with 45 mJ energy and a beam quality of M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> = 3.1 are generated using a ZnGeP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-based master oscillator/power amplifier, pumped by a cryogenic Q-switched Ho:YLF laser.

articleTitle: Optical bound states of 2D high-contrast grating for refractometric sensing
abstract: We report the numerical study of optical bound states in the radiation continuum using a silicon-based 2D high-contrast grating. The results show two distinct bound states at 1549.2 nm and 1743.1 nm. The high-Q resonances present near the bound states are exploited as a label-free biosensor.

articleTitle: Influence of intrinsic phonon modes in nonlinear optical crystals on the performance of ultrafast frequency conversion devices
abstract: We demonstrate that coherently-excited Raman-/IR-active phonons in certain nonlinear optical crystals (KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, KTiOAsO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>) significantly affect the operation of ultrashort-pulse pumped optical parametric amplifiers. The photon-phonon coupling in these materials leads to non-instantaneous, pump-dependent 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-order susceptibility.

articleTitle: All photonic crystal electrically pumped CW mid-IR lasers
abstract: Electrically-pumped all-photonic-crystal lasers are reported on GaSb materials. Lasers show single-mode emission around 2.4 μm with more than 35 dB of SMSR over a wide range of currents.

articleTitle: Ultrafast photocurrent spectroscopy in a black phosphorus van der waals heterostructure
abstract: Ultrafast photocurrent spectroscopy is used to investigate the carrier lifetime of a black phosphorus heterostructure. Tuning the polarization reveals anisotropic response of the excitons with the optical field. Individual ultrafast pulses with a spacing of ∼1ns are resolved with our device.

articleTitle: Graded CRIGF filters for tunable external cavity lasers
abstract: Graded CRIGF filters were fabricated and characterized. When inserted in a three elements cat's eyes laser diode external cavity, they allow continuous tuning of the emission wavelength over 20 nm in the 850 nm range.

articleTitle: Retroactive terahertz displacement sensor in a standard 65nm CMOS technology
abstract: In this paper we demonstrate a self coherent terahertz system implemented in a standard a 65 nm CMOS technology for displacement sensing application. We name this method retroactive detection since no additional terahertz components are required to operate. The device main operating frequency is 0.35 THz in continuous-wave mode and operates at room temperature.

articleTitle: Coupled photonic crystal microcavities for high-Q sensing
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that resonances in a system of coupled L0-type photonic crystal microcavities can have higher quality factor (Q~15,000) than an uncoupled cavity (Q~4,000), which is critical for sensing applications. We study theoretically the origins of higher Q with respect to bonding and anti-bonding states of coupled photonic molecules.

articleTitle: A smartphone-based microplate reader for point-of-care ELISA quantification
abstract: We designed a hand-held and cost-effective smartphone-based microplate reader for quantification of colorimetric ELISA tests. This mobile-device, combined with machine learning, achieved >99% accuracy for the measurement of mumps, measles, and herpes-simplex-virus IgG ELISA tests.

articleTitle: A fresh look on the origin of nonlinear light scattering and photoluminescence from gold nanorods
abstract: Using electron holography, we have shown that gold nanorods with perfect structural symmetry are electrically anisotropic. We present a quantitative model that accounts for the spectrum, power scaling and the origin of the luminescence.

articleTitle: Efficient spectral bandwidth compression of single photon wavepackets
abstract: Sixfold spectral bandwidth compression of single photon wavepackets by means of electro-optic time lens is experimentally demonstrated. We significantly increase single photon flux through a narrowband spectral feature, making a key step in development of hybrid quantum networks.

articleTitle: Compressive optical imaging using a multi-core fiber and spatially dependent scattering
abstract: We demonstrate two-dimensional compressive image reconstruction from spatially-encoded illumination patterns generated by spatially-dependent scattering from a ground glass diffuser at the distal end of a multi-core fiber.

articleTitle: Fast graphene based plasmonic terahertz amplitude modulators
abstract: We present two graphene based plasmonic devices for the external optoelectronic amplitude modulation of THz radiation. Modulation depths as high as 8% and up to 50 MHz, for a 10 V potential difference are reported.

articleTitle: Dielectric laser acceleration of sub-100keV electrons with silicon dual pillar grating structures
abstract: We present the demonstration of high gradient (370 MeV/m) laser acceleration and deflection of sub-relativistic electrons with silicon dual pillar grating structures using both evanescent inverse Smith-Purcell modes and coupled cosh-like modes.

articleTitle: High-contrast time-multiplexed pulse-shaping systems
abstract: A process for optimizing a time-multiplexed pulse-shaping system generating up to eight shaped optical waveforms is described, leading to contrast better than 68 dB for four-channel operation and 46 dB for eight-channel operation.

articleTitle: Dilectric metasurfaces for polarization selective beam shaping
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the capability of dielectic metasurfaces in silicon to perform arbitrary polarization selective beam shaping.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of a multispectral infrared metamaterial detector
abstract: Infrared imaging systems require new technologies at the pixel level to provide enhanced spectral sensitivity with similar function to cones and rods in the human retina. A multicolor imaging system can be accomplished with the aid of metamaterials to spectrally select and enhance a specific color from incoming radiation. In this work, we demonstrate the use of a metamaterial absorber design to enhance the quantum efficiency of an infrared interband cascade detector from 6.1% to 18.6% at a peak operating wavelength of 6.14μm and 4.1% to 14.7% at a peak operating wavelength of 7.13μm.

articleTitle: Digital micromirror device camera used for high-speed and high-resolution imaging
abstract: We incorporate the hardware restrictions of existing image sensors, implement a hardware prototype with a digital micromirror device (DMD) camera, and theoretically analyze the per-pixel coded exposure to realize high-speed and high-resolution imaging.

articleTitle: Analog logarithmic computing primitives with silicon photonics
abstract: Optical computing accelerators help alleviate bandwidth and power consumption bottlenecks in electronics. We introduce an approach for the implementation of logarithmic-type analog primitives in silicon photonics.

articleTitle: Bragg gratings will improve signal-to-noise in χ(3) degenerate photon-pair generation
abstract: Dual-pump photon-pair sources typically suffer from parasitic pair production. To circumvent this, we propose and design a source in which parasitic pairs are suppressed by proper engineering of photonic band gaps in a Bragg grating.

articleTitle: Polarization-tracking-free PDM IF-over-fiber mobile fronthaul employing multiband DDO-OFDM
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a polarization-tracking-free PDM IF-over-fiber mobile fronthaul with only a simple optical filter at each receiver for polarization demultiplexing the corresponding signal band. Both spectral and cost efficiencies are largely enhanced.

articleTitle: Holographic techniques for biomedical microscopy
abstract: Digital holography is an emerging technology in biomedical microscopy that yields high-sensitivity high-resolution quantitative images of cellular microscopic structures and processes. An overview of recent research and development of digital holographic microscopy will be presented.

articleTitle: Characterization of time-dependent ionization degree of gaseous media during high-harmonic generation
abstract: Plasma-induced frequency shift can be found in angularly resolved harmonic spectrographs by non-collinear high-harmonic generation. Based on the results we derive time-dependent ionization degree of the gaseous medium during high-harmonic conversion process.

articleTitle: Detection of greenhouse gas (N2O) using intracavity absorption spectroscopy (ICAS)
abstract: A fiber laser system was developed using a hollow-core photonic crystal fiber as a gas cell to detect one of the rotational lines of nitrous oxide gas in the 1.55 μm band.

articleTitle: A new beam shaping technique implemented in 150 W 1kHz repetition rate picosecond pulse amplifier
abstract: We present a practical implementation of a novel beam shaping technique (based on spatially variable phase retardation plate inscription in fused silica glass by femtosecond pulses) in a high average power picosecond pulses amplifier.

articleTitle: Vertically stacked heterostructures for tunable photonic devices — from 2D materials to hybrid perovskites
abstract: Here I discuss our recent effort in the assembly of vertical heterostructures from graphene, two-dimensional semiconductors and perovskite materials for the creation of diverse tunable photonic devices, including photodetection and light emitting devices.

articleTitle: Investigation of random lasing characteristics from dye-doped twisted nematic liquid crystals in wedge cell
abstract: The output polarization and slope efficiency of random laser could be controlled by the rubbing direction of PI and temperature, respectively, from dye-doped twisted nematic liquid crystals within wedge cell.

articleTitle: Free carrier induced nonlinear six-wave mixing in silicon
abstract: We report free carrier induced effective six-wave mixing in silicon. Unique features of this novel nonlinear wave mixing process, including strong detuning dependence, asymmetric sideband lineshape, and interactions with Kerr four-wave mixing are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Cavity-enhanced narrowband radiation of an electrically driven graphene light emitter
abstract: We present an electrically driven thermal emitter with spectrally enhanced narrowband radiation based on graphene and silicon photonic crystal cavities. Coupled to the cavity resonances, the emission of graphene show pronounced enhancement at the wavelengths around 1590 nm with a Q factor of 700.

articleTitle: Attosecond streaking measurements of extreme ultraviolet pulses using an infrared light source
abstract: Extreme ultraviolet pulses below the silicon L edge, generated as high harmonics using few-cycle optical pulses at 1600 nm from a millijoule BIBO OPCPA, are characterized by attosecond streaking with the long-wavelength electric field.

articleTitle: Optical access to topological insulator spin dynamics
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical access to topological-insulator ultrafast spin dynamics using transient-reflectivity measurements by controlling photon energy and polarization. Our approach distinguishes bulk and surface responses, providing a practical tool for studying topological insulator dynamics.

articleTitle: Ultrawide C- and L-band mode-locked erbium-doped fiber ring laser and its application in ultrafast microscopy
abstract: We report an ultrawide C- and L-band erbium-doped fiber ring laser with 92-nm bandwidth centered at 1550 nm and 44.5-MHz repetition rate. Furthermore, it was applied to ultrafast time-stretch microscopy.

articleTitle: Fabrication of aspherical glass molded lens using vitreous carbon mold
abstract: A cost-effective vitreous carbon (VC) mold was prepared for the molding of aspherical glass lens by carbonization of replicated furan precursor from the diamond turning machined aluminum master mold.

articleTitle: Laterally confined excitons in two-dimensional semiconductor quantum dots
abstract: We study size-tunable lateral quantum confinement of excitons in monolayer transition metal dichalcogenide nanoflakes. Exciton photoluminescence energy and valley polarization are compared between continuous and patterned monolayers in the weak confinement regime.

articleTitle: Quantitative characterisation of endoscopic imaging fibres
abstract: We describe a technique for the quantitative characterisation of endoscopic imaging fibres using interferometry. We demonstrate the use of our characterisation technique by comparing three fibres, two of which have identical structure but different scale.

articleTitle: Metasurface-based freeform optics for biosensing and augmented reality systems
abstract: We demonstrate the capability of metasurfaces for freeform optics by performing FDTD simulations of a metasurface-based lens with adjustable focal length, and conducting ray optics analysis to enable a small form-factor diffractive augmented reality visor.

articleTitle: Sub-picosecond pulse stability of passively mode-locked two-section quantum dash laser at ∼ 1550 nm subject to single and dual optical feedback
abstract: We report effects of varying feedback ratios and phases in dual-loop external optical feedback on phase-noise characteristics of passively mode-locked two-section quantum-dash lasers. Optimal feedback yields ~100× reductions in RF-linewidth.

articleTitle: Characterization of liquid absorption and emission spectra using linear variable filters integrated with a CMOS camera
abstract: A compact analysis platform for detecting liquid absorption and emission spectra using a set of linear variable filters atop a CMOS image sensor is presented to cover wide spectral ranges and provide low detection limits.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional holographic nonlinear metamaterials
abstract: We demonstrate full control of the nonlinear phase in 3D, multilayer metamaterials. Functional nonlinear optical elements are designed and fabricated, demonstrating capabilities to generate and shape light beams and computer generated nonlinear holography.

articleTitle: C-band swept wavelength erbium-doped fiber laser with a high-Q tunable interior-ridge silicon microring cavity
abstract: We demonstrate an erbium-doped fiber laser with a tunable silicon microring cavity. We measured a narrow laser linewidth (16 kHz) and single-mode continuous-wave emission over the C-band (1530nm-to-1560nm) at a swept-wavelength rate of 22,600nm/s or 3106THz/s.

articleTitle: Magnetization dynamics in cobalt thin films probed with femtosecond high harmonics pulses
abstract: We report on the ultrafast re-magnetization and precession dynamics, probed resonantly at the M-edge (56.7 eV) of 20 nm thick cobalt films, pumped by near IR pulses. The complementarity of the results, obtained in this T-MOKE HHG configuration, with visible NIR studies is discussed.

articleTitle: Single-frequency Nd:GGG/BaWO4 Raman laser emitting at 1178.3 nm
abstract: An actively Q-switched Nd:GGG/BaWO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> single-frequency Raman laser at 1178.3 nm is demonstrated. Under a pulse repetition rate of 20 kHz, the maximum pulse energy was 12 μJ and the linewidth was less than 4.34×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Unibody, compact, and lightweight Q-switched lasers enabled by additive manufacturing
abstract: This paper demonstrates additive manufacturing scheme to fabricate a compact and unibody solid-state lasers. Cellular structures, embedded cooling channels, flexure alignment structures were used to produce robust and lightweight Q-switched YAG lasers.

articleTitle: Real-time trace gas sensor using a high-power, multimode diode laser and cavity ring-down spectroscopy
abstract: A simple ultra-sensitive real time trace gas detector using a multi-mode Fabry-Perot diode laser and cavity ring-down spectroscopy has been developed to detect NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> with a single shot sensitivity of 530 ppt in 60 μs.

articleTitle: A Kagome fiber based, high energy delivery laser scalpel system for laser microsurgery
abstract: We present the development of a 5 mm, piezo-actuated, ultrafast laser scalpel that delivers upwards of 1 μJ at the target surface. Experiments show fast and effective surface ablation of tissue tens of microns deep.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a compact 500 Hz repetition rate Joule-level chirped pulse amplification laser
abstract: A diode-pumped CPA laser based on cryogenically-cooled Yb:YAG amplifiers that produces 1 Joule pulses at repetition rates up to 500Hz with good beam quality was demonstrated and used to pump a table-top soft x-ray laser.

articleTitle: Measurement of nonlinear optical response functions of common organic solvents
abstract: The nonlinear optical (NLO) response functions of 24 widely used organic solvents are measured, including both bound-electronic and nuclear contributions. The response function establishes a self-consistent reference for predicting the outcomes of various NLO experiments.

articleTitle: Circular polarization selective aluminum nano-spirals at ultraviolet wavelengths
abstract: Manipulating ultraviolet light presents unique challenges in technology. Here we demonstrate circular polarization selection at ultraviolet wavelengths over subwavelength distances using a flat-optical device consisting of Al chiral nanospirals periodically patterned on a glass substrate.

articleTitle: Measurement of H2O and OH in a flame by optical frequency comb spectroscopy
abstract: We measure broadband H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O and OH spectra in a flame using near-infrared cavity-enhanced Fourier transform optical frequency comb spectroscopy, we retrieve temperature and OH concentration, and compare water spectra to an improved line list.

articleTitle: Measuring the frequency stability of a quantum cascade laser frequency comb
abstract: Optical frequency combs generated by quantum cascade lasers have recently been proven in the mid infrared. The first attempt of frequency stabilizing a quantum cascade laser comb against a metrological mid-infrared frequency comb through a single phase-locking chain is presented.

articleTitle: Terahertz-driven high harmonic generation in bulk crystals
abstract: High harmonic bursts from a bulk solid are studied in the time domain. The data reveal a non-resonantly driven, non-perturbative quantum interference of crystal electrons from multiple valence bands.

articleTitle: 10-fs-level synchronization of a photocathode laser with an S-band RF oscillator for an RF photocathode gun
abstract: We demonstrate synchronization between a Ti:sapphire photocathode laser and a 2.856-GHz oscillator for an RF photocathode gun in the KAERI-UED/FEL Facility with 5.1-fs rms jitter [10 Hz–100 kHz] and 8.1-fs rms drift (for 1-hour).

articleTitle: Modifying coupled mode theory to model quasi-dark states in coupled resonators
abstract: We show that Coupled Mode Theory incorrectly predicts a dark state for a coupled resonator design and we propose a correction that effectively reconciles it with results obtained experimentally and through the Transfer Matrix Method.

articleTitle: Near-field integration of a Si3N4 nanobeam and a SiO2 microcavity for heisenberg-limited displacement sensing
abstract: A single-chip radio-frequency optomechanical system, consisting of a Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> nanobeam in the evanescent near-field of a SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> optical microdisk resonator realizes displacement imprecision >30dB below the standard quantum limit at room-temperature.

articleTitle: Bias-field tailored plasmonic nano-electrode for pulse and continuous-wave terahertz radiation
abstract: By using nano-electrodes, the THz emission power was improved by four times and more than 50 times for the pulse and continuous-wave terahertz emitter. Comparisons are made in terms of local carrier dynamics.

articleTitle: Silicon photonic temperature sensor employing narrowband cladding-modulated Bragg reflectors
abstract: A silicon photonic temperature sensor based on cladding-modulated grating provides narrowband reflection (0.35-nm), high temperature sensitivity (83 pm/°C) and wide temperature range that outperform the sensors based on ring resonator and strip/slab-type grating counterparts.

articleTitle: Stability of modelocked microresonator frequency combs
abstract: We show that soliton-modelocked silicon nitride microresonators are highly stable against external perturbations. Modelocking is maintained even for relatively large RMS pump-power noise and thermal shifts, which represents a key feature for potential applications.

articleTitle: Scan-less, line-field, confocal microscopy based on dimensional-conversion optical frequency comb
abstract: Dimensional-conversion optical frequency comb (OFC) is proposed to explore new applications of OFC. Combination of OFC with the wavelength/space conversion enables us to establish both confocal imaging and full-field imaging under the scan-less condition.

articleTitle: Silicon-chip generation of multiplexed telecom-wavelength entangled photons pairs
abstract: We report the fully telecom compliant generation of photon pairs on a silicon micro-ring resonator chip. The ring cavity is designed such as to demultiplex the emitted frequency-comb like spectrum using standard off-the-shelves telecom 100 GHz dense wavelength division multiplexers (DWDM). We measure energy-time entanglement in different channel pairs with raw visibilities exceeding 97%, which paves the way for silicon photonics based quantum key distribution (QKD) with either increased bit rates, or more users.

articleTitle: Phase change materials for emerging photonics
abstract: Phase change materials such as chalcogenides and complex oxides possess electronic structures that are widely tunable via external stimuli. Under the right triggers, these can be volatile (threshold switches) or non-volatile (memory). I will present an overview of correlated oxide systems where one can create sub-wavelength dielectric environments on-demand. The role of materials synthesis and their influence in photonic device performance will be considered.

articleTitle: Tunable optical de-aggregation of a 40-Gbit/s 16-QAM signal into two 20-Gbit/s 4-PAM signals using a coherent frequency comb and nonlinear processing
abstract: We experimentally de-aggregate the 16-QAM signal (EVM 6.9%) onto two 4-PAM signals (EVM 8.5%). Tunability of the approach over modulation format and bit rate is also shown by de-aggregating QPSK signals at two different baud rates.

articleTitle: Coherent ultrafast polaron pair formation in a conjugated polymer at room temperature
abstract: Ultrafast 2D optical spectroscopy with 10-fs-time-resolution, complemented by density matrix simulations, show that coherent vibronic coupling accelerates polaron-pair formation and results in strongly correlated exciton and polaron-pair dynamics in polythiophene thin films at room temperature.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser writing in lithium niobate
abstract: The fine morphology of infrared femtosecond laser-induced changes in bulk lithium niobate is closely analysed. Linearly polarized light can generally produce two or three axially separated modified regions containing polarization-dependent self-organized periodic nanostructures.

articleTitle: Doppler-shift emulation using highly time-refracting TCO layer
abstract: A wavelength shift of 15 nm is obtained for near-infrared (1250 nm) pulses interacting with a temporally engineered Al-doped-ZnO layer. The underlying time-refraction process is driven by an intense, <;100 fs pulse at 785 nm.

articleTitle: Robust fiber packaging in a scalable photonics process
abstract: We present a scalable photonics process utilizing i-line lithography to achieve 2.46dB/cm propagation losses and multiple high-performance devices. Fiber support structures are lithographically aligned to gratings, enabling durable packaging of multiple fibers on a chip.

articleTitle: Dependence of intense THz generation on gap size from ZnSe interdigitated large aperture photoconductive antennas
abstract: We studied the influence of the gap-size onto the generation of intense THz pulses from ZnSe interdigitated photoconductive antennas. We demonstrated that the waveform and the peak electric field depend strongly on this parameter.

articleTitle: Analysis of nitric oxide isotopes via differential faraday rotation spectroscopy
abstract: We present real-time optical polarization subtraction for calibration of Faraday rotation spectra. Noise analysis yields minor isotope sensitivity of 3.0 ppbv·Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1/2</sup> and 1.7×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup> rad·Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1/2</sup> noise-equivalent angle. Sub-permil ratiometric precision is achieved at integration times >100 s.

articleTitle: 20 GS/s photonic analog-to-digital converter using optical comb based on an optoelectronic oscillator
abstract: A novel 20 GS/s photonic analog-to-digital converter using optical comb based on an optoelectronic oscillator is demonstrated. The timing jitter of the optical sampling pulses is below 54.9 fs and the ENOB is 3.4 bits.

articleTitle: Fabrication of high-Q crystalline microresonators by femtosecond laser direct writing for phase matched second harmonic generation
abstract: We report on phase matched second harmonic generation (SHG) in an on-chip high-Q lithium niobate (LN) microresonator fabricated by femtosecond laser. Highly efficient SHG process was demonstrated with a normalized conversion efficiency of 1.106×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>/mW.

articleTitle: Modal analysis of anti-resonant hollow core fibers
abstract: We show the exploration of higher order core mode content in various designs of anti-resonant hollow core fiber using spatially and spectrally resolved imaging.

articleTitle: Generation of bright soft X-ray harmonics with circular polarization for X-ray magnetic circular dichroism
abstract: We present the first circularly polarized harmonics in the soft X-ray region and the physics underlying it. This source enables the first X-ray magnetic circular dichroism measurements in rare earth elements on tabletop.

articleTitle: 50-mJ waveform synthesizer for generating microjoule-scale isolated attosecond pulses
abstract: We demonstrate a novel light source based on coherent two-channel waveform multiplexing employing 28-fs carrier-envelope-phase stable pulses. The two-channel pulse energy reaches 50 mJ, which is the highest energy ever reported for a parallel synthesizer.

articleTitle: Operation of high-speed silicon photonic micro-disk modulators at cryogenic temperatures
abstract: We demonstrate the operation of silicon micro-disk modulators at temperatures as low as 3.8K. We characterize the steady-state and high-frequency performance and look at the impact of doping concentration.

articleTitle: Photochemical modification of polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA) for producing topographic and refractive index contrast for device fabrication
abstract: Polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA) can be modified through the use of ultraviolet radiation and cross-linking agents to produce either topographic or refractive index structures. These techniques enable the fabrication of reflectors, gratings, photonic crystals and waveguides.

articleTitle: Thermally-controlled single-soliton modelocking in silicon nitride microresonators
abstract: We report the first demonstration of thermally-controlled single-soliton modelocking in silicon-nitride microresonators. With the pump frequency fixed, we use only current control with on-chip integrated heaters to demonstrate a systematic pathway for achieving single-soliton modelocking.

articleTitle: Intrinsic speed of a black phosphorus photoconductive detector
abstract: The intrinsic speed of a black phosphorus photoconductive detector is determined using pulsed autocorrelation photocurrent measurements. The data reveals two timescales of 125 ps and 775 ps, indicating fast photodetection is possible with black phosphorus photoconductive detectors.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of Anderson localisation in large-scale coupled resonator slow-light waveguides
abstract: Performance of slow-light coupled-resonator optical waveguides (CROW) in a photonic crystal was analysed, and found to be limited by disorder-induced localisation. Localised modes were directly measured through out-of-plane loss.

articleTitle: On-chip wavelength multiplexing detection of cancer DNA biomarkers in blood serum
abstract: We used spectral multiplexing produced by MMI waveguides to detect and identify two types of melanoma cancer DNA on an optofluidic platform. Cancer DNA biomarkers in blood serum were isolated using a solid-phase extraction method.

articleTitle: An integrated mode (de)multiplexer based on adiabatic couplers
abstract: A novel broadband mode-division multiplexing link based on adiabatic couplers is proposed and experimentally demonstrated with crosstalk < −20 dB, insertion loss < 1 dB and power penalty < 1 dB, using Silicon integrated platform.

articleTitle: Nonlinear terahertz-spin interaction in thulium orthoferrite
abstract: Few cycle THz transients pump electronic transitions coupled to the spin system in thulium orthoferrite to trigger coherent magnons. Exploiting this novel driving mechanism we realize the first nonlinear interaction between THz pulses and spins.

articleTitle: Far-infrared nonlinear optics in multilayer epitaxial graphene
abstract: We report terahertz pump-probe experiments on multilayer graphene that measure both reflected and transmitted radiation. The data reveal complex reflection and transmission dynamics which calculations attribute to a transition from interband to intraband processes.

articleTitle: Wideband all-optical 3R WDM regeneration based on dual-pump parametric amplifier
abstract: Simultaneous all-optical 3R regeneration of WDM channels is demonstrated, based on dual-pump parametric amplification with sinusoidal modulated pumps. We observe receiver sensitivity improvement better than 1.5dB for five WDM channels modulated with 10Gb/s NRZ-OOK data.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared octave-spanning frequency comb generation in a suspended germanium-membrane ridge waveguide
abstract: We propose generation of 2.5 octave-spanning frequency combs in a suspended germanium-membrane ridge waveguide. The spectral range extends deep into the mid-infrared “fingerprint” region up to 12 μm, which cannot be realized using silicon-based waveguides.

articleTitle: 100 Gbps pattern matching using spatial-spectral holographic time domain correlation
abstract: Spatial-spectral holographic real-time correlative matched filtering of high bandwidth signals is demonstrated. Simple text searches for long phrases in PSK formatted optical data streams at rates up to 100 Gbps are presented.

articleTitle: Ultrafast optical control of plasmon-phonon interaction using topological phase transition in (Bi1-xInx)2Se3
abstract: We introduce a new methodology for controlling ultrafast plasmon-phonon interaction using topological phase transition. This is based on the manipulation of the spatial overlap between topological surface plasmonic states and bulk phonon.

articleTitle: Multiscale metasurfaces for enhanced light extraction
abstract: Computationally designed multi-scale gratings demonstrating both diffractive and effective medium properties can dramatically increase optical coupling out of a high-index dielectric. Typical results show increase of transmission on the order of 20%.

articleTitle: Chirped-pulse amplifier system based on thulium-doped ZBLAN fibers
abstract: We demonstrate a chirped-pulse amplifier system operating around 1900 nm using thulium-doped ZBLAN fibers. Pulses with a duration of 150 fs are obtained with average output power of 2.5 W.

articleTitle: A dark-state invisible material
abstract: We experimentally introduce dark-state corrugated metallic wires to construct a solid material possessing identical electromagnetic properties as air, which neither reflect nor refract light at any incident angle in free space., i.e., being perfectly invisible.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable integrated optical circulator
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated four-port optical circulator on silicon with 12dB isolation ratio. By locally switching the direction of the magnetic field on chip, we can dynamically reconfigure or shut off the circulation.

articleTitle: Coherent control of plasmonic spin-hall effect
abstract: We demonstrate coherent control of SPP orbitals for the two opposite spins using multiple rings of nano-slots with properly designed orientations on a metasurface. This scheme provides us to achieve arbitrary plasmonic spin-Hall effect.

articleTitle: Pr3+-doped mid-infrared chalcogenide fiber amplifiers using cascaded amplification
abstract: We computationally investigate cascaded amplification in a three-level mid-infrared Pr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped chalcogenide fiber amplifier. We show that 45% of the pump power that is injected at 2 μm can be shifted to 4.5 μm.

articleTitle: Manipulating the squeezing properties of a degenerate parametric amplifier with coherent, time-delayed feedback
abstract: Squeezing properties of a degenerate parametric amplifier are investigated with coherent, time-delayed feedback. Enhanced optical squeezing is obtained at frequencies set by the pump strength, the decay rates of the mirrors, and the time-delay.

articleTitle: Multipolar plasmonic resonances in terahertz hybrid metamaterials
abstract: The dark multipolar spoof localized surface plasmons resonances are observed in a hybrid structure consisting of a corrugated metallic disk and a bright C-shaped resonator. The multipole has a higher Q-value than the dipole resonance.

articleTitle: Spatial shaping of femtosecond laser pulses for improved micromachining efficiency
abstract: We quantify the efficiency of femtosecond micromachining of quartz and silicon as a function of the spatial beam shape (Bessel, vortex, Gaussian). A > 15-fold range of ablation thresholds was observed. Incubation effects were significant.

articleTitle: Phase sensitive amplification in metastable helium at room temperature
abstract: In this paper, we present our work on phase sensitive amplification performed in metastable helium at room temperature. The maximum obtainable gain is larger than 4.8 with a bandwidth of 100 kHz.

articleTitle: Four mode multi-correlated bi-photon states within an integrated quantum frequency comb
abstract: The generation of two-photon multi-correlated states over four modes and their pairwise entanglement is demonstrated by superimposing two different spontaneous four-wave mixing processes inside a bi-modally pumped CMOS-compatible microring resonator.

articleTitle: High peak power, short pulse duration Er:YAG lasers using Q-switching and cavity dumping
abstract: We report on Q-switched and cavity-dumped Er:YAG lasers that produce world-leading short-duration and high peak power pulses at 1.6μm. The lasers use co-planar folded-zigzag slabs and can be pumped by low brightness broadband laser diodes.

articleTitle: Optical phase-locking among phase-conjugated twin waves and free-running pump by using sum-frequency and second harmonic generation assisted OPLL for ND-PSA repeaters
abstract: Optical phase-locking among 5-Gbit/s BPSK phase-conjugated twin waves and a free-funning pump is experimentally demonstrated. A sum-frequency and second harmonic generation assisted OPLL circuit compensates error signals between the PCTWs and the pump successfully.

articleTitle: Spatial addressing of spin states in diamonds by doubly resonant nano-antennas
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a selective and spatially localized method for addressing the nitrogen vacancy (NV) center spin state, by a doubly resonant plasmonic antenna tuned to the NV's red and narrowband NIR transitions.

articleTitle: Heterodyne terahertz detectors based on plasmonic photomixers
abstract: A new scheme for heterodyne terahertz detection through plasmonic photomixing is presented, which offers significant enhancement in detection sensitivity and bandwidth at room temperature. We experimentally demonstrate a first proof-of-concept design operating at ~0.1 THz.

articleTitle: First demonstration of low loss, bend insensitive 37-cell hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber at 1μm for high power delivery applications
abstract: We report a low loss (~12.3dB/km), 37-cell hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber operating in the 1μm spectral region and demonstrate its bend-insensitive operation and its use for high power laser beam delivery.

articleTitle: Ultra-high Q whispering gallery mode electro-optic resonators on silicon chip
abstract: We show the ability of silicon photonics to overcome the long-standing challenge of efficient integrated coupling to ultra-high Q whispering-gallery-mode Lithium-Tantalate and Lithium-Niobate resonators. Coupling efficiency exceeding 90% with Q~45 millions is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Fully stabilized narrow linewidth 750-MHz Yb fiber laser frequency comb
abstract: We report a narrow mode linewidth (∼60 kHz) of 750-MHz-spaced Yb:fiber frequency comb and full phase stabilization by f-to-2f interferometer and locking to Er:fiber comb with CW laser. Preliminary further narrowing relative linewidth is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Unidirectional perfect absorber
abstract: We show an interplay between Fano resonances and a judicious absorption mechanism leads to a unidirectional perfect absorber which can be controlled both in direction and frequency.

articleTitle: Power coupling optimization in periodical segmented waveguides by bio-inspired algorithms
abstract: In this work we present the optimization of the power coupling between continuous and periodic segmented waveguides using a segmented taper by means of bio-inspired algorithms. The performance of the optimized taper as a function of the operating wavelength, C-band, has been also analyzed.

articleTitle: Probing ultrafast magnetization dynamics with high-harmonic magnetic circular dichroism
abstract: Magnetic circular dichroism in the extreme ultraviolet (XUV) spectral range is a powerful technique for element-specific and time-resolved probing of magnetization in multicomponent magnetic alloys and multilayers. We generate a circularly polarized XUV spectrum from a high-harmonic source by an efficient reflection-based phase shifter and demonstrate for the first time laboratory based, ultrafast resonant magnetic circular dichroism (MCD) absorption spectroscopy. We apply this novel technique to directly access the time-resolved dynamics of interface magnetism of a Pt/Co/Pt sample system.

articleTitle: Autoresonant three-wave-mixing in non-uniform second-order nonlinear bulk crystals
abstract: We demonstrate >60% efficient autoresonant three-wave-mixing in non-uniform bulk optical crystals by introducing temperature gradient phase-matching. This novel approach enabled generation of high-energy pulses with >50% conversion efficiency over a ∼150 nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: Slide-free (But Not Necessarily Stain-Free) microscopy via UV excitation
abstract: We describe MUSE (Microscopy using Ultraviolet Surface Excitation) - a novel, non-destructive, slide-free, inexpensive and rapid microscopic technique that provides diagnostic-quality images directly from fresh or fixed tissues without freezing, paraffin-embedding, or thin-sectioning.

articleTitle: A novel, highly precise characterization technique of integrated-photonic devices shown at a high order W-state generator
abstract: Evanescent coupled waveguides could be used to build multipartite inferometeros, which create an optical quantum state generator. The characterization of these integrated photonic devices needs a large effort and experimental expertise. We develop a method to reduce the measurement steps rapidly by using classical laser light. We show the application of this technique on a laser written W-state generator of the order N = 8.

articleTitle: GaN-based photonic-crystal thermal emitters operating in the middle-wavelength infrared range
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a narrowband (Q>90) thermal emitter with a peak wavelength of ~ 4 μm operating at 600°C by employing a photonic crystal structure containing n-doped GaN/AlGaN quantum wells.

articleTitle: Enhanced absorption and plasmon excitation in the bulk of fused silica with femtosecond Bessel beams
abstract: FEMTO-ST Institute, UMR 6174 CNRS University of Bourgogne Franche-Comte, 15 B, rue des Montboucons, F-25030 Besançon, France <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>Centre de Physique Théorique, CNRS, Ecole polytechnique Université Paris-Saclay, F-91128 Palaiseau, France We image femtosecond Bessel beam propagation in fused silica under ablation conditions, and observe unexpectedly high absorption. We identify plasmon excitation and plasma channel field enhancement as the likely mechanism for this increased absorption.

articleTitle: Topologically reconfigurable atomic lattice quantum metamaterial
abstract: We propose a novel architecture for topologically reconfigurable quantum metamaterial by engineering the response of dense ultracold atoms loaded in an artificial crystal of light. Our atomic lattice quantum metamaterial opens the door for applications at single-photon level with metamaterials.

articleTitle: Plasmonic interconnects using zirconium nitride
abstract: Zirconium nitride plasmonic waveguides were fabricated on sapphire using photolithography and plasma etching. For an 8.5 nm ZrN waveguide, long-range surface plasmon polaritons with a mode size around 10 μm were observed at 1.55 μm.

articleTitle: Plasmonic sensing with quantum noise
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a surface plasmon resonance sensor utilizing quantum noise in two-mode squeezed states for signal transduction. This quantum plasmonic sensor exhibits 5 dB greater sensitivity than its classical analog by exploiting plasmonic absorption.

articleTitle: Polarization-resolved hyperspectral stimulated Raman microscopy for tooth imaging
abstract: We report the development and implementation of a rapid polarization-resolved hyperspectral stimulated Raman scattering imaging technique for enhancing optical diagnosis and characterization of dental caries in the tooth without labeling.

articleTitle: Polarization dependence of avalanche multiplication factor in 1.5 μm quantum dot waveguide photodetector
abstract: We fabricated 1.5 μm quantum dot waveguide photodetector, and characterized the electrical and optical properties. It was found that the avalanche photocurrent strongly depends on TE/TM polarization.

articleTitle: Spin-orbit coupled, non-integer OAM fibers: Unlocking a new eigenbasis for transmitting 24 uncoupled modes
abstract: We excite and stably propagate a record 24 modes with non-integer mean OAM in a 10-meter thin-ring air core fiber. Average mode purity is ~20dB for both nearest-neighbors and modes of the same angular momentum.

articleTitle: Laser-directed “bubble-pen” for nanoparticle patterning
abstract: We develop a new technique - bubble-pen lithography - to pattern colloidal particles on the plasmonic substrate in arbitrary architecture using optically controlled microbubbles.

articleTitle: Rigorous characterization and analysis of the operating states in a passively mode-locked fiber laser
abstract: This work experimentally investigates the full spectrum of operational regimes that exist in a standard nonlinear polarization-rotation-based mode-locked fiber ring laser in order to understand and ultimately control these states within the cavity.

articleTitle: Detection of microRNA using a resonance-free capillary optofluidic sensor
abstract: A wavelength-encoded optofluidic sensor is fabricated by aligning a tapered optical fiber in lateral contact with a liquid-filled silica capillary. Preliminary experiment demonstrates its capability of molecular microRNA quantification with detection limit less than 2nM.

articleTitle: Optimization of mode-dependent gain efficiency based on intermodal Raman scattering for few-mode distributed Raman amplifier
abstract: Doping concentration and mode/wavelength configuration of intermodal Raman scattering are investigated for few-mode distributed Raman amplifier. The modal gain equalization and noise figure are optimized for four mode-groups resulting in mean gain of 14.7 dB.

articleTitle: Quantum frequency up-conversion of heralded single photon orbital angular momentum states
abstract: Frequency up-conversion of heralded single photon OAM states from 1560 nm to 525 nm is presented. Non-classical correlation and coherent properties are preserved in the up-conversion process.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation of a tunable continuous-wave carbon dioxide laser using orientation-patterned gallium phosphide
abstract: First demonstration of frequency doubling of a continuous-wave carbon dioxide laser using hydride vapor phase epitaxy grown orientation-patterned gallium phosphide is reported. Temperature dependence of second harmonic power was determined.

articleTitle: Low contrast dielectric metasurface optics
abstract: We demonstrate low contrast dielectric metasurface optical elements for operation at visible frequencies. Our devices show transmission efficiencies as high as 90% and focal spots on the order of the design wavelength.

articleTitle: Tunable, continuous-wave, doubly-resonant vortex beam optical parametric oscillator
abstract: We report a continuous-wave, doubly-resonant optical parametric oscillator pumped with first-order vortex green beam, producing first-order vortex in the signal (949.5–1060nm), and corresponding idler, in Gaussian profile, with maximum power ∼75mW and 165mW, respectively.

articleTitle: Franson interference in the filtered resonance fluorescence from a quantum dot
abstract: We report Franson interference from the light scattered by a single two-level InAs quantum dot interacting with a strong near-resonant monochromatic laser with the application of spectral filtering.

articleTitle: Slow light enhancement of Q-factors in fabricated photonic crystal ring resonators
abstract: Experimental results for photonic crystal ring resonators (PhCRR) fabricated on the silicon-on-insulator (SOI) platform are presented. Spectral features of the PhCRR's transmission spectrum are discussed and quality factors in excess of 30,000 are reported.

articleTitle: Controlled rapid delivery and on-chip trapping of nanoparticles by a hybrid electrothermoplasmonic nanotweezer
abstract: By combining intrinsic plasmonic heating and AC electric field, we demonstrate long-range transport, precise delivery and trapping of individual nanoparticles on a plasmonic nanoantenna. Our work will expand the range of applicability of plasmonic nanotweezers.

articleTitle: Bloch surface wave ring resonators
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the first Bloch surface wave ring resonator. Using a porous silicon material system, cavity confinement is achieved through a novel combination of total internal reflection and photonic band gap confinement mechanisms.

articleTitle: Plasmonic crystal cavity on optical fiber end facet for high performance label-free biosensing
abstract: Plasmonic crystal cavities on single-mode optical fiber end facets show a refractive index detection limit of 3.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> RIU. Real-time monitoring of the kinetic interaction process between immobilized proteins and partner molecules is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Photonic circuits with superconducting detectors and optomechanical phase shifters for integrated quantum optics
abstract: We developed a platform for integrated quantum optics. Optomechanical phase shifters and superconducting single photon detectors are combined on a chip. Good control over directional couplers and controlled-NOT circuits is demonstrated, and unknown phases are determined using optical resonances.

articleTitle: Optical study of Ge0.95Sn0.05/Ge0.9Sn0.1/Ge0.95Sn0.05 quantum well towards group-IV based light source on Si
abstract: A Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.95</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.05</inf>/Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.9</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</inf>/Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.95</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.05</inf> single quantum well was grown on Si via chemical vapor deposition. Temperature-dependent Photoluminescence shows the emission peak from the GeSn well. The studied structure aims for group-IV based efficient light source on Si.

articleTitle: Achiral nanoprobes extract chiral signals from within chiral metamaterials
abstract: Resonant plasmonic nanostructures amplify chirally modified, nonlinear signals from quantum emitters. Nonlinear emission signals are enhanced by 40× that of the emitters not embedded.

articleTitle: Terahertz trace gas spectroscopy based on a fully-electronic frequency-comb radiating array in silicon
abstract: A silicon integrated circuit is reported for radiating picosecond pulses with tunable repetition rate, covering frequencies from 30 GHz to 1.03 THz. This source is used in a gas spectroscopy setup to measure the absorption lines of ammonia and water in the terahertz region.

articleTitle: Two-photon luminescence of single gold nanorods: Influence of the rods volume at a given plasmon resonance
abstract: The two-photon luminescence (TPL) of colloidal gold nanorods (GNR) was investigated at the single object level, using correlated topography and polarization resolved intensity and spectral analyses. The origin of the TPL in colloidal GNR is discussed: we show the existence of a specific volume maximizing the TPL intensity.

articleTitle: Laser based processes for product customization in building integrated photovoltaics (PV)
abstract: This work presents new approaches for PV devices customization for BIPV applications using laser. Examples in c-Si and Thin Film silicon are shown. in addition the potential use of new meallization techniques using laser in this field are discussed.

articleTitle: Spectroscopic imaging of electron-induced nanoscale structure transitions in silk proteins using near-field optics
abstract: We present spectroscopic studies of nanoscale polymorphic transition of silk proteins under electrons using infrared scattering near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM), which paves the way for unlocking essential nanoscopic hierarchical molecular structures in protein-based biomaterials.

articleTitle: Photonic time-crystals and momentum band-gaps
abstract: Temporally periodic photonic-crystals develop an ω-k dispersion relation with momentum band-gaps, and offer new physical effects including frequency conversion, time-reversal and other optical phenomena in addition to their temporal control.

articleTitle: MoS2 monolayers on nanocavities: Enhanced light-matter interaction within atomic monolayers
abstract: We report a fundamental strategy to enhance the light-matter interaction of atomically-thin films based on strong interference in planar nanocavities, which is validated experimentally by absorption and photoluminescence enhancement of MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> monolayers.

articleTitle: Homogenization of nanowire-based composites with anisotropic unit cell and layered substructure
abstract: We present a simple numerical extension to Maxwell Garnett formalism for wire materials with high filling fractions in anisotropic unit cells to describe photonic band gap behavior observed in epitaxially grown semiconductor multilayer nanowires.

articleTitle: Image processing for the automatic alignment at the national ignition facility
abstract: The Automatic Alignment system in the National Ignition Facility is responsible for aligning 192 laser beams using camera sensor images. This paper reviews some of the image processing algorithms that generate the crucial alignment positions.

articleTitle: Solar pumped lasing of Nd-doped ZBLAN double-clad fiber with silica fiber Bragg gratings
abstract: We have realized that laser oscillation of a solar pumped fiber laser using a Nd-doped ZBLAN double-clad fiber as a laser medium and silica fiber Bragg gratings as cavity mirrors.

articleTitle: Temporal magnification with picosecond resolution at the single-photon level
abstract: We use temporal magnification via four-wave-mixing Bragg Scattering to resolve a 2.2 ps separation between two pulses each with a mean number of 0.05 photons. Our approach offers the potential for sub-200-fs resolution photon counting.

articleTitle: Multi-stratum resources optimization for cloud-based radio over fiber networks
abstract: We present a multi-stratum resources optimization architecture for cloud-based radio over fiber networks with software defined networking. The overall feasibility and efficiency of the proposed architecture are experimentally verified on our testbed.

articleTitle: Initial behavior of the relaxation oscillation at zero-phonon line of Yb gain media
abstract: Authors investigated the variation of the spiking interval during the start of the relaxation oscillation at the zero-phonon line in Yb-gain media, and proposed a novel procedure for evaluating effective spectroscopic parameters of gain media.

articleTitle: High yield fabrication of SPSL-based DUVLEDs on 6-inch sapphire substrates
abstract: Deep ultraviolet light emitting diodes (DUVLEDs) are fabricated using plasma assisted molecular beam epitaxy (PA-MBE) AlGaN films grown on 6-inch c-plane sapphire substrates with focus on yield and external quantum efficiency (EQE).

articleTitle: Improving crystalline quality of non-vacuum processed Cu(In,Ga)Se2 thin films by femtosecond laser annealing
abstract: We demonstrate the advantages of femtosecond laser annealing on non-vacuum CIGS thin films. The PL spectra implied some defect-levels or band-fluctuations were eliminated, and the conversion efficiency and ideal factor were enhanced after laser annealing.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband supercontinuum generation at telecommunication wavelengths in dispersion engineered stoichiometric Si3N4 waveguides

authors.preferredName: Peter J. M. van der Slot

abstract: We demonstrate the generation of ultra-broadband supercontinua in Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> waveguides at a pump wavelength of 1560nm. The supercontinuum extends to beyond 2.6 μm wavelength in the infrared and has a spectral width of more then 453 THz.

articleTitle: High-efficient, high-energy-pulse generation in 2.2–2.6 μm by Cr:ZnSe single-pass amplification
abstract: We demonstrated high-energy-pulse generation in 2.2-2.6 μm using a Cr:ZnSe single-pass amplifier in nanosecond pulse operation. Output energy was increased from 4.3 to 23.1 mJ at 2.41 μm with pump energy of 47.7 mJ. The conversion efficiency of the amplifier reached 39.4%.

articleTitle: Diamond microdisk cavity optomechanics
abstract: Optomechanical coupling between GHz frequency mechanical modes and λ ∼ 1.5μm optical modes in single–crystal diamond microdisks is demonstrated. The mechanical modes have a Q frequency product of 2 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup> Hz in ambient conditions, and are excited into ∼ 31 pm self-oscillations by radiation pressure.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics based on dielectric multilayer mirrors
abstract: Third harmonic generation is demonstrated in a novel dielectric mirror made of aperiodic layers of Hf<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</inf>O and SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. One percent conversion has been measured with 70-fs pulses and efficiencies larger than ten percent seem possible.

articleTitle: Diffractive lenses in the resonance domain
abstract: Restricting trade-off between efficiency and numerical aperture of scalar diffractive optics leads to clear supremacy of resonance domain diffractive optics. We present experimental results for resonance domain diffractive lenses in imaging, beam combining and fibers.

articleTitle: Photonic simulation of entanglement generation and transfer in a spin chain
abstract: We report on photonic quantum simulation of a 5-site spin chain dynamics in femtosecond-written circuits, with engineered couplings for perfect quantum transport, confirming the expected creation of entanglement at half transport time.

articleTitle: 5.3 W average output power MHz Q-switched Yb:YAG channel waveguide laser delivering ∼1 μJ pulse energy
abstract: We demonstrate an Yb:YAG femtosecond-laser-written channel-waveguide-laser with record-high average-output-power of 5.7 W and 78% slope-efficiency in CW and 5.3 W for Q-switched operation with 11-ns pulses and ~1-μJ energy at 5.4-MHz repetition-rate.

articleTitle: 30-mJ 200-fs cw-pumped Yb:CaF2 regenerative amplifier
abstract: We report on the design and performance of a cryogenic kilohertz Yb:CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> CPA producing 30-mJ, 200-fs pulses. A two-stage scheme enables bistability-free amplification in the repetition frequency range of 0.5-10 kHz, sustaining >20 W average power.

articleTitle: Disorder fingerprint — The distribution of local density of states in random media
abstract: We demonstrate the first direct measurement of the local density of states in random media. Our experiments and numerical calculations show that the long-tailed distributions manifest non-Gaussian behavior that depend on the type of disorder.

articleTitle: Attosecond nonlinear polarization and energy transfer in solids
abstract: Attosecond polarization spectroscopy is a new experimental technique resolving the nonlinear polarization and energy-transfer induced by visible few-cycle strong fields in solids. It reveals the intensity dependent response time of the system with attosecond resolution.

articleTitle: Full-range measurement and nonlinear sweep compensation in SS-OCT using digital coherent receiver
abstract: We realized full-range measurement without mirror images and nonlinear sweep compensation simultaneously in SS-OCT system by using a digital coherent receiver for telecommunication. Imaging depth is improved from 0.7mm to 3.6mm with resolution of 85μm.

articleTitle: Near-infrared on-chip spectroscopy for green-house gas detection
abstract: We demonstrated ultra-compact near-infrared on-chip gas spectroscopy using high resolution plasmonic filter array. We experimentally achieved ~10nm spectral resolution, which successfully resolved the two symmetric vibrational bands of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> at 2.0μm wavelength.

articleTitle: Towards all Yb based, high repetition rate FOPA systems
abstract: Starting from a 100kHz picosecond Yb laser, we derive tunable 10–15fs visible pulses for intrapulse difference frequency generation of potentially CEP stable, few-cycle IR pulses as the seed source for a subsequent FOPA chain.

articleTitle: Investigation of novel configuration of optical parametric oscillation based on oppositely-oriented crystal twins
abstract: We have investigated a novel configuration of optical parametric oscillation whereby signal twins and idler twins are simultaneously generated by both of two oppositely-oriented nonlinear crystals forming twins. Our theory is supported by our experiment.

articleTitle: Broadly-tunable pulse generation in cavity-free graphene random fiber lasers
abstract: Broadly-tunable pulse generation in cavity-free graphene random lasers is reported, with tunable pulsewidths across two orders-of-magnitude to less-than 900 ps, tunable repetition over three orders-of-magnitude up to 3 MHz, and 41-dB singly-polarized extinction ratio.

articleTitle: Single nanoparticle detection using a silicon nitride two-dimensional coupled-resonator optical-waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate single nanoparticle detection using a silicon nitride two-dimensional coupled-resonator optical-waveguide with light-scattering pattern recognition. Our proof-of-concept experiments show a detection of single 120nm-radius polystyrene particle using a 2 × 2 coupled microring array.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous III-V / Si photonic integration
abstract: We review recent advances in heterogeneous silicon photonic integration technology and components and describe progress in silicon photonic integrated circuits. Techniques for laser integration and the impact of active silicon photonic integrated circuits could have on interconnects, telecommunications and silicon electronics are reviewed.

articleTitle: Writing of bio-compatible silk patterns: 3D laser nano-printing
abstract: Laser-printing of crystalline silk patterns in amorphous fibroin film is demonstrated by femtosecond-laser pulses 1030 nm/230 fs without use of photo-initiator. The same patterns can be achieved by ablation of the crystalline silk film. Amorphous silk can be used as a negative tone photo-resist.

articleTitle: Revealing hidden orders in correlated electron systems with nonlinear optics
abstract: The symmetries of a crystal form the basis for understanding its mechanical, electrical and magnetic responses. Here we describe an optical high harmonic generation based technique for resolving the local (micron scale) crystallographic and electronic point group symmetries of crystals. Using the spin-orbit coupled correlated oxide Sr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>IrO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> as an example, we demonstrate how this technique can be used to resolve broken crystallographic and electronic symmetries that evaded diffraction based probes.

articleTitle: Terahertz carrier dynamics in graphene nanoribbons with different peripherial functional groups
abstract: We report a comparative study of ultrafast photoconductivity in graphene nanoribbons using time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy. The photoconductive properties of nanoribbons were found to be robust with regards to the position of peripheral functional groups.

articleTitle: High resolution temperature and strain discrimination by using π-phase-shifted fiber Bragg grating on polarization maintaining fiber
abstract: A high resolution temperature and strain discrimination scheme has been developed. Based on a π-phase shifted FBG on polarization maintaining fiber, resolutions of 0.003 °C and 0.05 μe in temperature and strain are achieved simultaneously.

articleTitle: 44 μJ, 160 kHz, few-cycle mid-IR OPCPA with chirp reversal
abstract: Implementing chirp reversal, we report a high-power, mid-IR OPCPA producing 82 fs (sub-8 cycle) pulses with 44 μJ pulse energy at 160 kHz repetition rate and excellent beam quality (M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup><;1.4).

articleTitle: Mid-infrared frequency-agile dual-comb spectroscopy with Doppler-limited resolution
abstract: Real-time absorption and dispersion dual-comb spectroscopy is achieved in the 3-μm region without mode-locked lasers or active stabilization. The resolved lines of flat-top frequency combs with adjustable line-spacing and tunable center wavelength enable precise spectroscopy.

articleTitle: C-rich SiCx micro-ring based 12-gbit/s cross-wavelength all-optical data inverter
abstract: 12-Gbit/s all-optical cross-wavelength data inversion with an SNR of 8 dB and a BER of 2.85×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> is demonstrated using a TPA-free C-rich SiC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> micro-ring resonator based Kerr switch.

articleTitle: Error-free dispersion-uncompensated transmission at 20 Gb/s over SSMF using a hybrid III-V/SOI DML with MRR filtering
abstract: Error-free 20-Gb/s directly-modulated transmission is achieved by enhancing the dispersion tolerance of a III-V/SOI DFB laser with a silicon micro-ring resonator. Low (~0.4 dB) penalty compared to back-to-back without ring is demonstrated after 5-km SSMF.

articleTitle: Structured light in linear and nonlinear engineered media
abstract: Structured light has attracted significant interest in applications ranging from optical manipulation to imaging. We discuss theoretical and experimental studies of linear and nonlinear interactions of singular beams in solid, liquid and gaseous engineered media.

articleTitle: High power femtosecond Yb:Lu2O3 amplifier and sub-100 fs Yb:Lu2O3 oscillator
abstract: We obtained up to 42 W with 780 fs-long pulses at 500 kHz repetition rate with M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=1.2 in a Yb:Lu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> based regenerative amplifier. Also, sub-100-fs pulse generation in a low-power SESAM mode-locked oscillator are presented.

articleTitle: Observing the uncoupling of electron motion from the molecular frame in photoelectron angular distributions
abstract: We observe the uncoupling of an electron's motion from the molecular frame through angle-resolved photoelectron imaging of a Rydberg orbital of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. This allows for ultrafast measurements in a distinct regime of non-Born-Oppenheimer molecular dynamics.

articleTitle: Narrow ridge cascade diode lasers with λ > 3 μm
abstract: GaSb-based type-I quantum well wide ridge multimode cascade diode lasers generate more than 360 mW near 3.25 μm at room temperature. Double-step narrow ridge waveguide lasers were fabricated to achieve single spatial mode operation with minimal threshold.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband adiabatic light transfer in titanium diffused lithium niobate waveguides
abstract: Ultra-broadband adiabatic light transfer was demonstrated for the first time in lithium niobate. Coupling bandwidths and efficiencies of ~540 nm and >0.96, respectively, were obtained with 5-cm long Ti:LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> adiabatic couplers for both polarization modes.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation in poled laser-written fused silica waveguides with periodic laser erasure
abstract: Second harmonic generation is reported for the first time in femtosecond laser written, thermally-poled silica glass. Poling was periodically erased by the same laser, yielding a quasiphase-matching SHG efficiency of 2.3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> %/W at 768.4 nm.

articleTitle: Sub-recoil linewidth and high power CW stimulated Raman scattering in the Lamb-Dicke regime
abstract: In a new Lamb-Dicke regime of stimulated-Raman-scattering, hydrogen molecules are deeply-trapped in self-nanostructured optical lattice to emit watt-level CW Stokes-radiation with sub-Doppler resolved spectral sidebands and with a sub-recoil linewidth as low as ~3 kHz.

articleTitle: Dispersive Fourier transformation femtosecond stimulated Raman scattering
abstract: We present the first proof-of-principle spectroscopic measurements with purely passive dispersive Fourier transformation femtosecond stimulated Raman scattering, with which the acquisition of the full Raman scattering spectrum is possible within microseconds.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Kerr-lens mode-locked dual-comb ring laser
abstract: We demonstrate a bidirectional Kerr-lens mode-locked dual-comb ring laser for simple and robust dual-comb spectroscopy. Two mutually coherent combs with slightly different repetition rates emitted from the single cavity enables dual-comb spectroscopy without feedback control.

articleTitle: μJ range optical fiber parametric chirped pulse amplification of short pulses at 1 μm
abstract: We report here on a Fiber Optical Parametric Chirped Pulse Amplification in which 1053 nm laser pulses are amplified in a large mode area photonic band gap fiber by an all-fiber pulsed pump in the μJ range with a gain of 53 dB and compressed up to about 400 fs.

articleTitle: Deep tomography: Polarization-entangled photon pairs in technicolor
abstract: We realize the frequency-resolved reconstruction of the density matrix of polarization-entangled photon pairs by stimulated emission tomography. This approach enables deeper insight into the correlations between different degrees of freedom in the photon-pair source.

articleTitle: 2D plasmonics for nanosecond generation of entangled plasmon pairs
abstract: We demonstrate that using 2D plasmons, the emission of entangled plasmon pairs can be enhanced by up to 15 orders of magnitude, corresponding to sub-nanosecond lifetimes, potentially allowing for ultrafast generation of entangled light.

articleTitle: Thermally-tunable ring resonators for high-speed optical sensor interrogation
abstract: We report an on-chip sensor interrogator based on thermal-optic ring resonators with a significantly enhanced speed. By using the transient response to a step thermal input, the interrogator was demonstrated to have a 52 kHz speed and 19.2 nm range with 0.33 nm resolution.

articleTitle: Rotational symmetry breaking in coherent dynamics of GaN excitons excited by radially polarized pulses
abstract: We performed four-wave-mixing (FWM) spectroscopy using radially polarized pulses on uniaxially strained GaN excitons. The FWM dynamics show a deformation of the polarization distributions attributable to the rotational symmetry breaking in the exciton coherent dynamics.

articleTitle: Computer-generated holograms embedded in bulk silicon with nonlinear laser lithography
abstract: Recently, we have showed a direct laser writing method to form subsurface structures inside silicon by exploiting nonlinear interactions. Here, we demonstrate utilization of this phenomenon to create computer-generated holograms buried in silicon.

articleTitle: Terahertz plasmon resonances in graphene-filled subwavelength metallic apertures
abstract: We observe and theoretically study new plasmon resonances in hybrid metal-graphene structures. We demonstrate anomalously high resonant terahertz absorption and transmission in graphene-filled metallic apertures. These tunable plasmon resonances can find applications in terahertz optoelectronics.

articleTitle: Broadband and non-volatile liquid controlled silicon photonics switch
abstract: A broadband and non-volatile liquid controlled silicon photonics switch is proposed. The measured crosstalk is less than −22dB and −12dB over 100nm wavelength range for bar and cross state, respectively. The insertion loss is less than 1dB.

articleTitle: Implementation of guided-mode resonance optical filter using two-step nanoimprinting process
abstract: We proposed a method to control the modulation depth of a guided mode resonance grating structure by using two-step nanoimprinting process in order to achieve narrow band optical filters. We verified this method with good reproducibility. Experimental results show that the grating modulation depth can be varied from 86 nm to 41 nm, and a transmitted notch filter with a spectral FWHM of 0.9 nm was achieved.

articleTitle: Transitioning Cr2+ and Fe2+ doped zn chalcogenide laser technology to commercial products — lessons learned
abstract: We describe the challenges of transitioning Cr and Fe-doped Zn-chalcogenide technology to real-world products enabling access to 1.9–6 μm range with up to 70% efficiency, 140W of CW output power, and short-pulse (<30 fs) multi-Watt (7W) oscillation.

articleTitle: High power far-infrared ZGP OPO laser
abstract: We present a far-infrared ZGP OPO laser pumped by a Q-switched Ho:YAG oscillator. The maximum output power of 8.2 W at 8.3μm with the beam quality factor M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of ~2.94 had been obtained.

articleTitle: Topology-optimized mode converter in a silicon-on-insulator photonic wire waveguide
abstract: A 1.4 μm × 3.4 μm fundamental to first order mode converter for the transverse electric polarization was designed using topology optimization. Insertion loss <2 dB (100 nm bandwidth) and extinction ratio >9.5 dB.

articleTitle: 2D nanomaterials saturable absorbers fabrication using the droplet method for erbium-doped fiber lasers
abstract: We present the simple and powerful droplet method to fabricate liquid exfoliated graphene oxide, reduced graphene oxide and black phosphorus polymer-based samples as all-fiber saturable absorbers for ultrashort pulse generation in Erbium-doped fiber lasers.

articleTitle: Broadband visible comb generation via third harmonic generation assisted by stimulated Raman scattering
abstract: We experimentally investigate visible Kerr comb generation via third harmonic generation and Raman scattering in a silica microtoroid. A broad bandwidth of 110 THz in the visible range is obtained by pumping at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: High resolution, wide field of view, ptychographic imaging of a biological sample using a high harmonic generation source
abstract: We present coherent diffractive imaging with broadband radiation generated from a high harmonic source around 29nm wavelength to image neuron tissue from the mouse hypothalamus to 80nm resolution over a 40nm field of view.

articleTitle: Terahertz quantum plasmonics at angstrom scale
abstract: We observed a ninety-seven percent decrease of terahertz transmittance in five-millimeter long, angstrom-sized metallic gaps of copper-graphene-copper hybrid structure. The giant nonlinearity originates from terahertz funneling-induced electron tunneling across the angstrom gap.

articleTitle: SLM-based reconfigurable test apparatus for integrated photonic logic circuits
abstract: Integrated all-optical logic circuits, an attractive platform for hardware accelerators, can have complicated I/O configurations. We demonstrate an SLM-based reconfigurable testbed that avoids the need to realign the access fibers for different circuit instances.

articleTitle: Pore size manipulation of hydrophilic nano/microporous polymer photonic crystal
