abstract: Here we report a low cost fabrication method to finely manipulate the pore size of nano/microporous materials and demonstrate its application for reversible color tuning of porous polymer photonic crystals based on atmosphere humidity condensation.

articleTitle: Aging study of white high power LED under thermal and electrical stresses — New experimental setup prototype, photometric and electrical characterizations
abstract: A new prototype of LED aging bench with thermal and electrical stress is highlighted. First photometrical and electrical results are presented. Current-voltage, capacitance-voltage, luminance-current and optical spectrum are investigated.

articleTitle: Mode-locked Er-doped fiber laser with TiS2 saturable absorber
abstract: We demonstrate mode-locked pulse generation in an Er-doped fiber laser by using a microfiber-based TiS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> saturable absorber. The edge-induced sub-bandgap absorption is proposed as the primary explanation for saturable absorption in this material.

articleTitle: Spectrally and temporally resolved resonance shifts of a photonic crystal cavity switch
abstract: We present experimental results of temporally and spectrally resolved transmission measurements of a photonic crystal cavity using two-color pump-probe technique. With a gated spectral measurement, we measure the resonance shift's dependence on pump power.

articleTitle: Coupling ideality of integrated silicon nitride microresonators for nonlinear photonics
abstract: Integrated microresonators are essential building blocks of linear and nonlinear photonic devices. Here we show that the performance of high-Q silicon nitride microresonators for nonlinear photonics strongly depends on the ideality of their coupler design.

articleTitle: Demonstration of efficient spin injection in a CW VECSEL at RT and dynamic control of its polarization state
abstract: We report the first efficient spin injection in a CW optically pumped VECSEL, obtained with phase anisotropy dynamic control. A threshold reduction of 1.5 % and an ellipticity of 75% are obtained at RT. Theoretical and experimental investigation of the polarization eigenstates is presented.

articleTitle: Toward a highly stable master laser for the interrogation of SYRTE's Sr and Hg optical lattice clocks
abstract: We report on the current developments of an ultra-stable laser based on spectral hole burning spectroscopy of rare-earth doped crystal at cryogenic temperature. Narrow spectral holes and error signal have been demonstrated with a heterodyne method.

articleTitle: Demonstration of orbital angular momentum (OAM) modes emission from a silicon photonic integrated device for 20 Gbit/s QPSK carrying data transmission in few-mode fiber
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate orbital angular momentum (OAM) mode emission from a high emission efficiency OAM emitter for 20 Gbit/s QPSK carrying data transmission in few-mode fiber (FMF). Two modes propagate through a 3.6km three-mode FMF with measured OSNR penalties less than 4 dB at a BER of 2e-3.

articleTitle: 16-user OFDM-CDMA optical access network
abstract: We demonstrate a 16×2.5 Gb/s (40 Gb/s aggregate) OFDM-CDMA PON for next-generation access applications. Four-channel error-free transmission over 25 km SMF shows 6 dB coding gain, with 0.1 dB dispersion and 0.9 dB crosstalk penalties.

articleTitle: Simplified all-polarization maintaining fiber laser modelocked in the all-normal dispersion regime
abstract: We report a simplified, all-normal dispersion, all polarization maintaining (PM) fiber laser operating at 1030 nm and all-PM fiber pulse compressor capable of generating 700 fs pulses with 0.45 nJ pulse energy.

articleTitle: Universal sign-control of evanescent coupling
abstract: We present a method for controlling the sign of the coupling term for individual links in arbitrary tight-binding lattices. The scheme employs defect insertion and eigenmode matching and is experimentally verified in photonic lattice implementations.

articleTitle: Collective, coherent, and ultrastrong coupling of 2D electrons with terahertz cavity photons
abstract: We have achieved collective ultrastrong light-matter coupling with long coherence times in an ultrahigh-mobility two-dimensional electron gas in a high-Q terahertz photonic-crystal cavity in a quantizing magnetic field.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous silicon/InP semiconductor optical amplifiers with high gain and high saturation power
abstract: High gain and high power SOAs on the heterogeneous silicon photonics platform are integrated by varying the waveguide width underneath the gain section. 25.5 dB of gain and 16 dBm output power are achieved.

articleTitle: Versatile supercontinuum generation in parabolic multimode optical fibers
abstract: We theoretically demonstrate that the pump's spatial profile can provide a degree of freedom in tailoring at will the nonlinear dynamics and the ensuing spectral content of supercontinuum generation in highly multimoded optical fibers.

articleTitle: Observation of noise-assisted energy transport in dynamically disordered photonic lattices
abstract: In this work we report on the observation of noise-assisted energy transport using stochastic networks of evanescently coupled waveguides. In this scheme every site is endowed with propagation constants randomly fluctuating along the propagation distance.

articleTitle: Noise suppression in Yb-doped single-frequency fiber laser by an optical passive-feedback loop
abstract: The frequency and intensity noise of a Yb-doped single-frequency distributed Bragg reflector fiber laser are effectively reduced by a simple, passive-feedback, optical loop, which consists of only two optical couplers. The linewidth is compressed from 3.96 kHz to 540 Hz.

articleTitle: Bond selective probe by time-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy: Ring-opening dynamics of 1,3-cyclohexadiene
abstract: Ring-opening dynamics of 1,3-cyclohexadiene upon two-photon excitation at 400 nm was revealed by time-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy using high harmonic photons probing the lower-lying occupied molecular orbitals, which are the fingerprints of the molecular structure.

articleTitle: Record ultra-low phase noise 12 GHz signal generation with a fiber optical frequency comb and measurement
abstract: We demonstrate a 12 GHz signal with a record absolute phase noise of −167 dBc/Hz at 10 kHz and −170 dBc/Hz at 100 kHz. We have developed a specific measurement setup for charactering this ultra-low phase noise.

articleTitle: Multi-tapered fiber-optic device for magnetic field measurement
abstract: A multi-tapered fiber device integrated with ferrofluid is proposed for the measurement of weak magnetic field. Wavelength sensitivity of -87.7 pm/mT has been obtained for the magnetic field intensity range of 2.5 to 25 mT.

articleTitle: 3D multiphoton fiber-coupled microscopy using adaptable optics for brain imaging
abstract: We describe a fiber-coupled miniature microscope with tunable focus using no mechanical parts for two-photon scanning microscopy in thick mouse brain tissue. A frequency-resolved optical grating (FROG) is used to measure the dispersive effects in the fiber-bundle.

articleTitle: Inverse design of a polarization-independent dirac-cone zero-index metamaterial
abstract: We apply a novel computational method to systematically design Dirac cones in photonic crystals. In particular, we demonstrate an unprecedented Dirac-cone zero-index metamaterial (DC-ZIM) that exhibits zero-index for any polarization of light.

articleTitle: Optical parametric amplification in ultra — silicon rich nitride waveguides
abstract: We fabricated highly-nonlinear (550W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) and low loss ultra-rich silicon nitride waveguides that can achieve parametric wavelength conversion over 170nm and parametric amplification of 23dB.

articleTitle: Zero-DGD multicore optical fibers
abstract: An analytical method is presented for designing N-coupled multi-core fibers with zero differential group delay. Using this technique a number of pertinent geometrical configurations are investigated in order to eliminate intermodal dispersion among supermodes.

articleTitle: GaN-based stress-induced bandgap widening with various arrangements of patterned sapphire substrates
abstract: By varying the arrangements of patterned sapphire substrates, the stress-induced bandgap widening of GaN-based epitaxial layers can be acquired. Photoluminescence and Raman results demonstrate a linear relationship of blue-shift with the increase of residual stress.

articleTitle: Diamond optomechanical crystals in the resolved-sideband regime
abstract: We demonstrate diamond optomechanical crystals (OMCs), which support a ∼6 GHz mechanical cavity coupled to a co-resonant ∼200 THz photon field. Diamond OMCs are optically driven to a cooperativity >1, highlighted by observed ‘phonon lasing’.

articleTitle: Artificial magnetism via nanoantennas under azimuthally polarized vector beam illumination
abstract: We show enhancement of magnetic near-field using symmetrical nanoantennas illuminated by azimuthally E-polarized beams. In particular a circular cluster nanoantenna is shown emphasizing enhanced magnetic field with high resolution in a magnetic dominant region.

articleTitle: Photonic topological zero-modes in a 2D lattice
abstract: We propose the realization of topological zero-modes in a two-dimensional quantum spin Hall-like photonic topological insulator structure. Unlike topological edge or surface modes, these zero-modes are point-like and thus have two fewer dimensions than their host lattice.

articleTitle: A chip-scale Kerr frequency comb driven by ultrahigh-Q microresonator stabilized laser
abstract: We study Kerr-comb stability with pump laser locked to ultrahigh-Q microresonator. Fractional instability of 1.26×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> is achieved, close to comb stability limit, 3.9×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup> imposed by intensity noise of the optical pumping and environmental fluctuations.

articleTitle: Large Amplification in Silicon via Stimulated Brillouin Scattering
abstract: We report large optical amplification in a pure silicon waveguide via stimulated Brillouin Scattering. The device supports >5 dB amplification at high pump powers and a record low (5 mW) threshold for net amplification.

articleTitle: Indoor OFDM visible light communications employing adaptive digital pre-frequency domain equalization
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an indoor OFDM-VLC system employing an adaptive digital pre-frequency domain equalization (pre-FDE) technique. By adaptively optimizing the modulation bandwidth of the OFDM signal, the proposed pre-FDE technique can maximize the system capacity.

articleTitle: Universal spin-momentum locking of evanescent waves
abstract: We show the existence of an inherent handedness (spin) of evanescent-electromagnetic-waves which is fundamentally locked to the direction of propagation (momentum). It is universal and accompanies evanescent waves in total internal reflection, waveguides/fibers and surface-states.

articleTitle: Two-photon laser-assisted device alteration in CMOS integrated circuits using linearly, circularly and radially polarized light
abstract: We investigate the influence of the incident light polarization on the 2pLADA spatial resolution. By comparing 2pLADA results obtained using linear, circular and radial polarizations we show that certain polarizations offer advantages in particular applications.

articleTitle: Study of electrical nonlinearity in analog silicon modulator
abstract: It is found that the electrical nonlinearity of PN junction severely limits the linearity of a silicon modulator. The modulation linearity can be effectively improved by reducing the series resistance of the PN junction.

articleTitle: Universal dynamics and controlled switching of dissipative Kerr solitons in optical microresonators
abstract: We discover a novel mechanism allowing for successive reduction of the number of dissipative Kerr solitons in optical microresonators. It is demonstrated that multiple and single soliton state can be deterministically accessed.

articleTitle: Comparison of 100 Gb/s O-band PAM-4 vs. C-band DMT for different laser linewidths and fiber lengths
abstract: We simulate 100 Gb/s systems using PAM-4 (O-band without chromatic dispersion) and DMT (C-band with less attenuation). We find the tolerance of each to laser linewidth, and discuss the fiber reach of each system.

articleTitle: Towards nanoscale quantum information sources with spaser technology
abstract: We show how the spaser technology in the presence of a realistic source of quantum noise can be employed as a building block for designing new integrated sources for quantum simulators at the nanoscale.

articleTitle: Watt-level single longitudinal mode Tm-doped fiber laser based on a self-constructed saturable absorption grating
abstract: We demonstrate a thulium-doped fiber ring laser integrated with an amplifier. Its output features a single longitudinal mode, a wide tunability of 120 nm and a high-enough power of up to 2.2 W with a slope efficiency of 10.7 %.

articleTitle: Stacking faults as a novel 2D potential for excitons
abstract: We investigate the properties of excitons bound to single stacking faults in GaAs, finding an ultra-narrow photoluminescence linewidth and a giant built-in dipole moment.

articleTitle: Remote detection of uranium by fs-filamentation laser ablation molecular isotopic spectrometry
abstract: We demonstrate remote detection of isotopes of uranium using fs-filamentation laser ablation molecular isotopic spectrometry (F2-LAMIS). The uranium monoxide molecular and uranium atomic emissions were optimized at different uranium-filament interaction points.

articleTitle: Ultrafast laser plasma assisted rare-earth doping for silicon photonics
abstract: A novel technique for rare-earth doping in silica is developed with femtosecond laser plasma processing and record high concentration of erbium in silica/silica-on-silicon platforms to realize compact optical amplifiers for silicon photonics are achieved.

articleTitle: Temporal magnification with large observation duty ratio using synchronized optical buffer
abstract: We demonstrate a method to substantially increase the observation duty ratio in temporal-magnification system without sacrificing the temporal resolution. 30% or even 100% observation duty ratio can be achieved on a 10-ns or longer waveform.

articleTitle: Study of polarization dependence of NLA in bulk SiO2 by fs two-color pump probe spectroscopy
abstract: We show single-shot nonlinear absorption is enhanced by 5% when pump and probe pulses have parallel polarization. At very large pump energy, we observe a new and fast decay component of self-trapped excitons ~0.5ps.

articleTitle: High SNR glucose monitoring using a SWIR super-continuum light source
abstract: We measure glucose solutions down to 1mg/dl based on the C-H combinational bands using a short-wave infrared super-continuum (SWIR-SC) laser. We estimate that the SWIR-SC increases the measurement system SNR by >50× compared with lamps.

articleTitle: Resonant excitation of single colloidal quantum dot coated on a tapered optical fiber
abstract: We propose a new resonant excitation method via the evanescent field surrounding optical nanofiber. Based on this method, we successfully obtain the fluorescence blinking signal of single colloidal quantum dot in room temperature.

articleTitle: High-bandwidth link with single laser input using silicon modulators and mode multiplexing
abstract: We demonstrate mode multiplexing to expand the bandwidth of silicon microring modulators. We show 37.5 Gb/s bandwidth while using a single laser coupled to a single waveguide, relieving the power and cost constraints associated with integrating multiple lasers for WDM.

articleTitle: Characteristic of UV plasmonic nanolasers with different spacer thickness
abstract: We report on plasmonic lasers with ZnO nanowire lying on single-crystalline silver film with different SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> thickness spacer. Spacer thickness were optimized to adjust the surface plasmon dispersion curve and resulting different group index.

articleTitle: Development of efficient mid-IR laser by intra-cavity OPO+DFM and its application to LUT of CFRP
abstract: We demonstrate efficient generation of a mid-IR source at 3.2 microns using a PPSLT OPO with intracavity PPSLT difference frequency mixing (DFM) crystal. This wavelength is the best suitable for ultrasonic-generation in CFRP.

articleTitle: Self-heterodyne brillouin dynamic gratings reflectometry
abstract: We present a novel technique that advantageously combines both Stokes and anti-Stokes reflections from counter-propagating BDGs in optical fibers, allowing distributed phase-shift measurement with high spatial resolution and immune to variations in fiber birefringence.

articleTitle: Correlation-induced photoemission delay in helium
abstract: We determined the photoemission timing of electrons escaping during shake-down and shake-up processes in helium with sub-attosecond standard error. Excellent agreement with ab-initio calculations allows benchmarking of theoretical models and identifies contributions of electronic correlation.

articleTitle: Delay line coherent pulse stacking
abstract: We show a novel approach to coherent pulse stacking at 1.5μm. We use phase preshaping of a symmetric 47 MHz pulse train to combine pulses next to each other and in turn reducing the repetition rate to 23.5 MHz.

articleTitle: Power-scaling a mid-IR OPA-pumped acetylene-filled hollow-core photonic crystal fiber laser
abstract: We report the highest pulse energy from a mid-IR acetylene-filled hollow-core fiber laser. The 1.41 μJ, ns pulses are emitted at 3.11 μm and 3.17 μm with 30 Hz repetition rate, ~20% overall efficiency at 9.8 torr.

articleTitle: Polarization assisted amplitude gating as a route to tunable, high-contrast single attosecond pulses
abstract: We demonstrate the simple implementation a polarization-assisted amplitude gate that is capable of generating high-contrast, isolated attosecond pulses tunable between the energy range of 50–130 eV.

articleTitle: Cavity ring down Faraday rotation spectroscopy for oxygen detection
abstract: A cavity ring down Faraday rotation spectrometer has been developed for oxygen detection at 762.6 nm. The system incorporates a differential measurement scheme for simultaneous detection of cavity losses in two orthogonal polarizations.

articleTitle: Coherent stokes Raman spectroscopy of pyridine in gas-phase at low temperature
abstract: Coherent Stokes Raman spectroscopic data of pyridine in gas-phase are presented. Both time and frequency resolved (femtosecond and picosecond adaptive) coherent Raman spectroscopic technique demonstrates a measurement sensitivity reaching below 30 ppm pyridine molecules.

articleTitle: Superfluid flow and vortex nucleation in room temperature, nonlocal photon fluids
abstract: We investigate superfluid behavior in a room-temperature photon fluid based on a thermal nonlinearity that mediates the photon-photon interactions. Placing an extended obstacle inside the flowing photon fluid leads to the nucleation of quantised vortices.

articleTitle: Single polarization, high energy pulsed fiber laser from 200 μm core Yb-doped fiber
abstract: We report a superluminescent diode seeded pulsed fiber MOPA at 1064nm delivering up to 12mJ single polarized pulses from a 200μm highly multimode core optical fiber.

articleTitle: Multiphoton imaging using a high transmission broadband hypocycloid-shape Kagome HC-PCF
abstract: Current limitations in multiphoton endoscopic imaging are overcome through the fabrication and use of broad transmission, low dispersion hypocycloid-shape Kagome HC-PCF for both excitation and collection. Two-photon imaging capabilities are demonstrated on fluorescent beads.

articleTitle: Quasi-phase-matched electric-field-induced second-harmonic in gas-filled hollow-core PCF
abstract: Quasi-phase-matched electric-field-induced second-harmonic generation is demonstrated in Xe-filled hollow-core kagomé photonic crystal fiber. The system is used to frequency double femtosecond near-infrared pulses, all signals being in the low-loss fundamental mode.

articleTitle: Geometric phase holograms imprinted by femtosecond laser nanostructuring
abstract: We demonstrate direct-write laser nanostructuring of semiconductor thin-films and transparent dielectrics resulting in space-variant anisotropic materials. The continuous phase profile of nearly any optical component can be achieved solely by the means of geometric phase.

articleTitle: Sub-100 fs pulses from Er-fiber laser passively mode-locked at 1.872 GHz by acoustic resonance in solid-core PCF
abstract: We report a dispersion-managed all-fiber laser delivering ~85 fs pulses at 1550 nm, passively mode-locked at the 178<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> harmonic (repetition rate 1.872 GHz) by intense optoacoustic interactions in a photonic crystal fiber (PCF) core.

articleTitle: The role of spin and orbital angular momentum in Čerenkov radiation
abstract: We show that Čerenkov radiation contains new phenomena arising from the quantum nature of charged fermions. The charge's orbital angular momentum and spin couple to the emitted photon, which scatters into preferred angles and polarizations.

articleTitle: Highly accurate multichannel fiber transfer delay measurement
abstract: We report a method for multichannel fiber transfer delay measurement based on phase discrimination and frequency measurement. It achieves a 0.2 picosecond resolution with a 1 picosecond accuracy, and large dynamic range over 50 kilometers.

articleTitle: Spectrum engineering for reconstructive spectrometry
abstract: We demonstrate a novel method spectrometry using etalons on a CCD camera. This prototype enables compact, high resolution, and high efficiency spectrometry with no moving parts.

articleTitle: Tailoring of individual photon lifetimes as a degree of freedom in resonant quantum photonic sources
abstract: Resonant quantum photonic sources with dissimilar decay rates are proposed and theoretically demonstrated to improve the efficiencies of entangled photon and squeezed light sources while also enabling engineering of frequency correlations in photon pair sources.

articleTitle: Quantum cascade laser on silicon at 4.8 μm
abstract: Here we demonstrate a room-temperature, 4.8 μm quantum cascade laser (QCL) heterogeneously integrated with silicon-on-nitride-on-insulator waveguides. QCL mesas are defined above silicon waveguides to form lasers.

articleTitle: Atomic photodetection
abstract: We demonstrate a novel photodetector featuring digital response and a low dark current at atomic scale. The principle of operation is based on a light controlled relocation of atoms in a memristive filament.

articleTitle: Quantum interference control of two- and three-photon processes
abstract: We present a strategy for carrier-envelope phase measurements using photocurrents due to quantum interference of two- and three-photon absorption processes. Our calculations include the injection current dependence on the optical polarizations and frequencies.

articleTitle: Generation of DUV/VUV Raman frequency comb via molecular modulation in a H2-filled Kagomé-PCF
abstract: Emission of narrowband pulses down to the VUV (184 nm) is demonstrated in a hydrogen-filled kagomé-PCF pumped at 266 nm. Intermodal Raman scattering facilitates the parametric excitation of short wavelengths in the all-normal dispersion regime.

articleTitle: DWDM source based on monolithic side-wall sample grating DFB laser array
abstract: We report side-wall sampled grating and quantum well intermixing techniques to fabricate a full function 4-channel DWDM source with excellent wavelength precision (residuals <0.13 nm) and high yield. Output power was >10 mW.

articleTitle: 87 fs pulse generation in a diode-pumped SESAM mode-locked Yb:YLF laser
abstract: We present for the first time sub-100-fs pulse generation in a SESAM mode-locked, Yb:YLF laser pumped with low-power single-mode fiber-coupled lasers at 976 nm. Almost Fourier transform limited 87-fs pulses at 1052 nm were obtained.

articleTitle: Lasing action in gold nanorod hyperbolic metamaterials
abstract: We study lasing in two gold nanorod arrays, one exhibiting hyperbolic dispersion while the other is elliptic at the emission wavelength of Rhodamine 101. Results show the hyperbolic metamaterial provides stronger emission with reduced threshold.

articleTitle: Observation of the breaking of a pulse on a weak background in optical fibers
abstract: We experimentally report the observation of dispersive shock waves from a short pulse superimposed to a small cw background in optical fibers. The visibility of intensity oscillations inherent to shock waves is strongly enhanced.

articleTitle: Dual-frequency comb spectroscopy: A digital solution for coherent averaging
abstract: We present a dual-comb spectrometer in which a new digital solution allows long-time coherent averaging of molecular spectra without spectral distortion even when the combs are free-running and subject to frequency drifting and jittering.

articleTitle: Observation of femtosecond dynamical franz-keldysh effect in polycrystalline diamond
abstract: Combining attosecond transient absorption spectroscopy in polycrystalline diamond with theoretical models we were able to identify dominant signatures from the dynamical Franz-Keldysh effect for excitations high into the conduction band and on few-femtosecond time scales.

articleTitle: Tunable few-cycle soliton generation up to 3.6 μm in fluoride fiber
abstract: We demonstrate generation of femtosecond pulses tunable from 2.6-3.6 μm through soliton self-frequency shift in a fluoride fiber. 8-nJ, 75-fs pulses at 3.6 μm are obtained, with 10 times higher peak power than prior results.

articleTitle: High-speed operation of a mid-infrared optical system at room temperature
abstract: We report on the room-temperature operation of a high-speed mid-infrared optical system (f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3-dB</sub> ≈ 0.5 GHz). This system consists of an efficient interband cascade laser and an uncooled high-performance interband cascade infrared photodetector.

articleTitle: Low bending loss nodeless hollow-core anti-resonant fiber
abstract: We report a high performance nodeless hollow-core anti-resonant fiber with a broadband guidance from 1050 nm to >1900 nm, a transmission attenuation of 200 dB/km, and a low bending loss of 0.25 dB/m for a 5 cm radius at wavelength of 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Effective third-order nonlinearities in refractory plasmonic TiN thin films
abstract: Here we study the third-order susceptibility of TiN thin films using the dual-arm Z-scan technique at 780 nm and 1550 nm. Due to its refractory nature, TiN is a promising metallic nonlinear component.

articleTitle: High-resolution, dual-comb spectroscopy enabled by a polarization-multiplexed, dual-comb femtosecond fiber laser
abstract: Dual-comb spectroscopy measurement of a high-Q microring resonator using a polarization-multiplexed mode-locked ultrafast fiber laser is demonstrated, which resolves picometer-wide spectral features in a very simple fiber-optic setup without complicated electronic control.

articleTitle: Development of a multichannel time-to-space THz spectrometer
abstract: We present a sensor head, which splits a THz pulse into spatially separated sub-pulses. The time-dependent order of the sub-pulses gives a spatial resolution by using only one pair of antennas.

articleTitle: Straight and curved photonic crystal waveguides realized with coupled L2 nanocavities
abstract: Straight and curved waveguides in 2D photonic crystals with wide transmission bands were realized using coupled high-Q L2 nanocavities. A channel drop filter was created by combining two coupled curved nanocavities and an H0 nanocavity.

articleTitle: Al-free active region DFB laser diodes operating at 894nm for compact cesium atomic clocks
abstract: Single frequency and low linewidth (<;1MHz) Al-free active region diode laser at 894nm, design-compatible for commercial Cesium atomic clocks optically-pumped, are developed and optimized using uncommon noise measurement techniques.

articleTitle: Laser-particle stimulated emission (LASE) microscopy with super resolution
abstract: We introduce a novel microscopy technique that utilizes optically pumped, nano-lasers as imaging probes. The lasing threshold and narrow spectrum of laser particles enables optical sectioning, sub-diffraction, and low-background imaging. Using nanowire lasers, we demonstrate ~180 nm resolution with large beam sizes of a few microns (>10-fold enhancement).

articleTitle: Memory-assisted quantum key distribution immune to multiple-excitation effects
abstract: Memory-assisted quantum key distribution aims to use existing quantum-device technologies to offer rate-versus-distance enhancements. Here, a variant of such systems, relying on single-photon sources, is proposed that counters the multiple-excitation effects in ensemble-based memories.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of negative optical Goos-Hänchen shift from photonic crystal
abstract: Asymmetric, low-loss, Photonic Crystal mirrors exhibit negative Goos-Hänchen shift up to -16.2 μm at 1532 nm wavelength. The shift is a strong function of wavelength, polarization and incident angle.

articleTitle: Fully-integrated nanomechanical wavelength and displacement sensor
abstract: We report a novel, fully-integrated nanophotonic wavelength and displacement sensor based on an electrostatically-actuated double-membrane photonic crystal nanocavity detector with a quantum dot absorption region.

articleTitle: Autonomous all-photonic processor based on reservoir computing paradigm
abstract: We present an autonomous all-photonic experimental implementation of an artificial neural network based on two coherent optical cavities in order to demonstrate its potential to process high-bandwidth analog signals with low power consumption.

articleTitle: Nonlinear phenomena in laser-cooled atoms at ultralow powers via an optical nanofiber
abstract: We report on 2-photon excitation processes in laser-cooled <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb that yields frequency upconversion at coupling powers of 200 pW in an optical nanofiber. We demonstrate Autler-Townes splitting and EIT mediated via the fiber.

articleTitle: All-polarization-maintaining, polarization-multiplexed, dual-frequency, mode-locked fiber laser
abstract: Two orthogonal-polarized pulse trains are simultaneously emitted from a single, all-polarization-maintaining fiber laser using two saturable absorber mirrors. This design shows great potential to reduce the complexity of current time-resolved measurement systems without sacrificing performance.

articleTitle: Polarization-based control of spin-orbit hybrid modes of light in biphoton interference
abstract: We report the experimental generation of a class of spin-orbit hybrid modes via an asymmetric Mach-Zehnder interferometer, whose intensity and polarization distributions may be tuned by manipulating the polarization state of the interferometer input beam. In the case of an equivalent biphoton input, we predict that this device will exhibit biphoton (Hong-Ou-Mandel) interference in conjunction with these mode transformations.

articleTitle: Deep-subwavelength Si core plasmonic waveguide monolithically integrated with Si photonic waveguide
abstract: A plasmonic waveguide with a deep-subwavelength Si core is integrated with a Si photonic waveguide. By utilizing horizontal Al-Si-Al structure, we obtained a 4-dB/μm propagation loss with a 60 × 60 nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> surface-oxidized Si core.

articleTitle: Fully CMOS-compatible TiN nanoantennas
abstract: We report the first visible/NIR darkfield scattering spectroscopy measurements of single titanium nitride nanostructures. We grow these fully CMOS-compatible nanoantennas via low-temperature atomic layer deposition and characterize and correlate their optical and material properties.

articleTitle: On bridging the terahertz gap using four-wave mixing in photonic crystal fibers
abstract: A newly introduced computationally-efficient FDTD model of pulse propagation in photonic crystal fibers, which accounts for both mode dispersion and third-order nonlinear properties of applied materials, is used in this paper to the study of the electrodynamics of terahertz generation with four-wave mixing of two co-propagating femtosecond pulses. Basic requirements for efficient conversion of energy, related to such parameters like group velocity dispersion, are specified. The impact of the transmission line characteristics and pulse properties on both spectral and time evolution of the generated terahertz radiation are shown and discussed. The obtained results pave the way for further rigorous studies heading toward bridging a terahertz gap with the aid of broadly available high-power femtosecond laser sources supplemented with dispersion-engineered photonic crystal fibers.

articleTitle: Magnetoplasmonic crystals based on anisotropic nanoantennas
abstract: By synergically combining experiments and simulations, we show how the excitation of lattice surface modes in ordered arrays of magnetic and optically-anisotropic nanoantennas leads to a highly enhanced and tunable Fano-like modulation of the magnetoplasmonic response.

articleTitle: High power surface-grating stabilized narrow-stripe broad area lasers with beam parameter product < 2 mm×mrad
abstract: Narrow-stripe (30 μm aperture) broad area lasers with monolithically integrated DFB-surface-gratings deliver 5 W optical output per emitter with 50% conversion efficiency, spectral width ≤ 1 nm from 970…980 nm, and beam parameter product < 2 mm×mrad.

articleTitle: Computationally-assisted THz dual-comb spectroscopy using quantum cascade laser frequency combs
abstract: Utilizing the Kalman filter-based averaging scheme, we demonstrated THz dual-comb spectroscopy covering 282 GHz at ~2.8 THz with unstabilized quantum cascade laser frequency combs. The peak signal-to-noise ratio(SNR) is 60 dB within 100 us averaging.

articleTitle: Nanooptomechanical sensing of carbon nanotube-based resonators
abstract: In this paper we present our first experimental results towards the exploration of nano-optomechanical detection in the limit of a weak optical coupling. We have been able to measure and actively control SiC nanowires and carbon nanotube-based resonators.

articleTitle: Mechanically flexible photonic-crystal cavities on strained germanium fabricated by nanomembrane assembly
abstract: Mechanically flexible photonic-crystal cavities consisting of disconnected Si-column arrays are fabricated on Ge nanomembranes by a novel membrane assembly approach. Photonic-crystal cavity resonances are clearly observed in the strain-enhanced photoluminescence spectra.

articleTitle: Self-referenced, chipscale Kerr frequency comb without external broadening
abstract: A Kerr frequency comb generated in an integrated silicon nitride microresonator is self-referenced using the 2f-3f approach. With an intrinsic bandwidth of two-thirds of an octave no additional, external broadening of the spectrum is required.

articleTitle: Transformation of a dispersive wave into a fundamental solition
abstract: We observe the transformation of a dispersive wave into a fundamental soliton using an axially-varying fiber. The solitonic nature is demonstrated theoretically by solving the Zakharov-Shabat scattering problem, and experimentally through spectral and temporal measurements.

articleTitle: Beating the diffraction limit with single-photons
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate quantum enhanced resolution in confocal fluorescence microscopy exploiting the non-classical photon statistics of single nitrogen-vacancy colour centres in diamond.

articleTitle: Measuring the noninstantaneous nonlinear refractive index of organic solvents by nonlinear ellipse rotation
abstract: We investigate the contribution of noninstantaneous response time of organic solvents nonlinearities by measuring the nonlinear refractive indices with ellipse rotation method as a function of pulse width, which was spanned from 50fs to ~700fs.

articleTitle: High power, widely tunable synchronously pumped fiber-based optical parametric oscillator
abstract: We demonstrate a synchronously pumped fiber optical parametric oscillator tunable from 795 nm to 860 nm. The FOPO operates in the normal dispersion regime and generates highly chirped pulses at the output allowing for significant pulse energy scaling without pulse breaking. The FOPO was able to generate up to 3.9 nJ pulses compressible to 173 fs by a photonic crystal fiber compressor.

articleTitle: Polarization-resolved terahertz imaging of hybrid fiber-reinforced composite laminate subject to low-velocity impact
abstract: By taking advantage of the interaction between terahertz polarization and carbon-fiber orientation, impact-induced intra- and inter-laminar damages at the same interface are differentiated via terahertz polarization-resolved imaging in three dimensions.

articleTitle: Silicon-microresonator-based mid-infrared dual-comb source
abstract: We demonstrate a microresonator-based dual-comb source. Operation is achieved in the mid-infrared with a single continuous-wave pump source using two silicon microresonators that are each modelocked using thermal control and free-carrier injection.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of localized energy density gain using coherent superposition of multiple structured orbital-angular-momentum modes
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the use of orbital angular momentum (OAM) superposition as basis for the generation of a directed energy beam. Different OAM superpositions are tested with a maximum achieved peak power gain of ~2.5.

articleTitle: Optical clock pulse generation using thermal nonlinearity in microring resonators
abstract: A reflective microring resonator is used as a wavelength selective nonlinear feedback element in a fiber ring laser to generate optical clock pulses. All components are driven by DC current.

articleTitle: Taking sub-cycle THz nanoscopy to the limits
abstract: We combine ultrafast field-resolved terahertz spectroscopy with scattering-type near-field scanning optical microscopy to access sub-optical-cycle dynamics on the nanoscale. We trace the oscillating electric near field from a (10 nm)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> volume on the surface of an indium arsenide nanowire with 10 fs temporal resolution, revealing the formation of a depletion layer on the nanowire surface. Furthermore, we apply ultrafast terahertz nanoscopy to strained vanadium dioxide nanobeams and observe a previously unseen correlation between the local steady-state phase-switching susceptibility and the ultrafast response to below threshold photoexcitation. Our findings point towards a nanoscale periodic strain profile that is frozen into the VO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> insulating state.

articleTitle: Rotational mechanism of lasing in singly ionized nitrogen molecules under femtosecond mid-IR pumping
abstract: Through high-resolution spectroscopy of lasing on N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> ions at 428nm wavelength, we quantify optical gain and population inversion in the gain medium. We show that molecular rotations are the enabling effect in this lasing process.

articleTitle: 7-Cycle pulses from an Er-fiber laser with self-similar evolution in comb-like dispersion-decreasing fiber
abstract: Self-similar evolution in a comb-like dispersion-decreasing fiber inside an erbium fiber laser is demonstrated. The laser generates 37-fs and 1.3-nJ pulses, which equal the shortest from an Er fiber laser but with 4 times the peak power.

articleTitle: Dramatic and previously overlooked interaction between strain and parasitic absorption in germanium with major implications for Si-compatible lasing
abstract: Extensive modeling and experiments demonstrate a dramatic reduction in parasitic absorption with strain due to a previously overlooked mechanism. A special resonance at 4-5% uniaxial strain indicates that this is the optimal strain level for a room temperature Ge laser.

articleTitle: Engineering frequency-correlated two-photon states using parametric down-conversion in integrated-optic nonlinear waveguide
abstract: We propose a scheme for generating frequency-correlated two-photon states via Spontaneous Parametric Down Conversion in periodically poled nonlinear integrated-optic waveguides. A method to differentiate such states from traditional frequency anti-correlated photon-pair sources is discussed.

articleTitle: Wake mode sidebands and instability in comb lasers with slow saturable absorbers
abstract: We computationally study wake modes in a fiber comb laser with a slow saturable absorber. We show that these modes will lead to the experimentally-observed sidebands, and we predict the laser's stable operating regime.

articleTitle: Quantum cascade lasers: A platform technology for today's marketplace
abstract: The demand for sensitive molecular detection in a wide range of applications is driving diverse mid-IR laser source requirements. We present recent results showing how quantum-cascade-laser-based systems provide a flexible platform that can address these requirements.

articleTitle: Development of a space-proof polarization-entangled photon source
abstract: We report on the engineering and testing of a highly efficient entangled photon source that can sustain the strong vibrations and thermal fluctuations of space flight and operation in space.

articleTitle: Spectroscopic detection of radiocarbon dioxide at parts-per-quadrillion sensitivity
abstract: A compact and simple laser spectroscopy apparatus at 4.5 μm, based on saturated-absorption cavity ring-down (SCAR), has approached the ultimate sensitivity of accelerator mass spectrometry, measuring radiocarbon dioxide concentration down to few parts per quadrillion.

articleTitle: Lensless endoscopic light delivery of individually addressable channels using a multimode fiber
abstract: We demonstrate asynchronous information transmission through a multimode fiber using different windows of a single spatial light modulator. Our findings pave the way towards individual diffuse optical imaging in deep biological tissue.

articleTitle: Shifted optical Gaussian filters based time division multiplexing of USFBGs sensing network
abstract: We demonstrated high-speed and wide-range, intensity based time division multiplexing of ultra-short fiber Bragg gratings for quasi distributed sensing with wide linear range of >3000 μe and a high sensitivity of ~0.005 dB/μe.

articleTitle: Site-controlled InAs quantum dots for plasmonics
abstract: We present site-controlled epitaxy of InAs quantum dots (QD) for plasmonics and report QD-plasmon coupling in a hybrid structure consisting of site-controlled InAs/GaAs QD chains in the proximity of an Ag film.

articleTitle: Single mode photonic crystal vertical cavity lasers for improved modulation bandwidth distance product
abstract: We demonstrate single mode photonic crystal vertical cavity surface emitting lasers with modulation bandwidth exceeding 15 GHz, low operating current density, and improved output power by optimization of the laser cavity optical and electrical design.

articleTitle: Photonic structure textile design for localized thermal management via radiative cooling
abstract: We numerically demonstrate a photonic structure textile design that is infrared-transparent and enables infrared radiative cooling that is sufficient for localized management of thermal comfort given a set point increase in room temperature of 4°F.

articleTitle: Space-time-wavelength mapping based electronically controlled two dimensional optical tweezing
abstract: We investigate two-dimensional optical tweezing by space-time-wavelength mapping. We show that by adding a virtually imaged phased array to the proposed setup, force field in a 2D plane can be controlled by time-domain modulation.

articleTitle: Ultra-low threshold lasing at 0.8 μm from organic microdisk cavity by the ink-jet printing method
abstract: We demonstrated an ultra-low lasing threshold of 0.33 μJ/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at 817.3 nm using an ink-jet-printed microdisk cavity doped with LDS798. Then microdisks with different tapered angles were evaluated on lasing threshold to perform low threshold.

articleTitle: Ar implantation-induced quantum dot intermixing technique for 1550 nm-band highly stacked QD photonic integrated circuit
abstract: We studied an Ar-implantation-induced quantum dot intermixing (QDI) technique and its physical mechanism, and demonstrate an almost equal performance of the QDI used 120 nm shifted laser diode compared to the performance without the technique.

articleTitle: Precision spectroscopy to enable traceable dynamic measurements of pressure
abstract: We present recent work aimed at creating a standard for the dynamic measurement of pressure. A near-IR laser spectroscopy system is demonstrated for measuring 8 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> in 50 μs with a 4 kHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: High-repetition-rate dynamic polarization mode dispersion characterization based on linear optical sampling
abstract: We demonstrate a method to measure the polarization mode dispersion using linear optical sampling with a high repetition rate of 156 kHz. The dynamic PMD of a 42 km field-installed fiber link has been precisely characterized with 25 Gb/s ultrashort pulses.

articleTitle: High-Purcell high-quantum-yield gap-plasmon spontaneous emission enhancement based on optically thin metallic substrates
abstract: We theoretically predict optically thin metallic substrates facilitates high-Purcell (> 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>), high-efficiency (>50%) gap-plasmon spontaneous emission with vanishing gap size. The enhancement is almost spatially uniform and does not suffer from quenching that commonly exist in previous structures.

articleTitle: Soliton pulse formation in a calcium fluoride whispering gallery microcavity without frequency sweeping
abstract: We study a way of achieving a soliton pulse from a CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> microcavity. We fabricated a dispersion controlled CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> cavity and also numerically developed a method to generate soliton pulses without sweeping the input laser.

articleTitle: Analysis of laser induced plasma in air using broadband femtosecond coherent anti-stokes Raman scattering
abstract: We investigated the laser induced plasma in air by means of coherent Anti-Stokes Raman scattering. The generation and decay of N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> was studied for different pulse energies.

articleTitle: Floodlight quantum key distribution
abstract: We describe a quantum key distribution protocol that breaks the one-photon-per-bit barrier, is secure against the optimum collective Gaussian attack, and is capable of a 2Gbps secret-key rate over a 50 km fiber link.

articleTitle: Widely tunable ultrafast sources for multi-photon microscopy
abstract: We demonstrate energy scalable fiber-laser based sources that produce sub-100 fs pulses widely tunable from 870-1200 nm, constituting ideal driver sources for multi-photon microscopy.

articleTitle: Tunable plasmonic band-stop filters based on periodically modulated graphene
abstract: Tunable band-stop filters with a wide working range (37 to 53 THz) and an ideal modulation depth (-26 dB) are proposed based on periodically modulated graphene. The length (750 nm) is only 1/9 of the operating wavelength.

articleTitle: Shaping light with nonlinear metasurfaces
abstract: Nonlinear metasurfaces introduce new ways to generate and control light. Here we demonstrate how to engineer the nonlinear interaction and shape the nonlinear emission by precisely tailoring the spatial distribution of the metasurface nonlinearity.

articleTitle: WGM resonators as universal nonlinear scattering platforms
abstract: Whispering gallery mode resonators allow to study various types light-matter interactions. We here discuss universal nonlinear scattering induced by the simultaneous excitation of Brillouin, Raman and Kerr nonlinearities.

articleTitle: Comb-based active laser ranging with frequency transfer
abstract: The performance of active laser ranging is enhanced by using the frequency comb. Distance measurement is conducted along with frequency transfer between two ends, with 100 nm resolution and 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-16</sup> Allan deviation for 1 s.

articleTitle: Counter-propagating spatially entangled bell-states generation in photonic crystal waveguides
abstract: We developed a general method for direct and fully integrated generation of photon pairs in counter-propagating spatially entangled Bell-states using parametric down-conversion in photonic crystal slab waveguides without the need for periodic poling.

articleTitle: Kerr comb generation with suppressed cavity-optomechanical oscillation in toroid microcavity
abstract: Toroid microcavities tend to excite cavity optomechanical vibration, which makes Kerr comb generation complicated. We demonstrated experimentally that transform limited pulses are obtained without optomechanical noise by controlling the pump frequency.

articleTitle: Linear and non-linear light-vapor interaction in ultra-compact serpentine atomic cladding wave guides
abstract: We present and experimentally demonstrate an ultra-compact and efficient apparatus for chips-scale linear and non-linear light vapor interactions, based on an atomic cladding nano-scale waveguides. Both low power saturation, and Autler-Townes splitting are observed.

articleTitle: Air refractive index self-correction exceeding empirical equation accuracy using two-color interferometry with optical frequency comb
abstract: Extremely high-accuracy self-correction of the air refractive index was achieved using two-color comb interferometry exhibiting phase difference measurement with 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup>-order resolution. Obtained 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>-order self-correction accuracy over 61-m exceeded the limit of empirical equation.

articleTitle: Spatial multiplexing of high-purity Heralded single photons in an integrated fibre architecture
abstract: We present the construction and characterisation of a spatially multiplexed photonic crystal fibre source of high-purity heralded single photons at 1560nm. We demonstrate performance improvements from multiplexing two sources.

articleTitle: Low strain silicon-vacancy color centers in diamond nanopillar arrays
abstract: We demonstrate the fabrication and optical characterization of diamond nanopillar arrays containing silicon-vacancy (SiV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>) color centers. Micro-photoluminescence reveals narrow linewidths and small inhomogeneous broadening of SiV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> emission from the nanopillars.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of SiNx/Au nanopatch cavities with colloidal nanocrystals
abstract: We report on the fabrication/characterization of nanoscale cavities in which a monolayer of CdSe/CdS quantum dots is embedded in a SiN<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>/Au structure. The physics of the emission rate enhancement (1.2-3.4) is discussed.

articleTitle: Reciprocal waveforms at through and drop ports in microcomb generation
abstract: Bright and dark pulses were observed respectively at the through and drop ports of a normal-dispersion microresonator, illustrating the impact of a superimposed pump on the time-domain waveform of the output microcomb.

articleTitle: Intravascular polarization sensitive optical coherence tomography in human patients
abstract: Polarization sensitive optical coherence tomography (PS-OCT) provides measures of tissue birefringence and depolarization. Here, we demonstrate catheter-based PS-OCT in the coronary arteries of human patients to obtain valuable insight into the morphology of atherosclerotic plaques.

articleTitle: Terahertz graphene modulator integrated with quantum cascade laser achieving 100% modulation depth
abstract: A graphene modulator has been integrated with a THz quantum cascade laser, resulting in a 100% modulation depth with a fast speed due to the strongly enhanced interaction between the laser field and the graphene.

articleTitle: Optical investigation of radiation induced conductivity changes in STT-RAM cells
abstract: Plasmonic defect spectroscopy of STT-RAMs under high energy radiation is proposed here. We show that engineered constellation designs of the STT-RAMs can be used to understand radiation defects by measuring optical reflectivity, diffraction, or absorption.

articleTitle: Titanium dioxide enables visible integrated-evanescent Raman sensors
abstract: We explore titanium dioxide (TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) for visible evanescent Raman sensing and observe >100× greater than previous reports. Furthermore, we demonstrate TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> micro-ring resonators to enhance both pumping efficiency and Stokes emission.

articleTitle: Pulse compression using stimulated brillouin scattering in fiber with frequency-shifted loopback
abstract: An efficient pulse compression using stimulated Brillouin scattering in fiber is proposed where the transmitted pump is returned to the fiber with its frequency downshifted. Simulation and experiment show that stable generation of highly-compressed nanosecond pulses is expected.

articleTitle: Displacement and attitude angles (Tilt and Yaw) are measured by a single-channel self-mixing interferometer
abstract: We develop a self-mixing interferometer capable of measuring the position (with half-wavelength resolution) and the two attitude angles - pitch and yaw - (with 15 microrad resolution) of a machine tool turret. The three measurements are performed, for the first time to the best of our knowledge, simultaneously and using a single channel optical signal.

articleTitle: Broadband enhancement of light-matter interaction in 2D semiconductors by photonic hypercrystals
abstract: We demonstrate enhanced photoluminescence from monolayer MoS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and WS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> by a factor of 60 over the entire emission range using a photonic hypercrystal having hyperbolic dispersion.

articleTitle: Slow light by hybridized double split ring resonators
abstract: Here, we design, fabricate, and characterize EIT-metamaterials by hybridizing two DSRRs into a single unit cell. First we, develop a method to determine the effective thickness of metamaterials which is crucial in calculating the group velocity of light. Then, we present a novel approach to enhance and dynamically tune the slow light characteristic by twisting the inner SRRs of two hybridized DSRRs in a flexible EIT-metamaterial. The design reduces the speed of light by 0.06 time compared with air.

articleTitle: Entanglement between Rydberg excited state and ground-state spin wave
abstract: Here, we report on the successful storage of a true single photon using the Rydberg polariton and establishment of the entanglement between Rydberg excited state and the ground state spin wave experimentally, making a primary step towards the construction of a hybrid quantum interface.

articleTitle: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) based optical routing using reconfigurable optical vortex grating
abstract: We propose and demonstrate routing of multiple free space optical communication channels labeled by OAM states through a dynamic grating. Data exchange and multicast among 49 OAM channels are demonstrated with bit error rate measurements.

articleTitle: Direct RF-to-optical detection by plasmonic modulator integrated into a four-leaf-clover antenna
abstract: We report on a plasmonic modulator integrated into a four-leaf-clover antenna. The antenna provides electric field enhancement of 92'000 in the active part of the modulator, which allows efficient conversion of millimeter-wave signals into the optical domain.

articleTitle: Few-cycle mid-IR OPCPA front-end at 100 kHz with sub-50 mrad CEP-stability
abstract: We present an OPCPA front-end delivering mid-IR (3.2 μm) pulses supporting sub-3.5 optical cycles with unprecedented passive CEP stability (44.2 mrad rms over 84 sec).

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated two-wavelength distributed Bragg reflector laser for terahertz generation
abstract: We demonstrate a monolithically integrated 1.55-μm two-wavelength distributed Bragg reflector (DBR) laser chip with integrated SOA for CW terahertz optical heterodyne signal generation. Continuous frequency tuning ranging from 0.06 THz–0.71 THz was obtained.

articleTitle: Cavity optomechanical magnetometry
abstract: Cavity Optomechanical magnetometry is realized by embedding the magnetostrictive material into the high Q microcavity, with sensitivity of 30 pT/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup>.

articleTitle: Photonic mixing approach to measure the angle-of-arrival of microwave signals
abstract: We propose a novel photonic approach to gauge the angle-of-arrival (AOA) and time-difference-of-arrival (TDOA) of microwave signals. The phase shift of a microwave signal at 6 GHz from 65° to 120° is measured with a maximum measurement standard error of 0.25°.

articleTitle: Optical pulling force in the vicinity of plasmonic interfaces
abstract: We demonstrate both analytically and numerically the existence of optical pulling forces acting on particles located near plasmonic interfaces. This effect can be utilized for effective optomechanical control of nanoobjects over metallic surface.

articleTitle: On-chip methane sensing with cryptophane-A cladded waveguide interferometers
abstract: We report 50-fold sensitivity enhancement of our integrated methane sensors when incorporating cryptophane-A in the waveguide cladding. A detection limit of 6 ppm was demonstrated with only 3 cm sensing length.

articleTitle: Tunable-coupling resonator arrays for chip-based quantum enigma machines
abstract: A large-scale tunable-coupling ring resonator array is demonstrated in a CMOS-compatible silicon photonics platform to achieve tunable frequency-dependent group delay. The system is proposed for a phase-encoded quantum data locking protocol.

articleTitle: Long-duration beat frequency stabilization for dual-polarization fiber grating lasers
abstract: By controlling pump power and introducing self-injection locking, beat frequency fluctuation of the dual-polarization DBR fiber laser can be greatly reduced to 8 kHz within over 1 hour, which is significant for high-accuracy sensing.

articleTitle: A chiral metamaterial for chiral responsive optoelectronic transduction
abstract: Chiral-selective nonlinear optics and optoelectronic signal generation are demonstrated in an electrically-active photonic metamaterial. The metamaterial reveals significant chiroptical responses in both harmonic generation and photon drag, correlating to the resonance in the linear regime.

articleTitle: Tunable high-power narrow-linewidth green external-cavity GaN diode laser
abstract: A tunable high-power green external-cavity diode laser is demonstrated. Up to 290 mW output power and a 9.2 nm tuning is achieve. This constitutes the highest output power from a tunable green diode laser system.

articleTitle: Spatially multiplexed bioparticle detection using multimode interference
abstract: On-chip fluorescence multiplexed detection of bioparticles is achieved by using a single multi-mode interference waveguide and a single wavelength light source to create different number of spots on three liquid-core waveguides in an optofluidic platform.

articleTitle: Fabrication of 74 mol% GeO2-doped fibers and mid-IR supercontinuum generation
abstract: We report a fabrication route to achieve highly GeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-doped silica fibers with GeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> molar concentration as high as 74% using the conventional MCVD process. Dispersion control and supercontinuum generation in 2.1-2.8μm are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal surface emitting laser with ultralow thermal resistance and narrow divergence angle
abstract: CW electrically pumped PC array surface emitting laser at 1545nm with ultralow thermal resistance of 0.018K/mW is realized experimentally. Narrow divergence angle of less than 4.8° and nearly circular beam are also achieved.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Confocal Fluorescence Microscopy by Frequency-Division-Multiplexed Multi-Line Focusing
abstract: We propose and demonstrate ultrafast fluorescence confocal microscopy at a record high frame rate of 32,000 fps. This is made possible by frequency-division multiplexing with multi-line focusing.

articleTitle: Application of a temperature-gradient PPLN crystal for IR image up-conversion
abstract: We assess the feasibility of enhancing the field-of-view of an infrared image up-converter by means of a thermal gradient in a PPLN crystal. We found a qualitative increase in both wavelength and angular tolerances which lead to the reduction of the sensitivity to illumination wavelength deviations and to the increase of the up-converted area.

articleTitle: Coupling efficiency of a single light emitter coupled to a nanofiber Bragg cavity
abstract: Coupling of lithe emitters to the fiber Bragg grating cavity is experimentally realized and the position dependence of spontaneous emission of a single dipole coupled to the cavity is numerically analyzed using 3D FDTD.

articleTitle: Dual-sideband linear FMCW lidar with homodyne detection for application in 3D imaging
abstract: Coherent lidar is reported with precision 130um and multi-target resolution 6mm. The system is based on simultaneous modulation of the in-phase and quadrature components of the transmitted optical signal and uses simplified homodyne detection.

articleTitle: Optimal receiver for coherent signals
abstract: We propose a practical receiver scheme for discriminating coherent signals with the error rate unconditionally below the standard quantum limit (or shot noise). For BPSK signals the error rate goes down to the Helstrom bound.

articleTitle: Room temperature photonic crystal bandedge membrane lasers on SOI substrates
abstract: We report the experimental demonstration of room temperature photonics crystal (PC) bandedge membrane lasers on silicon based on the transfer printing technique. Single mode lasing was observed with linewidth of 4 Å and side-mode suppression ratio (SMSR) greater than 31.5 dB.

articleTitle: Active and passive stabilization of a high-power violet frequency-doubled diode laser
abstract: We present a resonantly frequency-doubled tapered amplified semiconductor laser system emitting up to 2.6W at 400 nm. The system shows 0.12% RMS RIN, and less than 0.15%/h relative loss over 16 hours. It can be stabilized, and the internal alignment can be optimized using computer-controlled mirrors.

articleTitle: Short wavelength tail effects in multiphoton induced luminescence from ZnO using sub-10 fs Ti:Sa pulses
abstract: Multiphoton absorption induced ultraviolet luminescence in ZnO nanorods is investigated with interferometric frequency-resolved optical gating. Power dependency exponents between 3 and 4 are extracted, consistent with simulations using Keldysh theory showing three-photon and four-photon absorption.

articleTitle: Ultrafast thermal nonlinearity
abstract: We show that when optical fields are plasmonically concentrated into the volumes on the scale of few tens of nanometers, the speed of the thermo-optical effects approaches picosecond scale, suitable for applications such as all-optical switching and routing.

articleTitle: Optical communication components characterization using electro-optic dual-combs
abstract: A set-up based on an electro-optic dual-comb generator for the characterization of optical communication components is presented and experimentally validated. The instrument provides high speed operation and ultra-high wavelength resolution and frequency accuracy.

articleTitle: Highly efficient Yb3+-doped CaF2-LaF3 ceramic laser
abstract: We prepared transparent Yb:CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-LaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> ceramics with different combinations of doping concentrations of Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and La<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and obtained CW laser operation with maximum output of 3.97 W. The maximum slope efficiency was as high as 73.1%.

articleTitle: Mode coupling in chalcogenide negative curvature fibers
abstract: We calculate mode coupling and higher-order mode suppression in chalcogenide negative curvature fibers. The loss ratio of the higher-order mode to the fundamental mode is 58, while loss of the fundamental mode is under 0.4 dB/m.

articleTitle: Optical quality ZnSe films on silicon for mid-IR waveguides
abstract: ZnSe films were deposited on silicon substrates by evaporation and RF-sputtering and compared for their structural, morphological and optical properties. The deposited films were tested as waveguide cladding and the evaporated films showed lower loss.

articleTitle: Diamond color center based FM microwave demodulator
abstract: Nitrogen-vacancy centers, atomic-scale luminescent defects in diamond, are used to transduce frequency-modulated microwave signals to intensity-modulated fluorescence. Our work could lead to realization of radio receivers operating in extreme environments, including high temperature and pressure.

articleTitle: All-fiber mode-locked soliton er-lasers employing planar lightwave circuit (PLC) devices
abstract: We fabricate saturable absorbers and WDM/tap hybrid couplers using standard planar lightwave circuit (PLC) fabrication processes. The fabricated PLC devices are applied to modelocked all-fiber lasers, which show long-term stable and self-starting operation.

articleTitle: Real time measurements of temporal rogue waves and spontaneous modulation instability in optical fiber
abstract: We report the first real-time study of temporal rogue waves from spontaneous modulation instability. Time-lens magnification enables the direct capture of transient breather pulses and statistics, with measured intensity profiles in agreement with theory.

articleTitle: Terahertz optoelectronic switching with surface plasmon
abstract: We present a GaAs based optoelectronic switch that operates at exceptionally large signal modulation rates of 98% and switching rates up to THz. Applications in designing fundamental logic elements, NAND and NOR gates, are identified.

articleTitle: High color-conversion efficiency CdSe quantum dots hybrid light emitted diode
abstract: In this work, we have successfully demonstrated that the color-conversion efficiency in colloidal quantum dots can be greatly enhanced by light-emitting diodes (LEDs) with novel structures of nanorods embedded in microholes. Via an integrated technology of the nano-imprint and photolithography, nanorods structures can be fabricated at specific locations, generating functional nanostructured LEDs for high-efficiency light-emitting performance. With such a structured LED, the color-conversion efficiency of the existing quantum dots can be enhanced up to 12.5 %.

articleTitle: Boundaries of practicability for integrated stimulated Brillouin scattering devices
abstract: We present a theoretical framework for the design of silicon-photonics devices harnessing Stimulated Brillouin Scattering. We discuss the interplay and trade-off between opto-acoustic coupling, finite-size effects, nonlinear loss and fabrication tolerances.

articleTitle: High precision synchronization of a large-scale microwave network over stabilized fiber links
abstract: We demonstrate a high precision microwave network over stabilized multi-kilometer fiber links. Relative phase jitter (>1Hz) and drift (<;1Hz) between two remotely synchronized 10.83-GHz microwave sources are 77.9 and 119.6 μrad, respectively, over 2.5-hour operation.

articleTitle: Super-oscillation by higher-order radially polarized Laguerre-Gaussian beams
abstract: We investigated the super-oscillation by radially polarized Laguerre-Gaussian beams in tight focusing condition. We experimentally demonstrated that this super-oscillation is applicable for confocal laser scanning microscopy to greatly enhance the spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Lasing emission from plasmonic nanodome arrays
abstract: We demonstrate a new feedback mechanism to achieve nano-lasing using plasmonic nano-dome array (PNDA) substrates. The unique off-normal lasing phenomenon in the PNDA lasers provides useful applications which cannot be implemented by other plasmonic lasers.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence enhancement in porous SiC passivated by atomic layer deposited Al2O3 films
abstract: Porous SiC co-doped with B and N was passivated by atomic layer deposited (ALD) Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> films to enhance the photoluminescence. After optimizing the deposition conditions, as high as 14.9 times photoluminescence enhancement has been achieved.

articleTitle: Strong coupling of localized surface plasmons and ensembles of dye molecules
abstract: We have studied strong exciton-plasmon coupling in the films of silver nanoislands and layer-by-layer deposited films of gold nanoparticles coated by highly concentrated R6G dye. The experimental results agree with the analytical model.

articleTitle: Active, large-scale tuning of optical dispersion by free-space angular-chirp-enhanced delay (FACED)
abstract: We report a new technique, coined free-space angular-chirp-enhanced delay (FACED), to generate large-scale, wavelength-insensitive, actively tunable optical dispersion, at least 3 orders-of-magnitude larger in dispersion than the current techniques.

articleTitle: Tunable dual-wavelength fiber laser with ultra-narrow linewidth based on Rayleigh backscattering
abstract: We demonstrated a tunable dual-wavelength fiber laser with a 3dB linewidth of ~700 Hz for each wavelength based on the linewidth compression mechanism due to Rayleigh backscattering, and the wavelength tuning range is 3nm.

articleTitle: Volume Bragg grating based tunable continuous-wave and Bi2Te3 Q-switched Er3+:ZBLAN fiber laser
abstract: We report a tunable continuous-wave and Bi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Te<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> Q-switched Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:ZBLAN fiber laser based on a volume Bragg grating (VBG), which demonstrates that VBGs exhibit great potential in wavelength selection for applications in mid-infrared tunable laser sources.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Brillouin scattering self-cancellation
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the cancellation of Brillouin scattering by engineering a sub-wavelength diameter silica wire with exactly opposite photo-elastic and moving-boundary contributions.

articleTitle: Optical frequency combs for space applications
abstract: Optical frequency comb-based high resolution laser spectroscopy has been demonstrated in space under micro-gravity on two sounding rocket based experiments. The comb has been used to simultaneously measure two different atomic transitions.

articleTitle: Diffusive scattering from single microspheres with well-dispersed dielectric nano-scale inclusions
abstract: By fabricating a new class of composite microspheres comprising a random distribution of well-dispersed high-refractive-index dielectric nanoparticles, we confirm that forward and backward multiply scattered fields in the visible are diffusive.

articleTitle: Induction of topological transport by long ranged nonlinearity
abstract: We present topologically-protected transport in systems that are topologically trivial, but a long-range nonlinearity induces unidirectional transport and topological immunity to scattering from defects.

articleTitle: Coexistence of temporal cavity solitons and modulation instability in a passive Kerr cavity
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the simultaneous coexistence of two independent nonlinear states in a passive Kerr cavity operated at high power. Our experimental observations are shown to be in excellent agreement with simulation and theory.

articleTitle: Vertically-coupled micro-ring resonator in hydrogenated amorphous silicon
abstract: We demonstrated vertically coupled, hydrogenated amorphous silicon ring resonators by leveraging low temperature deposition of the material where SU-8 polymer was employed as planarization layer and resonator gap material.

articleTitle: Novel all-fiber comb-like filters based on circular polarization interference
abstract: We propose modified Lyot filters based on circular polarizers, which have comb-like transmission with intrinsically high spectrum modulation depth and can significantly simplify the fabrication process compared with conventional Lyot filters based on linear polarizers.

articleTitle: Depth resolved optical coherence elastography based on fiber-optic probe with integrated Fabry-Perot force sensor
abstract: We performed depth resolved elasticity measurement based on a quantitative optical coherence elastography system with integrated Fabry-Perot force sensor. We performed depth resolved stiffness measurement on a muti-layer phantom under different axial force.

articleTitle: Optomechanical enhancement of doubly resonant 2D optical nonlinearity
abstract: We report 3300 times enhancement of second harmonic generation from a MoS2 monolayer by engineering the nonlinear light-matter interaction in a micro-electro-mechanical system enabled optical frequency doubling device based on an electrostatically tunable Fabry-Perot microresonator.

articleTitle: Thermal radiation of Er doped crystals: Studying the range of applicability of the Kirchhoff's law
abstract: The range of applicability of Kirchhoff's law, predicting that emissivity of opaque bodies in thermodynamic equilibrium with environment which should be equal to absorptance, was studied in Er doped dielectric crystals - potential thermophotovoltaics radiation converters.

articleTitle: Record length (13.4km) pulse propagation in OAM states
abstract: We demonstrate 13.4km propagation of OAM L=7 fiber modes with record low 0.8dB/km loss via a circulating fiber loop experiment. For well-designed fibers, we demonstrate that OAM modes can travel distances relevant for large-scale data centers.

articleTitle: Broadband and efficient dual-pump four-wave-mixing in AlGaAs-on-insulator nano-waveguides
abstract: We characterize dual-pump four-wave-mixing in AlGaAs-on-insulator nano-waveguides and demonstrate an output conversion efficiency as high as −8.5 dB at 155-mW pump power. The idler optical signal-to-noise ratio is above 25 dB over a 26-nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: IMDD-based channel-reuse, bidirectional 40 Gb/s/λ WDM-PON
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an optical intensity modulation transmitter and direct detection receiver-based channel-reuse wavelength-division-multiplexing passive optical network (WDM-PON). Bidirectional 40 Gb/sλ, transmission over 45-km standard single-mode-fiber (SSMF) on a 100-GHz WDM grid is achieved.

articleTitle: Trapezoidal shape subwavelength grating waveguide based high quality factor micro-ring resonator
abstract: We report the design and experimental demonstration of high quality factor, trapezoidal shape subwavelength grating waveguide micro-ring resonators (SWGMRs). A 5 μm radius SWGMR with a quality factor as high as 11,500 has been demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Dynamics of mode-coupling-assisted microresonator frequency combs
abstract: We investigate theoretically and experimentally the dynamics of frequency comb formation triggered by mode-crossings in a normal group-velocity dispersion microresonator. We demonstrate that phase-matching conditions can predict the spectral features of the resulting combs.

articleTitle: Toward octave-spanning coherent near-field control in plasmonic nanostructures
